may banish chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
The ninth Rule of Villainy: When all else fails, turn
into a dragon.

cards.name: Hades
cards.fullText:

return a character card from your discard to your
hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Production is up, costs are down, the rivers are
full. Time to talk expansion.”

cards.name: Robin Hood

FEED THE POOR When you play this character, if an
opponent has more cards in their hand than you, draw a card.
GOOD SHOT During your turn, this character has Evasive.
(They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“We never rob. We just sort of borrow a bit from those who
can afford it.”

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“Sometimes, our strengths lie beneath the surface.

—Moana

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (When challenging, this character gets
+2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText: He loves to make light of a foe's predicament.

cards.name: LeFou
cards.fullText:
LOYAL If you have a character named Gaston in
play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
cards.flavorText: You need a good toady to be a proper bad guy.

cards.flavorText:
Wherever the seaweed had come from, Mickey was
sure of one thing: something fishy was going on.

cards.flavorText:
Wherever the princess goes, her musketeers are
...well, they're around somewhere, probably.

cards.name: Donald Duck

Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.

characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
STAY ALERT! During your turn, your Musketeer

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
WE CAN FIX IT Whenever this character quests,
you may ready your other Princess characters. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“I am Moana of Motunui. You will board my boat, sail
across the sea, and restore the heart of Te Fiti.”

cards.name: Mr. Smee
cards.flavorText:
“Mr. Smee is a kind, gentle soul who lives to bring
comfort and aid to a twisted old villain. Now, what
good is kindness like that?”
—Peter Pan

cards.name: Prince Phillip
cards.fullText:
HEROISM When this character challenges and is
banished, you may banish the challenged character.
cards.flavorText:
“The road to true love may be barred by still many more
dangers, which you alone will have to face.”
—Flora

cards.name: Pumbaa
cards.flavorText: “You gotta put your behind in your past.”

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
GLEAM AND GLOW When you play this
character, remove up to 3 damage from one of
your characters. Draw a card for each 1 damage
removed this way.

cards.flavorText:
“I should be writing symphonies, not tagging along after
some headstrong teenager.”

more other characters in play, you may draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText:
“So you're from outer space, huh? I hear the surfing's
choice.”
—David

cards.name: Stitch
cards.flavorText:
“His destructive programming is taking effect. He will
be irresistibly drawn to large cities, where he will back
up sewers, reverse street signs, and steal everyone's
left shoe.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Stitch
cards.flavorText:
Lilo: “David! I got a new dog!”
David: “Auwe!...You sure it's a dog?”
Lilo: “Uh-huh. He used to be a collie before he got
ran over.”

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.flavorText: She had no invitation—and needed no introduction.

cards.name: Stitch

cards.flavorText:
The best part about a beachside concert is that there's
always room for one more.

cards.name: Maui
cards.flavorText:
When the gods gift you a boat, you take it.
The boat's owner is optional.

cards.name: Timon
cards.fullText:
TASTES LIKE CHICKEN When you play this
character, you may remove up to 1 damage from
chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“There's all manner of tasty treats in the world—ya
just gotta know where to look.”

cards.name: Gaston
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: It's not arrogance when you really are the best.

cards.flavorText: What a wonderful phrase!

cards.name: Healing Glow

cards.flavorText:
“Don't freak out!”
—Rapunzel

cards.name: Just in Time
cards.fullText: You may play a character with cost 5 or less for free.
cards.flavorText:
The best heroes always arrive at the perfect moment—
whether they know it or not.

cards.name: Part of Your World
cards.flavorText:
What would I give
If I could live out of these waters?

cards.name: You Have Forgotten Me
cards.fullText: Each opponent chooses and discards 2 cards.
cards.flavorText:
“You are more than what you have become.”
—Mufasa

cards.name: Dinglehopper
cards.fullText:
STRAIGHTEN HAIR ⟳ — Remove up to 1 damage
from chosen character.
cards.flavorText: Enjoy the finest of human hairstyles!

cards.name: Lantern
cards.fullText:

character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Lanterns fill the sky on one special night, beacons of
hope and love.

cards.name: Ursula's Shell Necklace
cards.fullText:
NOW, SING! Whenever you play a song, you may pay
1 ⬡ to draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Singing is a lovely pastime...if you've got the voice
for it.”
—Ursula

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
LOVING HEART When you play this character,
if you have a character named Elsa in play, choose
an opposing character. The chosen character
doesn't ready at the start of their next turn.
cards.flavorText: “Two sisters, one mind.”

cards.name: Archimedes
cards.flavorText:
“Flying is not merely some crude, mechanical
process. It is a delicate art. Purely aesthetic.
Poetry of motion. And the best way to learn it is
to do it!”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.flavorText:
As long as he's around, newcomers to the Great
Illuminary will always get a warm welcome.

cards.flavorText: “Enchantée. A tip of the hat from Dr. Facilier.”

cards.fullText:

cards.name: Flotsam
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
DEXTEROUS LUNGE Your characters named
Jetsam gain Rush.
cards.flavorText: “We know someone who can help you...for a price.”

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
HIDDEN WONDERS This character gets +1 ¤
for each card in your hand.
cards.flavorText: There's more than one way to bury secrets.

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character
gets +3 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“Enough skulking about. It's time to show that
sniveling sultan what a sorcerer can do.”

cards.name: Jetsam
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SINISTER SLITHER Your characters named
Flotsam gain Evasive.
cards.flavorText: “We can help you get anything you want....”

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
SWEEP When you play this character, you may
shuffle a card from any discard into its player's
deck.
cards.flavorText:
In the immense story-forge known as the Great
Illuminary, there is always work to be done.

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.flavorText:
“One mustn't rush these things, or the greatest
plan might come to nothing.”

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
CAST MY SPELL! When you play this character,
you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“You dare challenge me? Fool, my magic is more
powerful than you could possibly imagine!”

cards.name: Marshmallow
cards.fullText:
DURABLE When this character is banished in a
challenge, you may return this card to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Hey! We were just talking about you! All good
things, all good things.”
—Olaf

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
ANIMATE BROOM You pay 1 ⬡ less to play Broom
characters.
CEASELESS WORKER Whenever one of your Broom
characters is banished in a challenge, you may return
that card to your hand.
cards.flavorText: He always goes for the clean sweep.

cards.name: Olaf
cards.flavorText: “I'm Olaf and I like warm hugs!”

cards.name: Pascal
cards.fullText:
CAMOUFLAGE While you have another character
in play, this character gains Evasive. (Only characters
with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText:
A true friend is always there for you, whether you can
see them or not.

cards.name: Rafiki
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“The past can hurt. But the way I see it, you can
either run from it or learn from it.”

cards.name: Sven
cards.flavorText:
“Reindeer comin' through!”
—Kristoff

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText: I SUMMON THEE ⟳ — Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Sublime beauty matched with peerless cunning. Is
there any question who is fairest?

cards.name: The Wardrobe
cards.flavorText: When you simply must have the hautest couture.

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
LOYAL AND DEVOTED Your characters named
Peter Pan gain Challenger +1. (They get +1 ¤
while challenging.)

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
IT'S TOO EASY! When you play this character,
each opponent loses 1 lore. You may draw a card
for each 1 lore lost this way.
cards.flavorText:
The first Rule of Villainy: If you're going to be evil,
you've got to have style.

cards.name: Yzma
cards.fullText:
YOU'RE EXCUSED Whenever this character
quests, look at the top card of your deck. Put it
on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “When I want your opinion, I will give it to you!”

cards.name: Zeus
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
Challenger +4 (While challenging, this character gets
+4 ¤.)
cards.flavorText: “A little lightning solves a whole lot of problems.”

cards.name: Befuddle
cards.fullText:
Return chosen character or item with cost 2 or less to
their player's hand.
cards.flavorText: Never be afraid to have your mind boggled now and then.

cards.name: Freeze
cards.fullText: Exert chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText: It's time for you to chill.

cards.name: Friends on the Other Side
cards.flavorText:
The cards, the cards
the cards will tell...

cards.name: Reflection
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put them back on the
top of your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText:
When will my reflection show
Who I am inside?

cards.name: Magic Mirror
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText: SPEAK! ⟳, 4 ⬡ — Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “What wouldst thou know, my Queen?”

cards.name: Ursula's Cauldron
cards.fullText:
PEER INTO THE DEPTHS ⟳ — Look at the top 2
cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck
and the other on the bottom.
cards.flavorText: Perfect for mixing potions and stealing voices.

cards.name: White Rabbit's Pocket Watch
cards.fullText:
I'M LATE! ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gains Rush
this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“No wonder you're late. Why, this watch is exactly two
days slow.” —The Mad Hatter

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
Fabulously wealthy. Practically untouchable.
Genuinely inauthentic.

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
ROAR When you play this character, exert all opposing
damaged characters.
cards.flavorText: “I'll take on all of you if I have to!”

cards.name: Cheshire Cat
cards.fullText:
LOSE SOMETHING? When this character is
challenged and banished, banish the challenging
character.
cards.flavorText: “You may have noticed that I'm not all there myself.”

cards.name: Cruella De Vil
cards.fullName: Cruella De Vil - Miserable as Usual
cards.fullText:
YOU'LL BE SORRY! When this character is
challenged and banished, you may return chosen
character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText: When she stops by, misery is company.

cards.name: Duke of Weselton
cards.flavorText:
“Sorcery! I knew there was something dubious
going on here.”

cards.name: Flynn Rider
cards.fullText:
HERE COMES THE SMOLDER Whenever this
character is challenged, the challenging player
chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
“I didn't want to have to do this, but you leave me
no choice....”

cards.name: Genie
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
DISAPPEAR When you play this character, you may
return chosen character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Can your friends go ‘Abracadabra, let 'er rip’ and then
make the sucker disappear?”

cards.name: Genie
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Genie.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
PHENOMENAL COSMIC POWER! Whenever this character
quests, you may play an action with cost 5 or less for free.

cards.name: Genie
cards.flavorText:
“You can wish for nearly anything! Do you want
the short version, or should I give you the whole
song and dance?”

cards.name: Hans
cards.flavorText:
“Rules are like older siblings. All they do is get in
the way.”

cards.name: Horace
cards.flavorText: “Well, they ain't in here, Jasper.”

cards.name: Iago
cards.fullText:
YOU GOT A PROBLEM? ⟳ — Chosen character
gains Reckless during their next turn. (They can't
quest and must challenge if able.)

cards.name: Jasper
cards.fullText:
PUPPYNAPPING Whenever this character
quests, chosen opposing character can't quest
during their next turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Now, look here, Horace, I warned you about
thinkin'.”

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullText:
PICK YOUR FIGHTS When you play this character
and whenever he quests, chosen opposing character
gains Reckless during their next turn. (They can't
quest and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText: “Don't be too put off by this...hunk of hardware.”

cards.name: Jumba Jookiba
cards.flavorText:
“Created something? Ha! But that would be
irresponsible and unethical. I would never, ever...
make more than one.”

cards.name: Kuzco
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
NO TOUCHY! When this character is challenged and
banished, you may banish the challenging character.
cards.flavorText:
“I asked for emerald and that is clearly jade! What is wrong
with you people?”

cards.name: Lady Tremaine
cards.fullText:
DO IT AGAIN! When you play this character,
you may return an action card from your discard
to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“If your chores are done, then clearly you don't
have enough of them.”

cards.name: Mad Hatter
cards.fullText:
TEA PARTY Whenever this character is challenged,
you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Mad Hatter: “Would you like a little more tea?”
Alice: “I haven't had any yet, so I can't very well take
more.”

cards.name: Megara
cards.fullText:
WONDER BOY When you play this character,
chosen character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“A deal's a deal. But falling in love was never
supposed to be part of it.”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
MISDIRECTION Whenever you play an action, chosen
opposing character can't quest during their next turn.
cards.flavorText: Quiet as a...well, you know.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.flavorText:
On rivers throughout the Inklands, the little
steamboat's whistle answers the cheery tunes of
its pilot.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
SKIP THE DRAMA, STAY WITH MAMA While this
character is exerted, opposing characters can't
quest.
cards.flavorText: “Great. Now I'm the bad guy.”

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “What's the matter, Hook? Can't you fly?”

cards.name: Tamatoa
cards.flavorText:
“Someday, I'll grow up to be the most crabulous
crustacean the world has ever seen!”

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
PIXIE DUST When you play this character,
chosen character gains Evasive this turn.

cards.fullText: Return an action card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“...Then scrub the terrace, sweep the halls and the
stairs, clean the chimneys. And of course there's the
mending, and the sewing, and the laundry...”
—Lady Tremaine

cards.name: Mother Knows Best
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Return chosen character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
One way or another
Something will go wrong, I swear

cards.name: Stampede
cards.fullText: Deal 2 damage to chosen damaged character.
cards.flavorText:
A wildebeest stampede is like a raging river: best
experienced from a distance.

cards.name: Steal from the Rich
cards.fullText:
Whenever one of your characters quests this turn,
each opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Wonder how much ol' Prince John spent on all those
fancy locks.”
—Little John

cards.name: Sudden Chill
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each opponent chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
Cruella De Vil, Cruella De Vil
If she doesn't scare you, no evil thing will

cards.name: The Beast is Mine!
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Reckless during their next
turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“It's only fitting that the finest hunter gets the foulest
beast!”
—Gaston

cards.name: Vicious Betrayal
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gets +2 ¤ this turn. If a Villain
character is chosen, they get +3 ¤ instead.
cards.flavorText:
“A true king takes matters into his own claws.”
—Scar

cards.name: Dr. Facilier's Cards
cards.fullText:
THE CARDS WILL TELL ⟳ — You pay 1 ⬡ less for the
next action you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Take a little trip into your future with me!”
—Dr. Facilier

cards.name: Stolen Scimitar
cards.fullText:
SLASH ⟳ — Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn.
If a character named Aladdin is chosen, he gets +2 ¤
instead.
cards.flavorText: Sometimes you've got to take what you can get.

cards.name: Abu
cards.flavorText:
“Someday, Abu, things are gonna change. We'll be
rich, live in a palace, and never have any problems
at all.”
—Aladdin

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Aladdin.)
DARING EXPLOIT During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge,
you gain 2 lore and each opponent loses 2 lore.

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
IMPROVISE When you play this character, each
opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
It can be hard to tell the difference between a
diamond in the rough and someone who's just,
well, rough.

cards.name: Captain
cards.flavorText:
“Barking signal. It's an alert. Report to the Colonel
at once!”

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
YOU COWARD! While this character is exerted,
opposing characters with Evasive gain Reckless. (They
can't quest and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText: “You wouldn't dare fight old Hook man-to-man!”

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.flavorText: “Who you callin' boisterous, buster?”

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
THAT'S NO BLIZZARD Whenever you play a
character named Anna, ready this character. This
character can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“My sister has always been there for me. I need to
be there for her.”

cards.name: Gaston
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: It's not arrogance when you really are the best.

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
Sometimes you gotta give it the ol' jump and
hyuck.

cards.name: LeFou
cards.fullText:
FAN THE FLAMES When you play this character,
ready chosen character. They can't quest for the
rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: All a mob needs is a push in the wrong direction.

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
DRAGON FIRE When you play this character,
you may banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
The ninth Rule of Villainy: When all else fails, turn
into a dragon.

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: “What I believe you were trying to say is ‘Thank you.’”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
When defeat looms and victory hangs by a thread,
a hero bolts to the rescue, patching things up
through shear determination.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.flavorText: Her fashion sense is always spot on.

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
THIS IS NOT WHO YOU ARE When you play
this character, you may banish chosen character
named Te Kā.
cards.flavorText: “You know who you are.”

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
LEAD BY EXAMPLE During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, your other characters get +1 ◊ this
turn.

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“Nobody calls Pan a coward and lives! I'll fight you
man-to-man, with one hand behind my back.”

cards.name: Pongo
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“At first I had no particular plan, just anything to
attract attention. You know, stir things up a bit.”

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
TANGLE When you play this character, each
opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: “Who are you? And how did you find me?”

cards.name: Scar
cards.flavorText: Consumed by the flames of ambition.

cards.name: Scar
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Scar.)
ROUSING SPEECH When you play this character, ready
your characters with cost 3 or less. They can't quest for the
rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: “The time has come to take what is ours!”

cards.name: Sergeant Tibbs
cards.flavorText: “Yes, sir. Righto, sir. Right away, sir!”

cards.name: Stitch
cards.flavorText:
“His destructive programming is taking effect. He will
be irresistibly drawn to large cities, where he will back
up sewers, reverse street signs, and steal everyone's
left shoe.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Te Kā
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: She burns for that which was stolen from her.

cards.name: Tigger
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText: “I'm the bounciest bouncer that ever bounced!”

cards.name: Be Prepared
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 7 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish all characters.
cards.flavorText: Our teeth and ambitions are bared!

cards.name: Cut to the Chase
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText: “Surprise!”

cards.name: Dragon Fire
cards.fullText: Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText: Rare is the hero who can withstand a dragon's wrath.

cards.name: Fan the Flames
cards.fullText:
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.
cards.flavorText: Pretty words can move a crowd, but so can ugly ones.

cards.name: He's Got a Sword!
cards.fullText: Chosen character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“We've all got swords!”
—Razoul

cards.name: Tangle
cards.fullText: Each opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Stay right there! I mean, you don't have a choice, I
guess. But still! Don't move!”
—Rapunzel

cards.name: Poisoned Apple
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
TAKE A BITE... 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Exert chosen
character. If a Princess character is chosen, banish her
instead.
cards.flavorText:
“One taste of the poisoned apple, and the victim's eyes
will close forever....”
—The Queen

cards.name: Shield of Virtue
cards.fullText:
FIREPROOF ⟳, 3 ⬡ — Ready chosen character. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Arm thyself with this enchanted Shield of Virtue
and this mighty Sword of Truth, for these weapons of
righteousness will triumph over evil.” —Flora

cards.name: Sword of Truth
cards.fullText:
FINAL ENCHANTMENT Banish this item — Banish
chosen Villain character.
cards.flavorText: Almost as powerful as True Love's Kiss.

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
LOOK AT THIS STUFF Whenever you play an
item, you may ready this character.
cards.flavorText: “You want thingamabobs? I got twenty.”

cards.name: Aurora
cards.fullText:
DISARMING BEAUTY When you play this
character, chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“There was something strange about that voice.
Too beautiful to be real...”
—Prince Phillip

cards.name: Aurora
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Aurora.)
PROTECTIVE EMBRACE Your other characters
gain Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)
cards.flavorText: As the princess slumbered, her power awoke.

cards.name: Aurora
cards.flavorText:
“They say if you dream a thing more than once,
it's sure to come true!”

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
TINKER Whenever this character quests, you
pay 1 ⬡ less for the next item you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
A little ingenuity and a lot of heart will take you far
in this world.

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
READ A BOOK During your turn, you may ink an additional
card.
MY FAVORITE PART! While you have 10 or more cards in
your inkwell, this character gets +4 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Far-off places, daring sword fights, magic spells, a prince
in disguise...”

cards.name: Chief Tui
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“You can always rely on the strength of those who
love you.”

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: Walk smarter, not harder.

cards.name: Flounder
cards.flavorText:
“Excitement...adventure...danger lurking
around every cor— AAAAAGGH!”

cards.name: Gramma Tala
cards.fullText:
I WILL BE WITH YOU When this character is
banished, you may put this card into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Moana: “Is there something you want to tell me?”
Gramma Tala: “Is there something you want to
hear?”

cards.name: Hades
cards.fullText:
IS THERE A DOWNSIDE TO THIS? When you
play this character, you may put chosen opposing
character into their player's inkwell facedown.
cards.flavorText:
“He's gotta have a weakness, because everybody's
got a weakness.”

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.flavorText:
“Try to understand. I've never done a thing on my
own. I've never had any real friends....I've never
even been outside the palace walls.”

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Jasmine.)
CARETAKER When you play this character and
whenever she quests, you may remove up to 2
damage from each of your characters.

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.flavorText:
“The princess shall indeed grow in grace and beauty,
beloved by all who know her. But before the sun sets
on her sixteenth birthday, she shall prick her finger on
the spindle of a spinning wheel....”

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.flavorText:
She had no invitation—and needed no
introduction.

cards.name: Maurice
cards.fullText:
GIVE IT A TRY Whenever this character quests,
you pay 2 ⬡ less for the next item you play this turn.
IT WORKS! Whenever you play an item, you may
draw a card.

cards.name: Merlin
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“What a mess! What a medieval muddle! We'll
have to modernize it.”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
GET A CLUE When you play this character,
you may put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Wherever the seaweed had come from, Mickey was
sure of one thing: something fishy was going on.

cards.name: Mufasa
cards.fullName: Mufasa - King of the Pride Lands
cards.flavorText:
“A king must care for all of the creatures in his
kingdom, no matter their size.”

cards.name: Philoctetes
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“Ya gotta be the best to train the best. And I train
the best!”

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullText:
FEED THE POOR When you play this character, if an
opponent has more cards in their hand than you, draw a card.
GOOD SHOT During your turn, this character gains Evasive.
(They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“We never rob. We just sort of borrow a bit from those who
can afford it.”

cards.name: Scar
cards.fullText:
INSIDIOUS PLOT When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -5 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“The best plans involve a little danger. Just not
for me.”

cards.name: Tamatoa
cards.fullText:
WHAT HAVE WE HERE? When you play this character
and whenever he quests, you may return an item card
from your discard to your hand.
GLAM This character gets +1 ◊ for each item you have
in play.
cards.flavorText: “Watch me dazzle like a diamond in the rough!”

cards.name: Triton
cards.flavorText: “Isn't ‘Because I said so’ enough of a reason?”

cards.name: Develop Your Brain
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your
hand and the other on the bottom of the deck.
cards.flavorText:
“Knowledge, wisdom—there's the real power!”
—Merlin

cards.name: If It's Not Baroque
cards.fullText: Return an item card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText: “...Don't fix it.”

cards.name: Let It Go
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Put chosen character into their player's inkwell facedown and
exerted.
cards.flavorText:
It's time to see what I can do
To test the limits and break through

cards.name: One Jump Ahead
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and
exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Gotta eat to live, gotta steal to eat—
Tell you all about it when I got the time

cards.name: Work Together
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Support this turn. (Whenever
they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
Pacha: “Put your whole back into it!”
Kuzco: “This is my whole back!”

cards.name: Coconut Basket
cards.fullText:
CONSIDER THE COCONUT Whenever you play a character,
you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
The coconut is a versatile gift from the gods, used to make
nearly everything—including baskets to carry more coconuts.

cards.name: Eye of the Fates
cards.fullText:
SEE THE FUTURE ⟳ — Chosen character gets +1 ◊
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
You can change the future once you know what you're
looking at.

cards.name: Fishbone Quill
cards.fullText:
GO AHEAD AND SIGN ⟳ — Put any card from your
hand into your inkwell facedown.
cards.flavorText:
“If you want to cross the bridge, my sweet, you've got
to pay the toll.”
—Ursula

cards.name: Magic Golden Flower
cards.fullText:
HEALING POLLEN Banish this item — Remove up to 3
damage from chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Once upon a time, a single drop of sunlight fell from
the heavens....”
—Flynn Rider

cards.name: Scepter of Arendelle
cards.fullText:
COMMAND ⟳ — Chosen character gains Support
this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤
to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.flavorText:
“Oh ho! So the street rat found a sword and a
backbone!”
—Razoul

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
BREAK When you play this character, you may
banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText: “She'll never see me as anything...but a monster.”

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullName: Captain Hook - Captain of the Jolly Roger
cards.fullText:
DOUBLE THE POWDER! When you play this
character, you may return an action card named
Fire the Cannons! from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“A pretty sight, Mr. Smee. We'll pot 'em like sitting
ducks.”

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText: He loves to make light of a foe's predicament.

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullName: Captain Hook - Thinking a Happy Thought
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Captain Hook.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character
gets +3 ¤.)
STOLEN DUST Characters with cost 3 or less can't
challenge this character.

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.flavorText:
Always vigilant. Always fierce. Always fighting over
the ball.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
STAY ALERT! During your turn, your Musketeer
characters gain Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Gantu
cards.fullText:
UNDER ARREST Characters with cost 2 or less
can't challenge your characters.
cards.flavorText: “Relax, enjoy the trip...and don't get any ideas!”

cards.name: Goons
cards.flavorText:
They may be useless, but they came with the
castle.

cards.name: Hans
cards.fullText:
STAGE A LITTLE ACCIDENT Whenever this
character quests, you may deal 1 damage to
chosen character.
cards.flavorText: Tired of being last, he decided to cut the line.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText: “You gotta admit, that was pretty heroic.”

cards.name: Kristoff
cards.flavorText:
Kristoff: “You want to talk about a supply and demand
problem? I sell ice for a living.”
Anna: “Ooh, that's a rough business to be in right now. I
mean, that is really—ah, mm. That's unfortunate.”

cards.name: Kronk
cards.flavorText: “Oh yeah. It's all coming together!”

cards.name: Lilo
cards.flavorText:
“Space. That's where aliens come from. And also
tourists!”

cards.name: Maui
cards.flavorText:
When the gods gift you a boat, you take it. The boat's
owner is optional.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
ALL FOR ONE Your other Musketeer characters
get +1 ¤.

cards.name: Prince Eric
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText: “I lost her once! I'm not gonna lose her again!”

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
GUESS WHAT? When you play this character, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
“I'm gonna be the best king the Pride Lands have
ever seen!”

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
Challenger +4 (While challenging, this character gets
+4 ¤.)
POUNCE During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText: “I'll do whatever it takes to save my kingdom.”

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
I KNOW WHAT I HAVE TO DO During your
turn, whenever this character banishes another
character in a challenge, you gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“I can't hide anymore. It's time to accept my
destiny.”

cards.name: Starkey
cards.fullText:
AYE AYE, CAPTAIN While you have a Captain
character in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
A pirate must be tough, loyal, and strong. “Smart”
doesn't even make the list.

cards.name: Te Kā
cards.fullText:
SEEK THE HEART During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
Maui: “Ever defeat a lava monster?”
Moana: “No. Have you?”

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Tinker Bell.)
ROCK THE BOAT When you play this character, deal 1
damage to each opposing character.
PUNY PIRATE! During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you may deal 2
damage to chosen opposing character.

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
BATTLE PLANS ⟳ — Draw a card, then choose
and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: Sometimes all you need is a little tactical genius.

cards.name: A Whole New World
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player discards their hand and draws 7 cards.
cards.flavorText: Shining, shimmering, splendid...

cards.name: Break
cards.fullText: Banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText: No one throws a tantrum like a beast.

cards.name: Fire the Cannons!
cards.fullText: Deal 2 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
Captain Hook: “Double the powder and shorten the
fuse!”
Mr. Smee: “Shorten the powder and double the fuse!”

cards.name: Grab Your Sword
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Deal 2 damage to each opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
We don't like
What we don't understand
In fact, it scares us

cards.name: Ransack
cards.fullText: Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: Who has time to read labels?

cards.name: Smash
cards.fullText: Deal 3 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “Go away!”

cards.name: Beast's Mirror
cards.fullText:
SHOW ME ⟳, 3 ⬡ — If you have no cards in your
hand, draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Ashamed of his monstrous form, the Beast concealed
himself inside his castle, with a magic mirror as his only
window to the outside world.

cards.name: Frying Pan
cards.fullText:
CLANG! Banish this item — Chosen character can't
challenge during their next turn.
cards.flavorText:
It's a fine piece of cookware, but as a weapon it's truly
stunning.

cards.name: Musketeer Tabard
cards.fullText:
ALL FOR ONE AND ONE FOR ALL Whenever one of
your characters with Bodyguard is banished, you may
draw a card.
cards.flavorText: There's no such thing as a lone musketeer.

cards.name: Plasma Blaster
cards.fullText:
QUICK SHOT ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
cards.flavorText:
“You don't have to say ‘pew pew’ when you use it, but it
doesn't hurt.”
—Lilo, galactic hero

cards.name: Hades
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Hades.)
SINISTER PLOT This character gets +1 ◊ for each
other Villain character you have in play.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
OHANA When you play this character, if you
have 2 or more other characters in play, you may
draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Elsa.)
DEEP FREEZE When you play this character, exert up
to 2 chosen characters. They can't ready at the start of
their next turn.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
ANIMATE BROOM You pay 1 ⬡ less to play Broom
characters.
CEASELESS WORKER Whenever one of your Broom
characters is banished in a challenge, you may return
that card to your hand.

cards.name: Genie
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
DISAPPEAR When you play this character, you may
return chosen character to their player's hand.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
MISDIRECTION Whenever you play an action, chosen
opposing character can't quest during their next turn.

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Aladdin.)
DARING EXPLOIT During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you gain 2 lore and
each opponent loses 2 lore.

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)

cards.name: Aurora
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Aurora.)
PROTECTIVE EMBRACE Your other characters gain Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
READ A BOOK During your turn, you may ink an additional
card.
MY FAVORITE PART! While you have 10 or more cards in
your inkwell, this character gets +4 ◊.

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
Challenger +4 (When challenging, this character gets
+4 ¤.)
POUNCE During your turn, this character gains Evasive.
(They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Tinker Bell.)
ROCK THE BOAT When you play this character, deal 1

challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“This isn't how most cat-and-mouse games go, is
it, Dr. Dawson?”
—Basil

cards.name: Fidget
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: When a normal henchman just won't cut it.

cards.name: Honest John
cards.fullText:
EASY STREET Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, each opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“A thing like that ought to be worth a fortune to
someone!”

cards.name: Lady Tremaine
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Lady Tremaine.)
POWER TO RULE AT LAST When you play this character, each
opponent chooses and banishes one of their characters.
cards.flavorText:
The twelfth Rule of Villainy: If you don't have a throne,
take one.

cards.name: Lady Tremaine
cards.fullText:
NOT FOR YOU When you play this character, each
opponent with more lore than you loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Make no mistake: this time I will make certain the
key remains safe!”

cards.name: Lumiere
cards.flavorText:
When things heat up, no one can hold a candle
to him.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “This goes into my top ten most fun things!”

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Minnie Mouse.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
UNDERSEA ADVENTURE Whenever you play a second
action in a turn, this character gets +2 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.flavorText: Zero to fun in under three seconds!

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?! This character enters
play with 3 damage.
cards.flavorText: Her feelings are written all over her face.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText: “I have to do something!”

cards.name: Namaari
cards.fullText:
THIS SHOULDN'T TAKE LONG ⟳, Banish this
character — Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“I don't need swords to beat you. They just make
it more fun.”

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
The glow of lore in the flood caught her eye.
“The spellbook!” she cried. “Don't let it get away!”

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Queen of Hearts.)
LET THE GAME BEGIN Whenever one of your
characters challenges another character, you may
draw a card.

cards.name: Ratigan
cards.fullText:
THIS IS MY KINGDOM When you play this character,
exert chosen opposing character with 3 ¤ or less.
Choose one of your characters and ready them. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: “This time, nothing, not even Basil, can stand in my way!”

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullText:
NOTE TO SELF, DON'T DIE During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may ready this character. She can't
quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Two parts bravery, one part cleverness, and a whole
lot of determination.

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Raya.)
CHAMPION OF KUMANDRA Whenever this
character challenges a damaged character, she
takes no damage from the challenge.

cards.name: Raya
cards.flavorText:
“My ba dreams of a united Kumandra. I fight to
honor that dream.”

cards.name: Scar
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
DADDY ISN'T HERE TO SAVE YOU During your
turn, whenever this character banishes another
character in a challenge, you may ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Shere Khan
cards.fullText:
DON'T INSULT MY INTELLIGENCE Whenever one
of your characters challenges another character,
gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
The sixth Rule of Villainy: Keep your mind sharp
and your claws sharper.

cards.name: Tigger
cards.fullText:
ENERGETIC Whenever you play an action, this
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: Bouncing in to save the day!

cards.name: Tuk Tuk
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: A good friend is always ready to roll.

cards.name: Go the Distance
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Ready chosen damaged character of yours. They can't
quest for the rest of this turn. Draw a card.

cards.name: Teeth and Ambitions
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Deal 2 damage to chosen character of yours to deal 2 damage
to another chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
Of course, quid pro quo, you're expected
To take certain duties on board

cards.name: The Most Diabolical Scheme
cards.flavorText:
Now comes the real tour de force
Tricky and wicked, of course

cards.name: What Did You Call Me?
cards.fullText: Chosen damaged character gets +3 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“No one can have a higher opinion of you than I have,
and I think you're a slimy, contemptible sewer rat!”
—Basil

cards.name: You Can Fly!
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your
next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
them.)

cards.name: Dinner Bell
cards.fullText:
YOU KNOW WHAT HAPPENS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Draw cards
equal to the damage on chosen character of yours,
then banish them.
cards.flavorText: The delicate sound of impending doom.

cards.name: Peter Pan's Dagger
cards.fullText: Your characters with Evasive get +1 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
Like so much other lore, Peter Pan's dagger was safe in
the Great Illuminary until the flood.

cards.name: Sword in the Stone
cards.fullText:
⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn for
each 1 damage on them.
cards.flavorText:
“Whoso pulleth out this sword of this stone and anvil is
rightwise king born of England.”

cards.name: Alice
cards.fullText:
GOOD ADVICE Your other characters gain
Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
WHAT DID I DO? While this character has 10 ¤
or more, she gets +4 ◊.

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Basil.)
THERE'S ALWAYS A CHANCE If you used Shift to play this
character, you may draw 2 cards when he enters play.
cards.flavorText: A solution always presents itself.

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this
turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“What an ingenious device! If its light is refracted
through these, then its images must resolve
somewhere below.”

cards.name: Basil
cards.flavorText:
“There is no question: something is afoot in the
Great Illuminary.”

cards.name: Caterpillar
cards.flavorText: “Keep your tempo.”

cards.name: Cogsworth
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Cogsworth.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
UNWIND Your other characters gain Resist +1 (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Cogsworth
cards.fullText:
WAIT A MINUTE Your characters with Reckless
gain “⟳ — Gain 1 lore.”
cards.flavorText: “This has gone far enough. I'm in charge here.”

cards.name: Cruella De Vil
cards.fullText:
NOW GET GOING During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“Isn't it just gorgeous, darling? And just as stylish
as I am.”

cards.name: Cruella De Vil
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Cruella De Vil.)
OH, NO YOU DON'T Whenever this character quests,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “It's ink couture, darling. I wear only the best!”

cards.name: Duke Weaselton
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “It's Wee-sel-ton.”

cards.name: Gaston
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Gaston.)
DEVELOPED BRAIN When you play this character,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put
one into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.

cards.name: Grand Pabbie
cards.fullText:
ANCIENT INSIGHT Whenever you remove 1 or
more damage from one of your characters, gain
2 lore.
cards.flavorText: When he talks, even the sky listens.

cards.name: Hiram Flaversham
cards.fullText:
ARTIFICER When you play this character and
whenever he quests, you may banish one of your
items to draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText:
His creations are even more wondrous with the
Illuminary's resources at his fingertips.

cards.name: James
cards.fullText:
NEVER, EVER LOSE SIGHT When this character is
banished, you may put this card into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
I'M A FAST LEARNER When you play this
character, remove up to 1 damage from chosen
character of yours.
cards.flavorText:
She may be young, but she's got the spirit of a
true leader.

cards.name: Judy Hopps
cards.fullText:
DON'T CALL ME CUTE When you play this
character, you may banish chosen item. Its player
draws a card.
cards.flavorText:
“I'll get to the bottom of what happened with that
locked lorebook. You can count on me!”

cards.name: Mrs. Judson
cards.fullText:
TIDY UP Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, you may put the top card of your deck
into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“I know just the thing. Let me fetch you a pot of
tea and some of my fresh cheese crumpets.”

cards.name: Nick Wilde
cards.fullText:
IT'S CALLED A HUSTLE When you play this
character, you may return an item card named
Pawpsicle from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText: “It's criminal how good these things taste!”

cards.name: Noi
cards.fullText:
HIDE AND SEEK While you have an item in play,
this character gains Resist +1 and Ward. (Damage
dealt to this character is reduced by 1. Opponents
can't choose this character except to challenge.)

cards.name: Owl
cards.flavorText:
“For instance, based on the quality of the light and
the subtle change in wind direction, I can safely
say that it is time for tea.”

cards.name: Prince Charming
cards.fullName: Prince Charming - Heir to the Throne
cards.flavorText:
He'd searched across the Inklands for the young
woman who'd stolen his heart at the ball, only to
find more mysteries.

cards.name: Rabbit
cards.flavorText:
Pooh: “Isn't there anybody here at all?”
Rabbit: “Nobody!”
Pooh: “Somebody's there...because somebody
must have said ‘Nobody.’”

cards.name: Sisu
cards.fullText:
I TRUST YOU Whenever this character quests,
look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put
one into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText: No matter her shape, you can't mistake her heart.

cards.name: The Nokk
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: As elusive as water.

cards.name: Winnie the Pooh
cards.fullName: Winnie the Pooh - Having a Think
cards.fullText:
HUNNY POT Whenever this character quests,
you may put a card from your hand into your
inkwell facedown.
cards.flavorText:
When he thought, he thought in the most
thoughtful way he could think.

cards.name: Falling Down the Rabbit Hole
cards.fullText:
Each player chooses one of their characters and puts
them into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Down, down, down she went, floating in a swirl of ink.
How curious!

cards.name: Four Dozen Eggs
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Your characters gain Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Launch
cards.fullText:
Banish chosen item of yours to deal 5 damage to
chosen character.
cards.flavorText: Ready...aim...coconut?

cards.name: Nothing to Hide
cards.fullText: Each opponent reveals their hand. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Helps you avoid unpleasant surprises.

cards.name: Fang Crossbow
cards.fullText:
CAREFUL AIM ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gets -2 ¤
this turn.
STAY BACK! ⟳, Banish this item — Banish chosen
Dragon character.

cards.name: Gumbo Pot
cards.fullText:
THE BEST I'VE EVER TASTED ⟳ — Remove 1 damage
each from up to 2 chosen characters.
cards.flavorText:
“A gift this special just got to be shared.”
—James

cards.name: Maurice's Workshop
cards.fullText:
LOOKING FOR THIS? Whenever you play another item,
you may pay 1 ⬡ to draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
The solution you need could be just a few adjustments
away.

cards.name: Pawpsicle
cards.fullText:
JUMBO POP When you play this item, you may draw a card.
THAT'S REDWOOD Banish this item — Remove up to 2 damage
from chosen character.

cards.name: Sardine Can
cards.fullText:
FLIGHT CABIN Your exerted characters gain Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Flight 3759 boarding now! Let's go get that lore!”
—Orville

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
YOU'RE NOT WELCOME HERE When you play this
character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
cards.flavorText: Woe to the one who draws his gaze.

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
SHIELD ANOTHER Whenever one of your other
characters would be dealt damage, put that many
damage counters on this character instead.
cards.flavorText: “You'll have to go through me first.”

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Beast.)
IT'S BETTER THIS WAY At the start of your turn, if this
character has no damage, draw a card. Otherwise, he gets
+4 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “It must be my destiny—to remain a beast forever.”

cards.name: Benja
cards.fullName: Benja - Guardian of the Dragon Gem
cards.fullText:
WE HAVE A CHOICE When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText: “Don't mistake spirit for skill.”

cards.name: Chief Bogo
cards.fullText:
INSUBORDINATION! Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, deal 1 damage to each opposing
character.
cards.flavorText:
“We can confirm the ink flood was caused by an
explosion. We have it under control—now clear
the area.”

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
HAVE COURAGE When you play this character,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard a
card.
cards.flavorText:
She's always had the heart of a champion—now
she'll have the skills, too.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Cinderella.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
THE SINGING SWORD Whenever you play a song, this
character may challenge ready characters this turn.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.flavorText:
“You go ahead, Minnie! I'm going to see if there's
any lore over here.”

cards.name: Eli La Bouff
cards.flavorText:
“I don't suppose y'all could whip up some more
magical beignets with them inkcasters?”

cards.name: Goofy
cards.flavorText:
It's a banner day for Sir Goofy, who is steeled to
prove his mettle against anyone courting trouble—
joust in case.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Hercules.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText:
A good guy to have around when something wrecks your
inkworks.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.flavorText: No need to call IX-I-I!

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Jafar.)
NOW WHERE WERE WE? During your turn,
whenever this character banishes another
character in a challenge, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
I DON'T TRUST HIM, SIRE During your turn, this
character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText: “Soon you'll learn who holds the real power!”

cards.name: Kronk
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
SCOUT LEADER During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may deal 2 damage to chosen
character.

cards.name: Lawrence
cards.fullText:
PAYBACK While this character has no damage,
he gets +4 ¤.
cards.flavorText: In this new world, the crown could finally be his.

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.fullText:
ARCHERY LESSON Whenever this character
quests, your characters gain Evasive this turn.
(They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
Learn what to do, then learn to do it without
thought.

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
MAKE IT SHINE When you play this character,
chosen character gains Resist +1 until the start of
your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
Even with a hauling weight of “seriously, a lot,” it can
only do so much in a magical flood.

cards.name: Namaari
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
BLADES This character can challenge ready
characters.

cards.name: Pacha
cards.flavorText:
“Don't be fooled by the folksy peasant look.”
—Kuzco

cards.name: Prince Naveen
cards.flavorText: All he's got is his charm.

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
OFF WITH THEIR HEADS! Whenever an opposing
character is banished, you may ready this
character.
cards.flavorText:
The fourth Rule of Villainy: Do whatever it takes
to get ahead.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullText:
SKIRMISH ⟳ — Deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
cards.flavorText:
“Capable? You don't know the half of it.”
—Little John

cards.name: The Huntsman
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
CHANGE OF HEART Whenever this character
quests, you may draw a card, then choose and
discard a card.
cards.flavorText: “Run away, hide! In the woods, anywhere!”

cards.name: The Prince
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Tiana
cards.fullText:
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 2.)
WHAT YOU GIVE IS WHAT YOU GET While this
character is exerted and you have no cards in
your hand, opponents can't play actions.

cards.name: Tiana
cards.flavorText:
“My place is going be special, with great food
to fill people's bellies and hot jazz to feed their
souls!”

cards.name: Charge!
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Challenger +2 and Resist +2
this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while challenging. Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText:
Sometimes subtlety is required. This is not one of those
times.

cards.name: Let the Storm Rage On
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: The cold never bothered me anyway

cards.name: Pick a Fight
cards.fullText:
Chosen character can challenge ready characters this
turn.
cards.flavorText: “I'm gonna wreck it!”

cards.name: Strength of a Raging Fire
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Deal damage to chosen character equal to the number of
characters you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
Tranquil as a forest
But on fire within

cards.name: Last Cannon
cards.flavorText: One shot can change everything.

cards.name: Mouse Armor
cards.fullText:
PROTECTION ⟳ — Chosen character gains Resist +1
until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: Built by the tiniest of hands for the bravest of hearts.

cards.name: Weight Set
cards.fullText:
TRAINING Whenever you play a character with 4 ¤ or
more, you may pay 1 ⬡ to draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Personally endorsed by Hercules himself!

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText: Singer 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)

cards.name: Snow White
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one

WISHES COME TRUE Whenever this character
quests, you may return a character card from your
discard to your hand.

cards.fullText:
STUDENT Whenever this character quests, you
may return another chosen character of yours to
your hand to gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Madam Mim
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
I WIN, I WIN! When you play this character, banish
her or return another 2 chosen characters of yours
to your hand.

Ward (Opponents can't choose this character

TAKE THAT! Whenever you play an action, this

WHO'S NEXT? While this character has 7 ¤ or

SECOND WIND Whenever an opposing character

Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is

Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.

characters must choose one with Bodyguard if
able.)
BLADES This character can challenge ready
characters.

cards.name: Baloo
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
LET'S MAKE LIKE A TREE When this character is
banished, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Bernard
cards.fullText:
I'LL CHECK IT OUT At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, you may ready another
chosen character of yours.
cards.flavorText: “You stay there. I'll look for scattered lore.”

cards.name: Chernabog
cards.fullText:
THE POWER OF EVIL For each character card in your
discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
SUMMON THE SPIRITS When you play this character,
shuffle all character cards from your discard into your
deck.
cards.flavorText: Darkness calls to minions everywhere.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
YOU'LL NEVER EVEN MISS IT When you play this
card, chosen opponent reveals their hand and
discards a song card of your choice.

cards.name: Dalmatian Puppy

WHERE DID THEY ALL COME FROM? You may have

in your deck.

chair.
