cards.name: Joshua Sweet
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“Heading out to the Inklands? Come on back if
you need patching up.”

cards.name: Kida
cards.flavorText: [in Atlantean] “Welcome to the Inklands”

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Kida.)
PERHAPS WE CAN SAVE OUR FUTURE When you play this
character, all characters get -3 ¤ until the start of your
next turn.
cards.flavorText: “She has been chosen.” —King Kashekim Nedakh

cards.name: Lucky
cards.fullText:
GOOD AS NEW ⟳ — Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck.
You may put each character card with cost 2 or less into
your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any
order.
PUPPY LOVE Whenever this character quests, if you have 4
or more other characters in play, your other characters get
+1 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Singer 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)
ENTOURAGE Whenever you play a character with
Bodyguard, you may remove up to 2 damage from
chosen character.
cards.flavorText: Her musical talents are off the charts!

cards.name: Miss Bianca
cards.fullName: Miss Bianca - Rescue Aid Society Agent
cards.fullText:
Singer 4 (This character counts as cost 4 to sing
songs.)
cards.flavorText:
“Our society has never failed to answer a call for
help.”
—Mr. Chairman

cards.name: Mr. Snoops
cards.flavorText:
“This is simple, Snoops! I want that lore! The one
that shines like a diamond!”
—Madame Medusa

cards.name: Nani
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText: “Let me handle this, Lilo.”

cards.name: Orville
cards.flavorText:
“Boy, look at those things go! Whaddaya call 'em?
Inkrunners? I wish I could fly like that.”

cards.name: Patch
cards.fullText:
BARK ⟳ — Chosen character gets -2 ¤ until the
start of your next turn.
cards.flavorText: Just like Thunderbolt, he'll stand up to any bad guy.

cards.name: Perdita
cards.fullText:
COME ALONG, CHILDREN When you play this
character and whenever she quests, you may play
a character with cost 2 or less from your discard
for free.
cards.flavorText: Her pups will follow her anywhere.

cards.name: Piglet
cards.fullText:
AND I'M THE CAPTAIN! While you have 2 or more
other characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Ahoy! There's lore out there, and I'm g-gonna
find it!”

cards.name: Pluto
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Pluto.)
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An
opposing character who challenges one of your characters
must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
GUARD DOG At the start of your turn, remove up to 3
damage from this character.

cards.name: Pluto
cards.fullText:
GOOD DOG ⟳ — You pay 1 ⬡ less for the next
character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText: He just can't wait for new friends to arrive!

cards.name: Pongo
cards.fullText:
TWILIGHT BARK Once per turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a
character card, put it into your hand. Otherwise,
put it on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “We'll find our way. I know we will!”

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
ALL WAYS HERE ARE MY WAYS Whenever this
character quests, your other Villain characters get
+1 ◊ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
The more of the Inklands she claims, the more
she wants.

cards.name: Rolly
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText: “I'm hungry, Mother. I really am.”

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
MAKE A NEW FRIEND When you play this character,
look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
a character card and put it into your hand. Put the
rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText: Plenty of berries—and friendship—to go around.

cards.name: Wendy Darling
cards.flavorText:
With Tink's upgrades in place, Wendy took them to
the skies to find the missing mermaid.

cards.name: 99 Puppies
cards.fullText:
Whenever one of your characters quests this turn,
gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Two, four, six, and three is nine, plus two is 11...”
—Roger

cards.name: Boss's Orders
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Support this turn. (Whenever they
quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“Snoops! I know you can look harder! Find me that lore!”
—Madame Medusa

cards.name: Heal What Has Been Hurt
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Remove up to 3 damage from chosen character. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Let your power shine
Make the clock reverse...

cards.name: Kit Cloudkicker
cards.fullText:
SKYSURFING When you play this character, you
may return chosen opposing character with 2 ¤
or less to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“It's been fun, guys, but I got to be going.
Yahoooo!”

cards.name: Quick Patch
cards.fullText: Remove up to 3 damage from chosen location.
cards.flavorText: “Good as new! Well, almost.”

cards.name: Jolly Roger
cards.fullText:
LOOK ALIVE, YOU SWABS! Characters gain Rush while here. (They can challenge
the turn they're played.)
ALL HANDS ON DECK! Your Pirate characters may move here for free.

cards.name: The Bare Necessities
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen opponent reveals their hand and discards a
non-character card of your choice.
cards.flavorText: Forget about your worries and your strife....

cards.name: How Far I'll Go
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your
hand and the other into your inkwell facedown and
exerted.

cards.name: Cleansing Rainwater
cards.fullText:
ANCIENT POWER Banish this item — Remove up to 2
damage from each of your characters.
cards.flavorText: Rainwater lands as stone melts and dragons fly again.

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullText:
CHART YOUR OWN COURSE For each location you have
in play, this character gains Resist +1 and gets +1 ◊.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: “I was never much good at games. Always hated to lose.”

cards.name: Heart of Atlantis
cards.fullText:
LIFE GIVER ⟳ — You pay 2 ⬡ less for the next
character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“It's what's keeping you—all of Atlantis—alive!”
—Milo Thatch

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Stitch.)
ADORING FANS Whenever you play a character
with cost 2 or less, you may exert them to draw a
card.

cards.name: Wildcat's Wrench
cards.fullText:
REBUILD ⟳ — Remove up to 2 damage from chosen
location.
cards.flavorText: The right tool makes all the difference.

cards.name: Never Land
cards.flavorText:
The mermaids told Peter they'd seen some items floating by several days earlier,
but they were more concerned that one of their sisters had gone missing.

cards.name: Pride Lands
cards.fullText:
WE ARE ALL CONNECTED Characters get +2 ⛉ while here.
LION HOME If you have a Prince or King character here, you pay 1 ⬡ less
to play characters.

cards.name: Tiana's Palace
cards.fullText: NIGHT OUT Characters can't be challenged while here.
cards.flavorText: In New Orleans, dreams can come true.

cards.name: Alice
cards.fullText:
CURIOUSER AND CURIOUSER ⟳ — Exert chosen
opposing character and all other opposing
characters with the same name.
cards.flavorText:
With the right tea leaves and a little magic, she
creates the perfect cup for any party guest.

cards.name: Chernabog's Followers
cards.fullText:
RESTLESS SOULS Whenever this character quests,
you may banish them to draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Let chaos reign.

cards.name: Diablo
cards.fullText:
LOOKING FOR AURORA Whenever you play a
character named Maleficent, you may look at the
top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the
bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
With a little ink-enhanced magic, nothing escapes
his sight.

cards.name: Genie
cards.fullText:
THREE WISHES Whenever this character quests,
you may shuffle this card into your deck to draw 3
cards.
cards.flavorText:
“Right here, direct from the lamp, right here for
your very much wish fulfillment.”

cards.name: Hydros
cards.fullText: BLIZZARD ⟳ — Exert chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “Freeze Zeus!”

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
TREASURE FINDER Whenever this character
quests, you pay 1 ⬡ less for the next item you
play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
A strange new world is the perfect place to make a
strange new fortune!

cards.name: Iago
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Your majesty certainly has a way with dumb
animals.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
I AM YOUR MASTER NOW When you play this
character, look at the top 2 cards of your deck.
Put one on the top of your deck and the other on
the bottom.
cards.flavorText: “I will rule as far as the eye can see.”

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Jafar.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
POWER BEYOND MEASURE During your turn, while this
character is exerted, whenever you draw a card, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Lena Sabrewing
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText: Born from the shadows. Saved by friendship.

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
POWER CLEAN When you play this character, if
you have a Sorcerer character in play, you may
exert chosen opposing character. They can't
ready at the start of their next turn.
cards.flavorText: Super-smooth tidiness.

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
CLEAN THIS, CLEAN THAT When you play this character,
you may shuffle all Broom cards from your discard into
your deck.
cards.flavorText: Super-speedy tidiness.

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
CLEAN SWEEP While this character is at a
location, it gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText: Super-sized tidiness.

cards.name: Magic Carpet
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
FIND THE WAY ⟳ — Move a character of yours to a location
for free.
cards.flavorText:
“Carpet and I can swoop in, grab the lore, and be back
before anyone knows it!” —Aladdin

cards.name: Magica De Spell
Magica De Spell
cards.fullName: Magica De Spell - The Midas Touch
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Magica De Spell.)
ALL MINE Whenever this character quests, gain lore
equal to the cost of one of your items in play.
cards.flavorText:
“I can feel my powers growing the closer I get to
Scrooge's precious dime!”

cards.name: Magica De Spell
cards.fullText:
TELEKINESIS ⟳ — Return chosen item with cost
equal to or less than this character's ¤ to its
player's hand.
cards.flavorText: “Do you know what I call this? A good start!”

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
DARK KNOWLEDGE Whenever this character quests,
you may draw a card.
DIVINATION During your turn, whenever you draw a
card, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen
character to chosen opposing character.

cards.name: Mama Odie
cards.fullText:
LISTEN TO YOUR MAMA NOW Whenever this
character quests, you may move up to 2 damage
counters from chosen character to chosen
opposing character.
cards.flavorText: “That's the way to give it what it needs, Juju!”

cards.name: Pua
cards.fullText:
ALWAYS THERE When this character is banished,
you may shuffle this card into your deck.
cards.flavorText: Always ready to lend a hand...er, snout.

cards.name: Rafiki
cards.fullText:
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets
+3 ¤.)
ANCIENT SKILLS Whenever he challenges a Hyena
character, this character takes no damage from the
challenge.
cards.flavorText: Mind the stick!

cards.name: Stratos
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
CYCLONE ⟳ — Gain lore equal to the number of
Titan characters you have in play.
cards.flavorText: “Blow Zeus away!”

cards.name: The Firebird
cards.flavorText:
It rages through the forest,
Wings spread wide with flame
Spring sings its ancient chorus
And green renews its claim

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.flavorText:
“A cobweb's strand to hold her fast
An eagle's eye to see her well
Sands of time to steal her past
Thus I cast my magic spell!”

cards.name: Treasure Guardian
cards.fullName: Treasure Guardian - Protector of the Cave
cards.fullText:
WHO DISTURBS MY SLUMBER? This character can't
challenge or quest unless it is at a location.
cards.flavorText: “Only one may enter here.”

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
YOU'RE TOO LATE Whenever this character
quests, chosen opposing character can't ready at
the start of their next turn.
cards.flavorText: The secret contract has already been written.

cards.name: Bestow a Gift
cards.fullText:
Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to
chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
“From magic ink I call this gift.
Fly my minion, thy wings be swift!”
—Maleficent

cards.name: It Calls Me
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Draw a card. Then, choose up to 3 cards from chosen
opponent's discard and shuffle them into their deck.
cards.flavorText: I am everything I've learned and more

cards.name: Last-Ditch Effort
cards.fullText:
Exert chosen opposing character. Then chosen
character of yours gains Challenger +2 this turn.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText: “I got your back.”

cards.name: The Boss is on a Roll
cards.fullName: The Boss is on a Roll
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put any number of them
on the top or the bottom of your deck in any order. Gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: Go ahead! Make your choice!

cards.name: The Lamp
cards.fullText:
GOOD OR EVIL Banish this item — If you have a
character named Jafar in play, draw 2 cards. If you
have a character named Genie in play, return chosen
character with cost 4 or less to their player's hand.

cards.name: The Sorcerer's Hat
cards.fullText:
INCREDIBLE ENERGY ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Name a card, then reveal the
top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put that card
into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
Minnie approached it cautiously. Whoever had placed it here
might have prepared traps.

cards.name: Forbidden Mountain
cards.flavorText:
An eerie quiet surrounds the castle—but beware of the dangerous
occupant within.

cards.name: The Queen's Castle
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
USING THE MIRROR At the start of your turn, for each character you have here,
you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Those who visit the mirror can choose their question—but not the answer.

cards.name: The Sorcerer's Tower
cards.fullText:
BROOM CLOSET Your characters named Magic Broom may move here for free.
MAGICAL POWER Characters get +1 ◊ while here.
cards.flavorText: Everything you need to make some magic.

cards.name: Cubby
cards.fullText:
THE BEAR Whenever this character moves to a
location, he gets +3 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
With Peter holding off Hook, Cubby did what he
does best: break stuff.

cards.name: Cursed Merfolk
cards.fullText:
POOR SOULS Whenever this character is challenged,
each opponent chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Now it's happened once or twice, someone couldn't
pay the price...”
—Ursula

cards.name: Don Karnage
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“You didn't expect to find me here, did you? Well
neither did I.”

cards.name: Flotsam
cards.fullText:
EERIE PAIR Your characters named Jetsam get
+3 ¤.
cards.flavorText: “Ursula needs lore to complete her plan....”

cards.name: Friar Tuck
cards.fullText:
YOU THIEVING SCOUNDREL When you play this
character, the player or players with the most
cards in their hand chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText: “Get outta my church! Out! Out! Out!”

cards.name: Helga Sinclair
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Helga Sinclair.)
THIS CHANGES EVERYTHING Whenever this
character quests, you may deal 3 damage to
chosen damaged character.

cards.name: Helga Sinclair
cards.fullText:
NOTHING PERSONAL When this character is
challenged and banished, banish the challenging
character.
cards.flavorText: “You said we were in this together!”

cards.name: Jetsam
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
EERIE PAIR Your characters named Flotsam gain Ward.
cards.flavorText: “There must be powerful lore here, very powerful.”

cards.name: Kit Cloudkicker
cards.fullText:
SKYSURFING When you play this character, you
may return chosen opposing character with 2 ¤
or less to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“It's been fun, guys, but I got to be going.
Yahoooo!”

cards.name: Lyle Tiberius Rourke
cards.fullText:
WELL, NOW YOU KNOW When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gains Reckless during their
next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
THANKS FOR VOLUNTEERING Whenever one of your
other characters is banished, each opponent loses 1 lore.

cards.name: Milo Thatch
cards.flavorText:
“Believe me, studying gibberish really can take
you places!”

cards.name: Milo Thatch
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Milo Thatch.)
TAKE THEM BY SURPRISE When this character is
banished, return all opposing characters to their
players' hands.
cards.flavorText: “You don't know what you're tampering with.”

cards.name: Morph
cards.fullText:
MIMICRY You may play any character with Shift on
this character as if this character had any name.
cards.flavorText:
“You jiggle-headed blob of mischief!”
—John Silver

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
I CAME TO LISTEN TO THE STORIES Once per turn,
when this character moves to a location, gain lore
equal to that location's ◊.
cards.flavorText:
The Illumineers needed someone to find a missing
spellbook, and Peter was the first to volunteer.

cards.name: Prince John
cards.fullText:
COLLECT TAXES Whenever this character quests,
each opponent with more lore than you loses 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Too late to be known as John the First, he's sure to
be known as John the Worst!”
—Sheriff of Nottingham

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.flavorText:
“Some days, it's nice to let the river do the
running.”

cards.name: Shenzi
cards.fullText:
I'LL HANDLE THIS While this character is at a location, she
gets +3 ¤.
WHAT'S THE HURRY? While this character is at a location,
whenever she challenges another character, you may draw
a card.
cards.flavorText: “Why not stick around for dinner?”

cards.name: Sir Hiss
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: Prince John isn't the only one collecting “taxes”!

cards.name: Skippy
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: Even the bravest outlaw knows when to lie low.

cards.name: Starkey
cards.flavorText: Point him in the right direction, and he'll do the rest.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
HIDE While this character is at a location, he gains
Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)
cards.flavorText: For such a flashy dresser, he sure is hard to spot.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
YOU'LL NEVER EVEN MISS IT When you play this
character, chosen opponent reveals their hand
and discards a song card of your choice.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
WHAT A DEAL Whenever this character sings a song,
you may play that song again from your discard for
free. If you do, put that card on the bottom of your
deck instead of into your discard.
cards.flavorText: “I don't want much—just the most powerful lore!”

cards.name: Wildcat
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
DISASSEMBLE ⟳ — Banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText: “I can take anything apart in under five minutes!”

cards.name: Zazu
cards.fullName: Zazu - Steward of the Pride Lands
cards.fullText:
IT'S TIME TO GO! While this character is at a
location, he gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“I'd be lyin' if I said I ran the place, but welcome to
the Pride Lands all the same!”

cards.name: Has Set My Heaaaaaaart...
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText:
He's not real smart
And yet, he's touched my little cowhide heart

cards.name: I Will Find My Way
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Chosen character of yours gets +2 ¤ this turn. They may move to
a location for free.
cards.flavorText:
I would go most anywhere
To feel like I belong

cards.name: Strike a Good Match
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
Please bring honor to us
Please bring honor to us all

cards.name: Airfoil
cards.fullText:
I GOT TO BE GOING ⟳ — If you've played 2 or more
actions this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Discovered in the lost Sea Duck, it looked good as new.

cards.name: Robin's Bow
cards.fullText:
FOREST'S GIFT ⟳ — Deal 1 damage to chosen damaged
character or location.
A BIT OF A LARK Whenever a character of yours named Robin
Hood quests, you may ready this item.
cards.flavorText:
“The forest always provides just what you need.”
—Robin Hood

cards.name: Starlight Vial
cards.fullText:
EFFICIENT ENERGY ⟳ — You pay 2 ⬡ less for the next
action you play this turn.
TRAP 2 ⬡, Banish this item — Draw 2 cards, then choose
and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: In the wrong hands, this vial of magic could be disastrous.

cards.name: De Vil Manor
cards.flavorText:
“They say the ol' place is haunted, or bewitched, or some such fiddle-faddle.”
—Colonel

cards.name: Fang
cards.fullText:
SURROUNDED BY WATER Characters gain Ward and Evasive while here. (Opponents can't
choose them except to challenge. Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText: A nation protected by fierce assassins and their even fiercer cats.

cards.name: Kuzco's Palace
cards.fullName: Kuzco's Palace - Home of the Emperor
cards.fullText:
CITY WALLS Whenever a character is challenged and banished while here, banish the
challenging character.
cards.flavorText: “Sure it's a little small, but also it DOESN'T HAVE A POOL!” —Kuzco

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
INSPIRING VOICE Whenever you play a song, chosen
character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next
turn.
cards.flavorText: Shipwrecks are great places to find lore—and hide from sharks!

cards.name: Billy Bones
cards.fullName: Billy Bones - Keeper of the Map
cards.flavorText:
“He's after me chest, that fiendish cyborg and his
band of cutthroats.”

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
NEMESIS During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
MAN-TO-MAN Characters named Peter Pan lose
Evasive and can't gain Evasive.

cards.name: Della Duck
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“I survived the moon. How tough could the flooded
Inklands be?”

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
MINDLESS WANDERING Once per turn, when this
character moves to a location, each opponent
loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: Considering the coconut.

cards.name: Hydra
cards.fullText:
WATCH THE TEETH Whenever this character is
dealt damage, deal that much damage to chosen
opposing character.
cards.flavorText: More heads are better than one.

cards.name: Jim Hawkins
cards.fullText:
THIS IS IT! When you play this character, you may play a
location with cost 4 or less for free.
TAKE THE HELM Whenever you play a location, this
character may move there for free.
cards.flavorText:
“You're gonna rattle the stars, you are.”
—John Silver

cards.name: Jim Hawkins
cards.flavorText:
If you want a bigger reward, you've got to take
bigger risks.

cards.name: Kakamora
cards.fullText:
PLUNDER When you play this character, each
opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: There's a bunch more where he came from.

cards.name: Madame Medusa
cards.fullText:
THAT TERRIBLE WOMAN When you play this
character, banish chosen opposing character with
3 ¤ or less.
cards.flavorText:
“Finding lore will be as easy as taking candy from
children.”

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
IN MA BELLY Whenever a character of yours named
HeiHei quests, this character gets +1 ◊ and loses
Reckless this turn.
cards.flavorText: “You got any more of those chickens hanging around?”

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
THIS MISSION IS CURSED This character can't
ready at the start of your turn.
I GOT YOUR BACK 2 ⬡ — Ready this character.
He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: Always ready to make a splash.

cards.name: Milo Thatch
cards.fullText:
I'M YOUR MAN! While this character is at a
location, he gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText: “My grandpa never told me about this place!”

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Moana.)
WELCOME TO MY BOAT Whenever this character
quests while at a location, ready all other characters
here. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: No fire or storm will keep her from her goal.

cards.name: Nutsy
cards.flavorText:
“Nutsy, button your beak.”
—Trigger

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
OVER HERE, TINK While you have a character named
Tinker Bell in play, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
With Peter, plans often meant diving headlong into
danger.

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Peter Pan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
YOU'RE NEXT! Whenever he challenges a Pirate character,
this character takes no damage from the challenge.

cards.name: Prince Eric
cards.fullText:
SURPRISE MANEUVER When this character is
banished, you may banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
The storm came out of nowhere, forcing Eric
to turn back before he reached the mysterious
structure at the edge of Lorcana.

cards.name: Scroop
cards.fullText:
BRUTE While this character has damage, he gets
+3 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
Always keep him in front of you. And downwind,
if possible.

cards.name: Simba
cards.flavorText:
He'll join the hunt for lore after he's had a quick
snack.

cards.name: Slightly
cards.fullText:
THE FOX If you have a character named Peter Pan in
play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText: “Pirates sure are easy to trick!”

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“Who thought giving him power armor was a
good idea?!”
—Nani

cards.name: Trigger
cards.fullText: OLD BETSY Your characters named Nutsy get +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Criminently, Trigger! Point that peashooter the
other way.”
—Sheriff of Nottingham

cards.name: Webby Vanderquack
cards.flavorText:
“Finding lore is a lot easier when you have a
grappling hook!”

cards.name: Divebomb
cards.fullText:
Banish one of your characters with Reckless to banish
chosen character with less ¤ than that character.

cards.name: I've Got a Dream
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Ready chosen character of yours at a location. They can't quest
for the rest of this turn. Gain lore equal to that location's ◊.
cards.flavorText:
Tor would like to quit and be a florist
Gunther does interior design

cards.name: On Your Feet! Now!
cards.fullText:
Ready all your characters and deal 1 damage to each of
them. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Catch them! Before they get away!”

cards.name: Voyage
cards.fullText:
Move up to 2 characters of yours to the same location
for free.
cards.flavorText: “We were voyagers! Why'd we stop?” —Moana

cards.name: Maui's Fish Hook
cards.fullText:
IT'S MAUI TIME! If you have a character named Maui in play,
you may use this item's Shapeshift ability for free.
SHAPESHIFT ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Choose one:
• Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next
turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
• Chosen character gets +3 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Sumerian Talisman
cards.fullText:
SOURCE OF MAGIC During your turn, whenever one of your
characters is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Summoned spirit from the dark
Show thyself before this arc.”
—Lena Sabrewing

cards.name: Agrabah
cards.flavorText:
“Welcome to Agrabah, city of mystery, of enchantment, and the finest
merchandise this side of the river.”
—Merchant

cards.name: Jolly Roger
cards.fullText:
LOOK ALIVE, YOU SWABS! Characters gain Rush while here. (They can challenge
the turn they're played.)
ALL HANDS ON DECK! Your Pirate characters may move here for free.

cards.name: RLS Legacy
cards.fullText:
THIS IS OUR SHIP Characters gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
HEAVE TOGETHER NOW If you have a character here, you pay 2 ⬡ less to move a
character of yours here.

cards.name: Audrey Ramirez
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
SPARE PARTS Whenever this character quests,
ready one of your items.
cards.flavorText: “How'd you break this thing, anyway?”

cards.name: Captain Amelia
cards.fullText:
DISCIPLINE During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“I've spotted a strange structure on the horizon.
Hard to port, helmsman!”

cards.name: Dewey
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText: “I got it! I knew I could do it! Dewey for the win!”

cards.name: Flintheart Glomgold
cards.fullText:
THEY'LL NEVER SEE IT COMING! During your turn,
this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText: “Nobody tells Flintheart Glomgold what to do!”

cards.name: Genie
cards.flavorText:
“Ten thousand years will give you such a crick in
the neck!”

cards.name: Gramma Tala
cards.fullName: Gramma Tala - Keeper of Ancient Stories
cards.fullText:
THERE WAS ONLY OCEAN When you play this
character, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You
may put one into your hand. Put the rest on the
bottom of your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText:
Listen with your whole heart, and the ancestors will
guide you.

cards.name: Gramma Tala
cards.fullName: Gramma Tala - Spirit of the Ocean
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Gramma Tala.)
DO YOU KNOW WHO YOU ARE? Whenever a card is put
into your inkwell, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
She will always be with you, no matter how far your
journey takes you.

cards.name: Gyro Gearloose
cards.fullText:
NOW TRY TO KEEP UP ⟳ — Put an item card from
your discard on the top of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “Maybe the bulb tech will be less evil this time...”

cards.name: Huey
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
THREE NEPHEWS Whenever this character quests, if you
have characters named Dewey and Louie in play, you
may draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: “This looks like part of a larger crystal!”

cards.name: King Louie
cards.flavorText:
“Hold up, cuz. Why not sit back and enjoy some
sweet beats?”

cards.name: Kit Cloudkicker
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Kit Cloudkicker.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)

cards.name: Kit Cloudkicker
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
Thrilled to have his airfoil back, he launched into
the Inklands.

cards.name: Louie
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText: “Found the last one!”

cards.name: Maid Marian
cards.fullText:
HIGHBORN LADY When you play this character,
chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: She makes every space more beautiful.

cards.name: Mama Odie
cards.fullText:
THIS GOING TO BE GOOD Whenever you play a song,
you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “You dig a little deeper, you'll find everything you need.”

cards.name: Pluto
cards.flavorText:
Pluto's job was to keep Gustav's attention so
Minnie could get to the cave.

cards.name: Rufus
cards.fullText:
TOO OLD TO BE CHASING MICE When this
character is banished, you may put this card into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “Faith is a bluebird you see from afar.”

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullName: Scrooge McDuck - Richest Duck in the World
cards.fullText:
I'M GOING HOME! During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
I DIDN'T GET RICH BY BEING STUPID During your turn,
whenever this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may play an item for free.
cards.flavorText: He can make money anywhere.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
TREASURE FINDER Whenever this character
quests, you pay 1 ⬡ less for the next item you
play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
A strange new world is the perfect place to make a
strange new fortune!

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
CALCULATING AND VAIN Whenever this character
quests, you may look at the top 3 cards of your
deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavorText:
She has only one question, and she'd better like
the answer.

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
I CAN USE THAT Whenever one of your items is
banished, you may put that card into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: She lives in a world of possibilities.

cards.name: Wendy Darling
cards.fullName: Wendy Darling - Authority on Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Distract
cards.fullText: Chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn. Draw a card.

cards.name: Friend Like Me
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player puts the top 3 cards of their deck into
their inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: You got some power in your corner now

cards.name: How Far I'll Go
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your
hand and the other into your inkwell facedown and
exerted.

cards.name: Repair
cards.fullText:
Remove up to 3 damage from one of your locations or
characters.
cards.flavorText:
“I'm thinkin' about opening a shop here. What do you
think?”

cards.name: Aurelian Gyrosensor
cards.fullText:
SEEKING KNOWLEDGE Whenever one of your characters
quests, you may look at the top card of your deck. Put it
on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
“It can point you toward lost lore, but if you're not careful,
it'll lead you off a cliff.”
—Venturo, an Illumineer

cards.name: Heart of Te Fiti
cards.fullText:
CREATE LIFE ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Put the top card of your deck
into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: It takes a pure heart to calm the raging storm within.

cards.name: Lucky Dime
cards.fullText:
NUMBER ONE ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Choose a character of yours
and gain lore equal to their ◊.
cards.flavorText: This one simple coin changed Scrooge's life forever.

cards.name: Scrooge's Top Hat
cards.fullText:
BUSINESS EXPERTISE ⟳ — You pay 1 ⬡ less for the
next item you play this turn.
cards.flavorText: Just the thing to top off another brilliant deal.

cards.name: Vault Door
cards.fullText:
SEALED AWAY Your locations and characters at
locations gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
Only Scrooge knows about this vault. And he's going to
keep it that way.

cards.name: Belle's House
cards.fullText: LABORATORY If you have a character here, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play items.
cards.flavorText: Some of the most important tools in Lorcana are crafted here.

cards.name: McDuck Manor
cards.flavorText:
“It's only the coolest home in Lorcana!”
—Webby Vanderquack

cards.name: Motunui
cards.fullText:
REINCARNATION Whenever a character is banished while here, you may
put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Chief Tui
cards.flavorText: “Look at our home! There is no better place to be.”

cards.name: Eeyore
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: “Not much of a roadblock, but I suppose I'll do.”

cards.name: Gustav the Giant
cards.fullName: Gustav the Giant - Terror of the Kingdom
cards.fullText:
ALL TIED UP This character enters play exerted
and can't ready at the start of your turn.
BREAK FREE During your turn, whenever one of
your other characters banishes another character
in a challenge, you may ready this character.

cards.name: Hades
cards.fullText: CALL THE TITANS ⟳ — Ready your Titan characters.
cards.flavorText:
“Brothers! Titans! Look at you in your squalid prison.
Who put you down there?”

cards.name: Helga Sinclair
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText: “That was an order, not a suggestion. Let's go!”

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullText:
CHART YOUR OWN COURSE For each location you have
in play, this character gains Resist +1 and gets +1 ◊.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: “I was never much good at games. Always hated to lose.”

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
cards.flavorText: She's seen strange things before, but nothing like this.

cards.name: Little John
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Little John.)
OKAY, BIG SHOT While this character is exerted, your
characters with Bodyguard gain Resist +1 and get +1 ◊.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Little John
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
DISGUISED During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Lythos
cards.fullText:
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 2.)
STONE SKIN ⟳ — Chosen character gains Resist
+2 this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Crush Zeus!”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
LET'S TAKE A LOOK This character gets +1 ¤ for
each location you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
Mickey knew just where to start searching for
the Sorcerer's Hat, but he didn't expect it to be
guarded.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText: SOUND THE CALL ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Play a character for free.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
JOURNEY While this character is at a location,
she gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText: She'll never cave under pressure.

cards.name: Mr. Smee
cards.fullText:
OH DEAR, DEAR, DEAR At the end of your turn,
if this character is exerted and you don't have a
Captain character in play, deal 1 damage to this
character.
cards.flavorText: “Catch those little—OUCH!”

cards.name: Mufasa
cards.fullName: Mufasa - Champion of the Pride Lands
cards.flavorText: Even his name makes enemies quiver in fear.

cards.name: Nala
cards.flavorText: “Pinned ya again.”

cards.name: Pyros
cards.fullText:
ERUPTION During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may ready chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “Melt Zeus!”

cards.name: Razoul
cards.fullText:
LOOKY HERE While this character has no damage,
he gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“There's no princess here to save you this time,
street rat.”

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.flavorText:
“You call this an ambush? Tsk, tsk. It's barely a
bushwhack.”

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Robin Hood.)
SKILLED COMBATANT During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
THE GOOD OF OTHERS When this character is banished in a
challenge, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Sheriff of Nottingham
cards.fullText:
TAXES SHOULD HURT Whenever you discard a
card, you may deal 1 damage to chosen opposing
character.
cards.flavorText:
The thirteenth Rule of Villainy: Take everything you
can, but do it with a smile.

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
STEP DOWN OR FIGHT When you play this character and
whenever he banishes another character in a challenge
during your turn, you may choose one:
• Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard 2 cards.
• Deal 2 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText: He's ready to restore the Pride Lands to their former glory.

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
TRIUMPHANT STANCE During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in
a challenge, chosen opposing character can't
challenge during their next turn.
cards.flavorText:
With dangers multiplying all around, the pride needs
its guardian.

cards.name: Thaddeus E. Klang
cards.fullText:
MY TEETH ARE SHARPER Whenever this character
quests while at a location, you may deal 1 damage
to chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “Soon the bells will ring in the sound of your doom!”

cards.name: And Then Along Came Zeus
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Deal 5 damage to chosen character or location.
cards.flavorText:
He hurled his thunderbolt—He zapped
Locked those suckers in a vault—They're trapped
And on his own stopped chaos in its tracks

cards.name: Ba-Boom!
cards.fullText: Deal 2 damage to chosen character or location.
cards.flavorText: Bigger than your average boom!

cards.name: Olympus Would Be That Way
cards.fullText:
Your characters get +3 ¤ while challenging a location
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Now that I set you free, what is the first thing you are
going to do?”
—Hades

cards.name: Rise of the Titans
cards.fullText: Banish chosen location or item.
cards.flavorText:
“Oh, we're in trouble, big trouble!”
—Hermes

cards.name: Captain Hook's Rapier
cards.fullText:
GET THOSE SCURVY BRATS! During your turn, whenever
one of your characters banishes another character in a
challenge, you may pay 1 ⬡ to draw a card.
LET'S HAVE AT IT! Your characters named Captain Hook
gain Challenger +1. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Gizmosuit
cards.fullText:
CYBERNETIC ARMOR Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Resist +2 until the start of your next
turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText:
It stands in the Hall of Lorcana, waiting for someone to
speak the secret words.

cards.name: Map of Treasure Planet
cards.fullText:
KEY TO THE PORTAL ⟳ — You pay 1 ⬡ less for the next location
you play this turn.
SHOW THE WAY You pay 1 ⬡ less to move your characters to a
location.
cards.flavorText:
“Gentlemen, this must be kept under lock and key.”
—Captain Amelia

cards.name: Maui's Place of Exile
cards.fullName: Maui's Place of Exile - Hidden Island
cards.fullText:
ISOLATED Characters gain Resist +1 while here. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: Nothing but boulders and sand—easy to miss.

cards.name: Nottingham
cards.flavorText:
Sir Hiss: “I say, sire, your mother's castle will be the perfect place to set up our scheme!”
Prince John: “Mommy!”

cards.name: The Bayou
cards.fullText:
SHOW ME THE WAY Whenever a character quests while here, you may draw a card, then
choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: A place to find what you need, not just what you want.

cards.name: Chernabog
cards.fullText:
THE POWER OF EVIL For each character card
in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
SUMMON THE SPIRITS When you play this
character, shuffle all character cards from your
discard into your deck.

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Kida.)
PERHAPS WE CAN SAVE OUR FUTURE When you play
this character, all characters get -3 ¤ until the
start of your next turn.

cards.name: Pride Lands
cards.fullText:
WE ARE ALL CONNECTED Characters get +2 ⛉ while here.
LION HOME If you have a Prince or King character here, you pay 1 ⬡ less
to play characters.

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Jafar.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
POWER BEYOND MEASURE During your turn, while this
character is exerted, whenever you draw a card, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
DARK KNOWLEDGE Whenever this character quests,
you may draw a card.
DIVINATION During your turn, whenever you draw a
card, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen
character to chosen opposing character.

cards.name: The Sorcerer's Hat
cards.fullText:
INCREDIBLE ENERGY ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Name a card, then reveal
the top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put that
card into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your
deck.

cards.name: Morph
cards.fullText:
MIMICRY You may play any character with Shift on
this character as if this character had any name.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
WHAT A DEAL Whenever this character sings a song,
you may play that song again from your discard for
free. If you do, put that card on the bottom of your
deck instead of into your discard.

cards.name: Kuzco's Palace
cards.fullName: Kuzco's Palace - Home of the Emperor
cards.fullText:
CITY WALLS Whenever a character is challenged and banished while here,
banish the challenging character.

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
NEMESIS During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
MAN-TO-MAN Characters named Peter Pan lose
Evasive and can't gain Evasive.

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Peter Pan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
YOU'RE NEXT! Whenever he challenges a Pirate character,
this character takes no damage from the challenge.

cards.name: RLS Legacy
cards.fullText:
THIS IS OUR SHIP Characters gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
HEAVE TOGETHER NOW If you have a character here, you pay 2 ⬡ less to move a
character of yours here.

cards.name: Gramma Tala
cards.fullName: Gramma Tala - Spirit of the Ocean
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Gramma Tala.)
DO YOU KNOW WHO YOU ARE? Whenever a card is
put into your inkwell, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullName: Scrooge McDuck - Richest Duck in the World
cards.fullText:
I'M GOING HOME! During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
I DIDN'T GET RICH BY BEING STUPID During your turn,
whenever this character banishes another character
in a challenge, you may play an item for free.

cards.name: Belle's House
cards.fullText: LABORATORY If you have a character here, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play items.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText: SOUND THE CALL ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Play a character for free.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Robin Hood.)
SKILLED COMBATANT During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
THE GOOD OF OTHERS When this character is banished in a
challenge, you may draw a card.

cards.name: And Then Along Came Zeus
Piglet
cards.fullText:
AND I'M THE CAPTAIN! While you have 2 or more
other characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Ahoy! There's lore out there, and I'm g-gonna
find it!”

cards.name: Agustin Madrigal
cards.flavorText:
Falling for Julieta was the easiest thing he'd ever
done.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
PERCEPTIVE PARTNER While you have a character
named Pascal in play, this character gains Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “Pascal! A new flower for the wall!”

cards.name: Alma Madrigal
cards.fullText:
TO THE TABLE When you play this character, you may
search your deck for a Madrigal character card and
reveal that card to all players. Shuffle your deck and put
that card on top of it.
cards.flavorText:
“Let's be clear, Abuela runs this show.”
—Mirabel

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
Singer 7 (This character counts as cost 7 to sing
songs.)
cards.flavorText:
“Watch and you'll see—some day I'll be part of
your world!”

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
Singer 9 (This character counts as cost 9 to sing
songs.)
BEAUTIFUL VOICE Whenever this character sings
a song, your other Princess characters get +1 ◊
this turn.

cards.name: Bruno Madrigal
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
YOU JUST HAVE TO SEE IT ⟳ — Name a card, then reveal
the top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put that
card into your hand and gain 3 lore. Otherwise, put it on
the top of your deck.

cards.name: Cogsworth
cards.fullText:

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.fullText:
Shift: Discard a character card (You may discard
a character card to play this on top of one of your
characters named Li Shang.)
LEAD THE CHARGE Your characters with 4 ¤ or
more get +1 ◊.

cards.name: Lumiere
cards.fullText: FERVENT ADDRESS Your other characters get +1 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“The invaders are at our gates, mes amis! It's time to
show them what we're made of.”

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mulan.)
STRAIGHT SHOOTER When you play this character, if you
used Shift to play her, she gets +3 ¤ this turn.
TRIPLE SHOT During your turn, whenever this character
deals damage to another character in a challenge, deal the
same amount of damage to up to 2 other chosen characters.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
TIME TO SHINE Whenever you play an action, this
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Ursula's messengers fled, leaving behind tendrils
of dark ink.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
BATTLE WOUND This character enters play with 2
damage.
cards.flavorText: She'll never give up.

cards.name: Namaari
cards.fullText:
TWO-WEAPON FIGHTING During your turn,
whenever this character deals damage to another
character in a challenge, you may deal the same
amount of damage to another chosen character.

cards.name: Nessus
cards.flavorText:
He sent the eels away when they came with the
sea witch's offer. He didn't need her help making
trouble.

cards.name: Noi
cards.fullText:
FANCY FOOTWORK Whenever you play an action,
this character takes no damage from challenges
this turn.
cards.flavorText: Fortune favors the bold—no matter how small.

cards.name: Pegasus
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“He zigs, he zags—what else do ya need?”
—Phil

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullText:
DON'T CROSS ME Whenever this character
challenges another character, gain 1 lore for each
other damaged character you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
“You're gonna fight an entire army?”
—Sisu

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullName: Raya - Guardian of the Dragon Gem
cards.fullText:
WE HAVE TO COME TOGETHER When you play this
character, ready chosen character of yours at a
location. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: “There are too many of them for me. But not for us.”

cards.name: Sisu
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
BRING ON THE HEAT! When you play this character,
banish chosen opposing character with 1 ¤ or less.
cards.flavorText: “Come on—what's the worst that can happen?”

cards.name: Sisu
cards.fullText:
SURGE OF POWER This character gets +1 ¤ for
each card in opponents' hands.
cards.flavorText:
Sometimes the only way to fight the unimaginable
is with the incredible.

cards.name: Sisu
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Sisu.)
I GOT THIS! When you play this character, banish
all opposing characters with 2 ¤ or less.

cards.name: Tong
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: “I too wish to join this fellowship of Druun butt-kickery.”

cards.name: Tuk Tuk
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
ON A ROLL When you play this character, you may
move him and one of your other characters to the
same location for free. The other character gets
+2 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: A Pirate's Life
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 6 or more may ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Each opponent loses 2 lore. You gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
Give me a career
As a buccaneer

cards.name: Be King Undisputed
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each opponent chooses and banishes one of their
characters.
cards.flavorText: Respected, saluted

cards.name: Brawl
cards.fullText: Banish chosen character with 2 ¤ or less.
cards.flavorText:
There are two ways to leave the Snuggly Duckling—
the door or the window.

cards.name: Imperial Proclamation
cards.fullText:
CALL TO THE FRONT Whenever one of your characters
challenges another character, you pay 1 ⬡ less for the next
character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“By order of the Emperor, one man from every family must
serve in the Imperial Army.”
—Chi Fu

cards.name: Medallion Weights
cards.fullText:
DISCIPLINE AND STRENGTH ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character
gets +2 ¤ this turn. Whenever they challenge another
character this turn, you may draw a card.

cards.name: The Plank
cards.fullText:
WALK! 2 ⬡, Banish this item — Choose one:
• Banish chosen Hero character.
• Ready chosen Villain character. They can't quest for
the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's a once-in-a-lifetime view.

cards.name: Vitalisphere
cards.fullText:
EXTRACT OF RUBY 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Rush and gets +2 ¤ this turn. (They
can challenge the turn they're played.)

cards.name: Snuggly Duckling
cards.fullText:
ROUTINE RUCKUS Whenever a character with 3 ¤ or more challenges
another character while here, gain 1 lore. If the challenging character
has 6 ¤ or more, gain 3 lore instead.

cards.name: Training Grounds
cards.fullText: STRENGTH OF MIND 1 ⬡ — Chosen character here gets +1 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
I WAS BORN READY If you have another Hero
character in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
After talking to Olaf, Anna marched into the
unexpected storm to save Kristoff.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
LET ME HELP YOU Whenever this character
quests, your other Hero characters get +1 ◊ this
turn.
cards.flavorText:
Make sure you know what's truly important and be
willing to fight for it.

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
THE GIRL WHO HAS EVERYTHING While you have
more items in play than each opponent, this
character gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Aurora
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Aurora.)
PRESERVER Opponents can't choose your items for abilities
or effects.
ROYAL INVENTORY ⟳ one of your items — Look at the top
card of your deck and put it on either the top or the bottom
of your deck.

cards.name: Aurora
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
Her music fills the Illuminary's gardens with joy
and light.

cards.name: Dang Hu
cards.fullText:
YOU BETTER TALK FAST Your other Villain characters
gain Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText: You can find villainy in the most unexpected places.

cards.name: Fa Li
cards.flavorText:
When far from home, Mulan often thinks of her
calming presence.

cards.name: Flounder
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
I'M NOT A GUPPY If you have a character named Ariel in
play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
cards.flavorText: “Ariel, Ariel! You won't believe what I found!”

cards.name: Hades
cards.flavorText:
“This neat little scheme has Ursula's tentacles all
over it. That sneaky sea witch...Wait! I can use
this. She can keep those obnoxious Illumineers
busy while I roll out my own plan.”

cards.name: Hans
cards.fullText:
ROYAL SCHEMES When you play this character, if a
Princess or Queen character is in play, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
Hans was confident he could bring Anna to Ursula—
all he needed was something of Kristoff's to lure
her in.

cards.name: Iduna
cards.fullText:
ENDURING LOVE When this character is banished,
you may put this card into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“Come my darling, homeward bound
When all is lost, then all is found.”

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullName: John Silver - Terror of the Realm
cards.flavorText:
“Strange things be at the edge of the map: sea
witches, entangled glimmers, and whatnot. I'll stay
with me ship, thank you.”

cards.name: Olaf
cards.fullText:
Shift: Discard an item card (You may discard
an item card to play this on top of one of your
characters named Olaf.)
CARROTS ALL AROUND! Whenever he quests, each
of your other characters gets +¤ equal to this
character's ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Olaf
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“Isn't this Kristoff's hat? If he went this way, he'll
be caught in that storm!”

cards.name: Pascal
cards.fullText:
COLORFUL TACTICS When you play this character,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them
back in any order.
cards.flavorText:
If you want to find something hidden, get someone
who's an expert at hiding.

cards.name: Prince Phillip
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
BEST DEFENSE Whenever one of your characters
is chosen for Support, they gain Resist +1 this
turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
PERCEPTIVE PARTNER While you have a character
named Pascal in play, this character gains
Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “Pascal! A new flower for the wall!”

cards.name: Scuttle
cards.fullText:
LET ME SEE When you play this character, look at
the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an
item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest
on the bottom of your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText: “Wow. This is special. This is very, very unusual.”

cards.name: Sisu
cards.flavorText:
“It may feel impossible, but sometimes, you just
have to take the first step, even before you're
ready.”

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
CONSULT THE SPELLBOOK ⟳ — Look at the top 4
cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card
and put it into your hand. If that item costs 3 or
less, you may play it for free instead and it enters
play exerted. Put the rest on the bottom of your
deck in any order.

cards.name: Transformed Chef
cards.fullText:
A CULINARY MASTERPIECE When you play this
character, remove up to 2 damage from chosen
character.
cards.flavorText:
“A good, hot meal will set you right as rain.”
—Mrs. Potts

cards.name: Triton
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Triton.)
IMPOSING PRESENCE Opposing characters get -1 ¤
for each location you have in play.

cards.name: Triton
cards.fullText:
CONSIGN TO THE DEPTHS ⟳, Banish one of your
items — Gain 3 lore.
cards.flavorText: “If this is the only way, so be it.”

cards.name: Triton
cards.fullText:
SUPERIOR SWIMMER During your turn, this
character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
KEEPER OF ATLANTICA Whenever one of your
locations is banished, you may put that card into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Tuk Tuk
cards.flavorText:
“Some say he's easily distracted. They're not
wrong...”
—Raya

cards.name: Dig a Little Deeper
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 8 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 8 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your
hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any
order.

cards.name: Glean
cards.fullText: Banish chosen item. Its player gains 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“This could be just the thing I need to get my invention
working.”

cards.name: Seldom All They Seem
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gets -3 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
I know you
I walked with you once upon a dream

cards.name: Treasures Untold
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 6 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Return up to 2 item cards from your discard into your
hand.
cards.flavorText: How many wonders can one cavern hold?

cards.name: Field of Ice
cards.fullText:
ICY DEFENSE Whenever you play a character, they gain
Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Great Stone Dragon
cards.fullText:
ASLEEP This item enters play exerted.
AWAKEN ⟳ — Put a character card from your discard
into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Ice Block
cards.fullText: CHILLY LABOR ⟳ — Chosen character gets -1 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Frozen ink can be harvested and processed to many useful
ends.

cards.name: Ariel's Grotto
cards.fullText:
TREASURE TROVE While you have 3 or more items in play, this location
gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Winter Camp
cards.fullText:
HELP THE WOUNDED Whenever a character quests while here, remove
up to 2 damage from them. If they're a Hero character, remove up to
4 damage instead.

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Shift: Discard a location card (You may discard
a location card to play this on top of one of your
characters named Aladdin.)
CRASHING THROUGH Whenever this character
quests, you may banish chosen item.

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.flavorText:
“How about we cut to the part where I make a
quick escape and you yell after me? No? Can't say
I didn't give you a chance.”

cards.name: Arges
cards.flavorText:
“Looks like you got some big feelings there,
buddy—let's stomp 'em out!”
—Hades

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
I WANT MORE Whenever you play a song, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: Everything she's ever wanted is almost in reach.

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Ariel.)
AMPLIFIED VOICE Whenever you play a song,
you may pay 2 ⬡ to deal 3 damage to chosen
character.

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: He's even tougher than he looks.

cards.name: Chi-Fu
cards.fullText:
OVERLY CAUTIOUS While this character has no
damage, he gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“You, there! Keep that fighting away from here! It
is imperative that I write to the Emperor.”

cards.name: Chien-Po
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
BOARDING PARTY During your turn, whenever
this character banishes a character in a challenge,
your other characters get +1 ◊ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Nobody stands a chance against the daring duck
of the high seas!

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)

cards.name: LeFou
cards.fullText:
I LEARNED FROM THE BEST During your turn, you
may play this character for free if an opposing
character was banished in a challenge this turn.

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.flavorText:
Immovable as a mountain and fierce as a dragon—
the Empire's finest warrior.

cards.name: Ling
cards.fullText: FULL OF SPIRIT Your Hero characters get +1 ¤.
cards.flavorText: A good friend is handy in a fight.

cards.name: Luisa Madrigal
cards.fullName: Luisa Madrigal - Rock of the Family
cards.fullText:
I'M THE STRONG ONE While you have another
character in play, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
There's no way Ursula's creatures are getting to
that donkey.

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
WINGED FOR A DAY During your turn, this
character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
It spends its days keeping the treasured glimmers
in the Hall of Lorcana sparkling clean.

cards.name: Magic Broom
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
ARMY OF BROOMS This character gets +2 ¤ for
each other character named Magic Broom you
have in play.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mickey Mouse.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
SWEEP AWAY When you play this character, deal damage to
chosen character equal to the number of Broom characters
you have in play.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
STAND STRONG When you play this character,
chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText:
He sets the standard for intrepid adventurers
everywhere.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.flavorText:
“Maybe what I really wanted was to prove I could
do things right, so when I looked in the mirror, I'd
see someone worthwhile.”

cards.name: Philoctetes
cards.fullText:
YOU GOTTA STAY FOCUSED Your Hero characters
gain Challenger +1. (They get +1 ¤ while
challenging.)
SHAMELESS PROMOTER Whenever you play a
Hero character, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Piglet
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
NOT SO SMALL ANYMORE While you have no cards
in your hand, this character can challenge ready
characters.

cards.name: Rajah
cards.fullText:
STEADY GAZE While you have no cards in
your hand, characters with cost 4 or less can't
challenge this character.
cards.flavorText: As regal as his namesake and just as powerful.

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 ¤.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
YOU GAVE IT YOUR BEST During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge, you
may draw a card.

cards.name: Yao
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“I'm gonna hit you so hard, it'll make your
ancestors dizzy.”

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.fullText:
Deal 1 damage to each opposing character. You may
banish chosen location.
cards.flavorText: A little snow never hurt anyone. That big rock, however...

cards.name: I Find 'Em, I Flatten 'Em
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish all items.
cards.flavorText:
I don't ask how hard the work is
Got a rough, indestructible surface

cards.name: One Last Hope
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. If a Hero character is chosen, they may also
challenge ready characters this turn. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: The Mob Song
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 10 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 10 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Deal 3 damage to up to 3 chosen characters and/or
locations.

cards.name: Triton's Decree
cards.fullText:
Each opponent chooses one of their characters and
deals 2 damage to them.
cards.flavorText:
“Ursula's foul creatures are not welcome in my
kingdom!”

cards.name: Fortisphere
cards.fullText:
RESOURCEFUL When you play this item, you may draw a card.
EXTRACT OF STEEL 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen character
of yours gains Bodyguard until the start of your next turn.
(An opposing character who challenges one of your characters
must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

cards.name: Imperial Bow
cards.fullText:
WITHIN RANGE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen Hero character
gains Challenger +2 and Evasive this turn. (They
get +2 ¤ while challenging. They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: RLS Legacy's Cannon
cards.fullText:
BA-BOOM! ⟳, 2 ⬡, Discard a card — Deal 2 damage
to chosen character or location.
cards.flavorText:
“So help me, I'll use the ship's cannons to blast ya all to
kingdom come!”
—John Silver

cards.name: The Wall
cards.fullText:
PROTECT THE REALM While you have an exerted character here, your
other locations can't be challenged.

cards.name: Thebes
cards.fullText:
IF YOU CAN MAKE IT HERE... During your turn, whenever a character
banishes another character in a challenge while here, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
Singer 9 (This character counts as cost 9 to sing
songs.)
BEAUTIFUL VOICE Whenever this character sings
a song, your other Princess characters get +1 ◊
this turn.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
DRAMATIC ENTRANCE When you play this character,
banish chosen opposing character with 5 ¤ or more.

cards.name: Look at This Family
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 7 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal up
to 2 character cards and put them into your hand. Put the
rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Ursula.)
NOW I AM THE RULER! Whenever this character
quests, exert chosen character.
YOU'LL LISTEN TO ME! Other characters can't
exert to sing songs.

cards.name: Yen Sid
cards.fullText:
TIMELY INTERVENTION When you play this
character, if you have a character named Magic
Broom in play, you may draw a card.
ARCANE STUDY While you have 2 or more Broom
characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Second Star to the Right
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 10 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 10 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen player draws 5 cards.

cards.name: Diablo
cards.fullText:
Shift: Discard an action card (You may discard an action card
to play this on top of one of your characters named Diablo.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
CIRCLE FAR AND WIDE During each opponent's turn,
whenever they draw a card while this character is exerted,
you may draw a card.

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
CUNNING MANEUVER When you play this
character and whenever she's challenged, each
opponent chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: We Don't Talk About Bruno
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Return chosen character to their player's hand, then that
player discards a card at random.

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
SUPER PEANUT POWERS Whenever this character
challenges another character, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Sisu
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Sisu.)
I GOT THIS! When you play this character, banish
all opposing characters with 2 ¤ or less.

cards.name: Snuggly Duckling
cards.fullText:
ROUTINE RUCKUS Whenever a character with 3 ¤ or more challenges
another character while here, gain 1 lore. If the challenging character
has 6 ¤ or more, gain 3 lore instead.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
LET ME HELP YOU Whenever this character
quests, your other Hero characters get +1 ◊ this
turn.

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
CONSULT THE SPELLBOOK ⟳ — Look at the top 4
cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card
and put it into your hand. If that item costs 3 or
less, you may play it for free instead and it enters
play exerted. Put the rest on the bottom of your
deck in any order.

cards.name: Ariel's Grotto
cards.fullText:
TREASURE TROVE While you have 3 or more items in play, this location
gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Ariel.)
AMPLIFIED VOICE Whenever you play a song,
you may pay 2 ⬡ to deal 3 damage to chosen
character.

cards.name: Piglet
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
NOT SO SMALL ANYMORE While you have no cards
in your hand, this character can challenge ready
characters.

cards.name: The Wall
cards.fullText:
PROTECT THE REALM While you have an exerted character here, your
other locations can't be challenged.

cards.name: Yen Sid
cards.fullText:
TIMELY INTERVENTION When you play this
character, if you have a character named Magic
Broom in play, you may draw a card.
ARCANE STUDY While you have 2 or more Broom
characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mulan.)
STRAIGHT SHOOTER When you play this character, if you
used Shift to play her, she gets +3 ¤ this turn.
TRIPLE SHOT During your turn, whenever this character
deals damage to another character in a challenge, deal the
same amount of damage to up to 2 other chosen characters.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mickey Mouse.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
SWEEP AWAY When you play this character, deal damage to
chosen character equal to the number of Broom characters
you have in play.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Ah, royalty! So pretty. So naive. So utterly
impressionable.”
—Ursula

cards.name: Bruno Madrigal
cards.fullText:
DARK PROPHECY When you play this character, each

one of your characters named Robin Hood.)
