opposing damaged character in play.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
MOTHER KNOWS BEST When you play this
character, you may pay 3 ⬡ to return chosen
character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“A beautiful lady never stands meekly at the back
of the line.”

cards.name: Clarabelle
cards.fullText:
ONE STEP BEHIND When you play this character,
if an opponent has more cards in their hand than
you, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “Golly! Those dancers can really moo-ve!”

cards.name: Shenzi
cards.fullText:
STICK AROUND FOR DINNER This character gets +1 ¤
for each other Hyena character you have in play.
WHAT HAVE WE GOT HERE? Whenever one of your
Hyena characters challenges a damaged character,
gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Mother Gothel.)
THE WORLD IS DARK When you play this
character, each opponent chooses one of their
characters and returns that card to their hand.

cards.name: Scar
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
LIFE'S NOT FAIR, IS IT? Whenever one of your
characters challenges a damaged character, you
may draw a card.

cards.name: Hypnotic Deduction
cards.fullText:
Draw 3 cards, then put 2 cards from your hand on the
top of your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText:
“A security device! Easily defeated, of course. Once I
make room for the crown, I...can...bring...it...
to...him.”

cards.name: Night Howler Rage
cards.fullText:
Draw a card. Chosen character gains Reckless during their
next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“I think someone is targeting predators on purpose and
making them go savage!”
—Judy Hopps

cards.name: You're Welcome
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Shuffle chosen character, item, or location into their
player's deck. That player draws 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: I make everything happen!

cards.name: Remember Who You Are
cards.fullText:
If chosen opponent has more cards in their hand than
you, draw cards until you have the same number.

cards.name: Prince John's Mirror
cards.fullText:
YOU LOOK REGAL If you have a character named Prince
John in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this item.
A FEELING OF POWER At the end of each opponent's
turn, if they have more than 3 cards in their hand, they
discard until they have 3 cards in their hand.

cards.name: Obscurosphere
cards.fullText:
EXTRACT OF EMERALD 2 ⬡, Banish this item — Your
characters gain Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Emerald Chromicon
cards.fullText:
EMERALD LIGHT During opponents' turns, whenever
one of your characters is banished, you may return
chosen character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Trust in the winds of change.”
—Inscription

cards.name: Sherwood Forest
cards.fullText:
FOREST HOME Your characters named Robin Hood may move here for free.
FAMILIAR TERRAIN Characters gain Ward and “⟳, 1 ⬡ — Deal 2 damage to chosen
damaged character” while here. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Tropical Rainforest
cards.fullText:
SNACK TIME Opposing damaged characters gain Reckless. (They can't
quest and must challenge if able.)

cards.name: Taffyta Muttonfudge
cards.flavorText:
“There's not a glimmer that can keep up with me.
You might as well quit now.”

cards.name: Wreck-It Ralph
cards.fullText:
REFRESHING BREAK Whenever you ready this
character, gain 1 lore for each 1 damage on him.

cards.name: Maximus
cards.fullText:
ROYALLY BIG REWARDS At the end of your turn, if
you have any characters in play with 5 ¤ or more,
gain 2 lore. If you have any in play with 10 ¤ or
more, gain 5 lore instead.
cards.flavorText:
It's easy to get carried away when it comes to
tug-of-war.

cards.name: Turbo
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
GAME JUMP This character also counts as being
named King Candy for Shift.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Donald Duck.)
HUMBLE PIE When you play this character, if you used Shift
to play him, each opponent loses 2 lore.
RAGING DUCK While an opponent has 10 or more lore, this
character gets +6 ¤.

cards.name: Rancis Fluggerbutter
cards.flavorText:
Ingredients: Butter, sugar, unsweetened chocolate,
vanilla, and arrogance.

cards.name: Scar
cards.fullText:
LONG LIVE THE KING When you play this
character, you may banish chosen character
named Mufasa.
cards.flavorText:
The second Rule of Villainy: Never settle for
second place.

cards.name: Snowanna Rainbeau
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText: When it comes to racing, she never gets cold feet.

cards.name: Daisy Duck
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: She has an unblemished record.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
PERFECT PARTNERS While you have a character
named Minnie Mouse in play, this character gets
+2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
He loves to share the spotlight with a star like
Minnie.

cards.name: Ratigan
cards.fullText:
NOTHING CAN STAND IN MY WAY While this
character has damage, he gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“The world's most diabolical genius should never
suffer such indignities!”

cards.name: Taffyta Muttonfudge
cards.fullText:
SHOWSTOPPER When you play this character,
if you have a location in play, each opponent
loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Never lose sight of where you're going. Second
place.”

cards.name: Denahi
cards.flavorText:
“You'll pay for what you've done! I'll track you all
the way to the Azurite Sea if I have to!”

cards.name: Pete
cards.fullText:
SCRAM! When you play this character, if you
have another character named Pete in play, you
may banish chosen opposing character.

cards.name: Taffyta Muttonfudge
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Taffyta
Muttonfudge.)
NEW ROSTER Once per turn, when this character
moves to a location, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullText:
MY GREATEST PERFORMANCE Whenever this
character quests, look at the top 4 cards of your
deck. You may reveal an action card with cost 6
or less and play it for free. Put the rest in your
discard.

cards.name: Gaston
cards.fullText:
A MAN AMONG MEN! For each damaged character
you have in play, you pay 2 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)

cards.name: Pete
cards.flavorText:
His half-baked scheme to whisk away the food
almost worked. But in the end, he got his just
desserts.

cards.name: Arthur
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“Hold it, boy. Not so fast.”
—Merlin

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
PLUCKY PLAY Whenever this character challenges
another character, each opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: He keeps his eye on the prize.

cards.name: Ratigan
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Ratigan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
DELIGHTFULLY WICKED Your damaged characters get +2 ¤.

cards.name: Vanellope von Schweetz
cards.fullName: Vanellope von Schweetz - Random Roster Racer
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
PIXLEXIA When you play this character, she gains
Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
I LAUGH IN THE FACE OF DANGER When you play
this character, chosen character gets +2 ¤ this
turn.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
DANCE-OFF Whenever this character or one of
your characters named Mickey Mouse challenges
another character, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
She doesn't seek the spotlight—the spotlight seeks
her.

cards.name: Break Free
cards.fullText:
Deal 1 damage to chosen character of yours. They gain
Rush and get +1 ¤ this turn. (They can challenge the
turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
Tink darted from the shattered lantern in the blink of
an eye.

cards.name: Evil Comes Prepared
cards.fullText:
Ready chosen character of yours. They can't quest for
the rest of this turn. If a Villain character is chosen,
gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Don't Let the Frostbite Bite
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 7 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Ready all your characters. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.
cards.flavorText: Let's call it a night

cards.name: Glimmer vs Glimmer
cards.fullText:
Banish chosen character of yours to banish chosen
character.
cards.flavorText:
Hades: “Listen, kid. If I'm gettin' banished back to the
lorebook, you're going with me.”
Hercules: “We'll see about that.”

cards.name: Who's With Me?
cards.fullText:
Your characters get +2 ¤ this turn.
Whenever one of your characters with Reckless
challenges another character this turn, gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText: “Don't forget, the purple unicorn is mine!”

cards.name: Potion of Might
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
VILE CONCOCTION 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen
character gets +3 ¤ this turn. If a Villain character is
chosen, they get +4 ¤ instead.

cards.name: The Sword Released
cards.fullText:
POWER APPOINTED At the start of your turn, if you
have a character in play with more ¤ than each
opposing character in play, each opponent loses 1 lore
and you gain lore equal to the lore lost.

cards.name: Ruby Chromicon
cards.fullText:
RUBY LIGHT ⟳ — Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this
turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Leave fear behind.”
—Inscription

cards.name: Sugar Rush Speedway
cards.fullText:
ON YOUR MARKS! Once per turn, you may ⟳ chosen character here and
deal them 1 damage to move them to another location for free.

cards.name: Ratigan's Party
cards.fullText:
MISFITS' REVELRY While you have a damaged character here, this
location gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: King Candy
cards.flavorText:
“My sweet subjects, I can without a pinch of
hesitation assure you that I have never been so
happy.”

cards.name: Chaca
cards.flavorText: “Look, look! My tooth is even looser today!”

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
She'd seen what the ink could do for other
glimmers. What could it do for her?

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.flavorText:
“The secret room should be right here! Ach, I
cannot believe I paid a whole penny for this map.”

cards.name: Prince John
cards.fullText:
TAXES NEVER FAIL ME Whenever you play an item,
this character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Of course I'm on the list. Check under ‘PJ.’”

cards.name: Merlin
cards.fullText:
LONG LIVE THE KING! Your characters named
Arthur gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“A little rest and relaxation will do wonders for
your health, boy.”

cards.name: Pacha
cards.fullText:
HELPFUL SUPPLIES At the start of your turn, if you
have an item in play, gain 1 lore.
PERFECT DIRECTIONS At the start of your turn, if
you have a location in play, gain 1 lore.

characters named The Queen.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
REFLECTIONS OF VANITY For each other character named
The Queen you have in play, this character gets +1 ◊.

cards.name: Sheriff of Nottingham
cards.fullText:
EVERY LITTLE BIT HELPS For each item you have in
play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Chicha
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
ONE ON THE WAY During your turn, when you put a card
into your inkwell, if it's the second card you've put into
your inkwell this turn, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Prince John
cards.fullText:
BEAUTIFUL, LOVELY TAXES ⟳ — Play an item from
your hand or discard with cost 5 or less for free,
exerted.
cards.flavorText: A villainous schemer from day to night.

cards.name: The Queen
cards.fullName: The Queen - Crown of the Council
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
GATHERER OF THE WICKED When you play this character,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal any
number of character cards named The Queen and put them
into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.

cards.name: Kuzco
cards.fullText:
OUTPLACEMENT When you play this character, you
may put chosen item or location into its player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
BY INVITE ONLY 4 ⬡ — Your other characters gain
Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Mufasa
cards.fullText:
A DELICATE BALANCE When you play this character,
exert all cards in your inkwell, then return 2 cards at
random from your inkwell to your hand.
EVERYTHING THE LIGHT TOUCHES Whenever this
character quests, ready all cards in your inkwell.

cards.name: Ludwig Von Drake
cards.flavorText:
“So you see, there's a dark void at the edge of
Lorcana. A complete absence of electromagnetic
radiation! What's it made of? I don't know! The
light's just gone. Kaput!”

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
CAKE CATAPULT When you play this character,
chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: This puts the Frosting Flinger 2000 to shame.

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“This case is as good as solved!”
—Basil

cards.name: King Candy
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named King Candy.)
CHANGING THE CODE When you play this
character, you may draw 2 cards, then put a card
from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
BAFFLING MYSTERY When you play this character,
you may put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“There's just gotta be one of those chromi-thingies
around here somewhere!”

cards.name: Tanana
cards.fullText:
YOUR BROTHERS NEED GUIDANCE When you play
this character, you may remove up to 1 damage
from chosen character or location.

cards.name: Tipo
cards.fullText:
MEASURE ME AGAIN When you play this
character, you may put a card from your hand into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “Mom, Mom! I think I'm still growing!”

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
USHERED INTO THE PARTY When you play this
character, your other characters gain Ward until
the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Merlin
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Merlin.)
OVERDEVELOPED BRAIN When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play him, you may search your deck
for any card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle
your deck.

cards.name: Vision of the Future
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put one into your
hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any
order.
cards.flavorText:
“We must repair the Illuminary before it's too late. And
we'll need these devices, these chromicons, to fix it.”

cards.name: Royal Tantrum
cards.fullText:
Banish any number of your items, then draw a card for
each item banished this way.
cards.flavorText: “I am King! King! King!”

cards.name: Ever as Before
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Remove up to 2 damage from any number of chosen
characters.
cards.flavorText:
Ever just as sure
As the sun will rise

cards.name: Hide Away
cards.fullText:
Put chosen item or location into its player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Fauna: “Oh my! We dropped some...”
Merryweather: “You mean you dropped some!”

cards.name: All Funned Out
cards.fullText:
Put chosen character of yours into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “Pretty pathetic, huh?”

cards.name: Medal of Heroes
cards.fullText:
CONGRATULATIONS, SOLDIER ⟳, 2 ⬡, Banish this item
— Chosen character of yours gets +2 ◊ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“You have etched in the rock of virtue a legacy beyond
compare.”
—General Hologram

cards.name: Basil's Magnifying Glass
cards.fullText:
FIND WHAT'S HIDDEN ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Look at the top 3
cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card and
put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.
cards.flavorText: “I say, a piece of the Hexwell Crown!” —Basil

cards.name: Merlin's Carpetbag
cards.fullText:
HOCKETY POCKETY ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Return an item card
from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“What a way to pack!”
—Arthur

cards.name: Sapphire Chromicon
cards.fullText:
POWERING UP This item enters play exerted.
SAPPHIRE LIGHT ⟳, 2 ⬡, Banish one of your items —
Gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Knowledge is eternal.”
—Inscription

cards.name: The Great Illuminary
cards.fullText: WARM WELCOME Characters with Support get +1 ◊ and +2 ⛉ while here.
cards.flavorText: Every surface glows with the joy of celebration.

cards.name: Merlin's Cottage
cards.fullText:
KNOWLEDGE IS POWER Each player plays with the top card of their deck
face up.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
HEAVE HO! When you play this character, you
may deal 2 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
He's not the biggest glimmer on the team, but he
still packs a wallop.

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
Challenger +7 (While challenging, this character
gets +7 ¤.)
INTIMIDATING GAZE Opposing characters with
cost 4 or less can't challenge.
cards.flavorText: “No one will keep me from the broken crown!”

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
FACE THE PAST During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “This is my kingdom. If I don't fight for it, who will?”

cards.name: Rudy
cards.flavorText:
“The Illuminary can't handle this much groove!
We have to keep the noise down or it'll fall apart
for sure!”

cards.name: Royal Guard
cards.flavorText: “Hey, I've been turned into a cow. Can I go home?”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: Underestimating him is a recipe for disaster.

cards.name: Sleepy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)

cards.name: Kronk
cards.fullText:
Challenger +1 (While challenging, this character
gets +1 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“Maybe this one's a chromicon. Probably not.
I really should have paid more attention when
that wizard guy was talking...”

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText: Who's the “boat snack” now?!

cards.name: Sneezy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
HEADWIND When you play this character, chosen
Knight character gains Challenger +2 this turn.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Dopey
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
STRONGER TOGETHER When you play this
character, if you have another Knight character in
play, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character
or location.

cards.name: Namaari
cards.fullText:
I DON'T HAVE ANY OTHER CHOICE For each
opposing character banished in a challenge this
turn, you pay 2 ⬡ less to play this character.
Resist +3 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 3.)

cards.name: Snow White
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
NATURAL LEADER This character gains Resist +1
for each other Knight character you have in play.
(Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1 for
each other Knight.)
cards.flavorText: Friendship is the best armor of all.

cards.name: Yzma
cards.fullText:
I'M WARNING YOU! During your turn, whenever
one of your characters banishes another character
in a challenge, you may deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
cards.flavorText:
“What do you mean, ‘not on the list’?! I told you to
always put me on the list!”

cards.name: Kronk
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Kronk.)
ARE YOU ON THE LIST? During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge, you
may play a character with cost 5 or less for free.

cards.name: Grumpy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
BOON OF RESILIENCE While one of your Knight
characters is at a location, that character gains Resist
+2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
BURST OF SPEED During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Pete
cards.fullText:
RE-PETE ⟳ – Reveal the top card of your deck.
If it's a character card named Pete, you may play
it for free.
cards.flavorText: He'll have you seeing double.

cards.name: Sir Ector
cards.flavorText:
“Well, by Jove. Don't just stand there. Raise a
glass to my son Kay...and may we be rid of the
trickster wizard Marvin, or whatever his blasted
name was.”

cards.name: Bashful
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
IMPRESS THE PRINCESS While you have a
character named Snow White in play, this
character gains Bodyguard. (An opposing
character who challenges one of your characters
must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

cards.name: Arthur
cards.flavorText:
“That boy's got real spark. Lots of spirit. Throws
himself heart and soul into everything he does.”
—Merlin

cards.name: Happy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
BURST OF SPEED During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)

cards.name: Simba
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Simba.)
FEARSOME ROAR When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item or location.

cards.name: Doc
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
DRASTIC MEASURES When you play this
character, you may discard your hand to draw
2 cards.

cards.name: Arthur
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Arthur.)
KNIGHTED BY THE KING When you play this character,
chosen character gains Challenger +2 and Resist +2 and can
challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while
challenging. Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Pete
cards.fullText:
BLOW THE WHISTLE When you play this character,
opponents can't play actions until the start of
your next turn.
cards.flavorText: “It ain't cheatin' if you're the one makin' the rules.”

cards.name: Tug-of-War
cards.fullText:
Choose one:
• Deal 1 damage to each opposing character without Evasive.
• Deal 3 damage to each opposing character with Evasive.

cards.name: When Will My Life Begin?
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character can't challenge during their next
turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Stuck in the same place I've always been...

cards.name: Duck for Cover!
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Resist +1 and Evasive this
turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1. They can
challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Food Fight!
cards.fullText:
Your characters gain “⟳, 1 ⬡ — Deal 1 damage to chosen
character” this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Gawrsh, who ordered the...upside-down CAA-AA-AKE?”

opponent choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: “You're going to love this!”

cards.name: Fred
cards.fullText:
HOW COOL IS THAT Whenever this character is
challenged, gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText: “...but by night...I am also a school mascot.”

cards.name: Tootles
cards.flavorText:
Every Lost Boy has a favorite hiding spot. Tootles
has twelve.

cards.name: Dawson
cards.flavorText:
“By Jove, he must be around here somewhere.
Basil! Basil! Shout if—aaahhh!”

cards.name: Heathcliff
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
Loyal butler, training target, helicopter pilot—and
completely unflappable.

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Hmm. Footprints from a large...owl? With
droplets of water? Clearly some avian menace
has crossed the Azurite Sea and absconded with
the crown!”

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
CAPTAIN ON DECK While you have a Captain
character in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“A promotion! It's about time someone recognized
my natural leadership skills!”

cards.name: Daisy Duck
cards.fullText:
DISTANT SHORES Whenever one of your Pirate
characters quests while at a location, draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“The answers we're looking for are on the other
side of that maze, I just know it!”

cards.name: Mertle Edmonds
cards.flavorText: “Get out of my way before I run you over.”

cards.name: Prince Phillip
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
A clear head and a calm hand will see you through
uncharted waters.

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Jasmine.)
RULER OF THE SEAS When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play her, return all other
exerted characters to their players' hands.

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
LOOK INNOCENT This character enters play exerted.
CAN'T TAKE A JOKE? While this character is exerted,
each opposing player can't gain lore unless one of
their characters has challenged this turn.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
STRONG LIKE HIS DAD 3 ⬡ — Deal 1 damage to
chosen damaged character.

cards.name: Alistair Krei
cards.fullText:
AN EYE FOR TECH When you play this character,
if an opponent has an item in play, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Sleek yet strong...These inkrunners are an
extraordinary feat of engineering.”

cards.name: Gazelle
cards.fullText:
YOU CAN REALLY MOVE When you play this
character, chosen character gains Evasive until
the start of your next turn. (Only characters with
Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
CLEVER DESIGN Whenever this character quests,
chosen character gains Ward until the start of
your next turn.

cards.name: Bellwether
cards.fullText:
FEAR ALWAYS WORKS During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, chosen opposing
character gains Reckless during their next turn.
(They can't quest and must challenge if able.)

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Basil.)
TWISTS AND TURNS During your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, you may pay 1 ⬡ to
have chosen opponent choose and discard a card.

cards.name: Olivia Flaversham
cards.flavorText:
She had searched high and low in the Illuminary
for any hint of Basil. Instead, she found something
completely unexpected...

cards.name: Bend to My Will
cards.fullText: Each opponent discards all cards in their hand.
cards.flavorText: “At last! This is where your luck runs out!”

cards.name: Prepare to Board!
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gets +2 ¤ this turn. If a Pirate
character is chosen, they get +3 ¤ instead.
cards.flavorText:
“Bring me the treasure, bring me that ship, and bring
me Peter Pan!”
—Captain Hook

cards.name: Heffalumps and Woozles
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen opposing character can't quest during their
next turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: If honey's what you covet, you'll find that they love it

cards.name: Mosquito Bite
cards.fullText: Put 1 damage counter on chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Don't move. A mosquito has chosen me as her perch.
She's so...beautiful.”

cards.name: You Came Back
cards.fullText: Ready chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Nobody gets left behind.”
—Stitch

cards.name: MegaBot
cards.fullText:
HAPPY FACE This item enters play exerted.
DESTROY! ⟳, Banish this item — Choose one:
• Banish chosen item.
• Banish chosen damaged character.

cards.name: Galactic Communicator
cards.fullText:
RESOURCE ALLOCATION 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Return
chosen character with 2 ¤ or less to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText: The best way to keep in touch with those you're looking for.

cards.name: Transport Pod
cards.fullText:
GIVE 'EM A SHOW At the start of your turn, you may
move a character of yours to a location for free.
cards.flavorText:
“We've reinvented the very concept of transportation.”
—Alistair Krei

cards.name: Perilous Maze
cards.fullText:
LOST IN THE WAVES Whenever a character is challenged while here, each
opponent chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: Owl Island
cards.fullText:
TEAMWORK For each character you have here, you pay 1 ⬡ less for the first
action you play each turn.
A LOT TO LEARN Whenever you play a second action in a turn, gain 3 lore.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
MARINER'S MIGHT Whenever this character
quests, chosen Pirate character gets +2 ¤ and
gains “This character takes no damage from
challenges” this turn.

cards.name: Kakamora
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
Moana: “Do you think they saw us?”
Maui: “They saw us.”

cards.name: Kakamora
cards.fullText:
DIZZYING SPEED When you play this character,
chosen Pirate character gains Evasive until the
start of your next turn. (Only characters with
Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
YOU'LL NEVER MISS IT Whenever this character
quests, each opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
Even the smallest mouse can make the biggest
difference.

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullText:
COME ON, LET'S DO THIS Once during your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may
ready another chosen character of yours. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Wendy Darling
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
LOOK LIVELY, CREW! While you have another
Pirate character in play, this character gets +1 ¤
and +1 ◊.

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullText:
CHART YOUR OWN COURSE Whenever this
character quests, you may deal 1 damage to
another chosen character of yours. If you do,
ready that character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.

cards.name: Vanellope von Schweetz
cards.fullText:
AS READY AS I'LL EVER BE At the start of your turn,
if this character is at a location, draw a card and
gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: “Almost got it!”

cards.name: Michael Darling
cards.flavorText:
“Hoist the colors! Prepare to fight! Teddy bear at
the ready!”

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.flavorText:
Finding your way through the Azurite Sea takes a
stout heart, plenty of courage, and more than a
little luck.

cards.name: Markowski
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “Just what we needed—a new place to fight bugs.”

cards.name: Abu
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“Port, Abu! Port! To the left! ABU! The other way!”
—Aladdin

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
SOLID GROUND While this character is at a
location, he gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“Golly, this looked a lot easier from the ship. But I
know I can make it—the crew is counting on me!”

cards.name: Adorabeezle Winterpop
cards.fullText:
KEEP DRIVING While this character has damage,
she gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“It'll take more than that to knock me out of the
race!”

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
LEARNING THE ROPES This character can't challenge
unless you have a Captain character in play.
cards.flavorText:
“You wanna tell me I don't know what I'm doing? I
know I don't!”

cards.name: John Darling
cards.flavorText: “Get ready, Michael! Here they come!”

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Aladdin.)
REMEMBER YOUR TRAINING When you play this
character, your characters get +2 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
LAND, HO! Once during your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, you may return a
location card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
Minnie leaned forward. Could it be true? Was this
the island at last?

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Moana.)
GATHERING FORCES When you play this
character, you may move any number of your
characters to the same location for free. Gain 1
lore for each character you moved.

cards.name: Pete
cards.flavorText:
Pete was always looking for trouble. Now he was
finally getting paid for it.

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “Hold on to yer hat!”

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
CHEEEEHOOOO! Whenever this character challenges
another character, you may return an action card from
your discard to your hand.
WAYFINDING Whenever you play an action, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Hades
cards.fullText:
WHAT ARE YOU GONNA DO? ⟳, 3 ⬡, Banish one
of your characters — Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “Panic, use your head for once!”

cards.name: Tigger
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SWASH YOUR BUCKLES Whenever you play an
action, this character gets +1 ¤ and +1 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Scar
cards.fullText:
TEETH AND AMBITIONS When you play this
character, deal 2 damage to chosen character of
yours to deal 2 damage to another chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“It's for the greater good. I'm sure you understand.”
—Scar

cards.name: Thievery
cards.fullText: Chosen opponent loses 1 lore. Gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
Apples, gems, magic lamp ...Abu's not picky as long
as there's something worth stealing.

cards.name: Lead the Way
cards.fullText: Your characters get +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“We have what it takes to find our way through this
maze, together! Hold on—we're going in!”

cards.name: The Islands I Pulled from the Sea
cards.fullName: The Islands I Pulled from the Sea
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Search your deck for a location card, reveal that card to all
players, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.flavorText: So what can I say except...you're welcome

cards.name: Energy Blast
cards.fullText: Banish chosen character. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Did you really think I would fight fair?”
—Jafar

cards.name: Longboat
cards.fullText:
TAKE IT FOR A SPIN 2 ⬡ — Chosen character of yours
gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Gold Coin
cards.fullText:
SPARKLY ACCESS ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Ready
chosen character of yours. They can't quest for the
rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Sweet mother of monkey milk! A gold coin!”
—Vanellope von Schweetz

cards.name: Card Soldier's Spear
cards.fullText: A SUITABLE WEAPON Your damaged characters get +1 ¤.

cards.name: Flotilla
cards.fullText:
TINY THIEVES At the start of your turn, if you have a character here,
all opponents lose 1 lore and you gain lore equal to the lore lost this way.

cards.name: Skull Rock
cards.fullText:
FAMILIAR GROUND Characters get +1 ¤ while here.
SAFE HAVEN At the start of your turn, if you have a Pirate character
here, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: B.E.N.
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Aunt Cass
cards.fullText:
HAPPY TO HELP Whenever this character quests,
chosen Inventor character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “All right, geniuses, let's feed those hungry brains.”

cards.name: Gadget Hackwrench
cards.fullText:
BRAINSTORM Whenever you play an item, this
character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Golly, a perfect wingnut! There's about a million
uses for that!”

cards.name: Gadget Hackwrench
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Gadget
Hackwrench.)
MECHANICALLY SAVVY While you have 3 or more
items in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play Inventor
characters.

cards.name: Zipper
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
RUN INTERFERENCE During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, another chosen
character gains Resist +1 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Oswald
cards.fullText:
FAVORABLE CHANCE During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, you may reveal the
top card of your deck. If it's an item card, you may
play that item for free and it enters play exerted.
Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Yokai
cards.fullText:
TIME TO UPGRADE Whenever this character
quests, you may return one of your items to your
hand to pay 2 ⬡ less for the next item you play
this turn.

cards.name: Pleakley
cards.fullText:
REPORTING FOR DUTY When you play this
character, put chosen character of yours into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“As the duly appointed representative for the
Galactic Council, I volunteer for this assignment!”

cards.name: Hiro Hamada
cards.fullText:
SWEET TECH ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Search your deck for an item
card or a Robot character card and reveal it to all
players. Shuffle your deck and put that card on top of it.
cards.flavorText: “A couple more tweaks and I've just about...got it!”

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
EAT ANYTHING When you play this character,
exert chosen opposing item. It can't ready at the
start of its next turn.
OUT TO LUNCH During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)

cards.name: Sour Bill
cards.fullText:
UNPALATABLE When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“You want to go in there? Fine. If you do, you won't
come back out.”

cards.name: Nick Wilde
cards.fullText:
NICE TO HAVE A PARTNER While you have another
character with Support in play, this character gets
+2 ¤.
cards.flavorText: “Glad you could make it.”

cards.name: Wasabi
cards.fullText:
BLADES OF FURY When you play this character, you
may banish chosen item. Its player gains 1 lore.
QUICK REFLEXES During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)

cards.name: Nick Wilde
cards.fullText:
Shift 1 (You may pay 1 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Nick Wilde.)
YOU CAN'T TOUCH ME While you have an item in
play, this character can't be challenged.

cards.name: Gadget Hackwrench
cards.flavorText:
“All the clues pointed to an island, but I never
thought I'd see it on a map. Golly, this is
incredible! I mean, the island actually exists, so it's
technically credible—but still! This is amazing!”

cards.name: Dr. Delbert Doppler
cards.flavorText:
“Of course! It all makes perfect sense. That's why
my old star charts are useless. Every star in the sky
here is different!”

cards.name: Tadashi Hamada
cards.fullText:
LET'S GET BACK TO WORK This character gets +1 ¤
and +1 ⛉ for each item you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
“I'm not giving up on you. You don't understand this
yet, but people need you.”

cards.name: Hiro Hamada
cards.fullText:
I NEED TO UPGRADE ALL OF YOU Your other
Inventor characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt
to them is reduced by 1.)
SHAPE THE FUTURE 2 ⬡ — Look at the top card of
your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom
of your deck.

cards.name: Tadashi Hamada
cards.fullText:
SOMEONE HAS TO HELP During an opponent's turn,
when this character is banished, you may put the top
card of your deck into your inkwell facedown. Then, put
this card into your inkwell facedown.
cards.flavorText: His work lives on.

cards.name: Baymax
cards.fullText:
FULLY CHARGED If you have an Inventor character
in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
YOU SAID ‘OW’ 2 ⬡ — Remove up to 1 damage
from another chosen character.

cards.name: Baymax
cards.fullText:
THE TREATMENT IS WORKING When you play
this character and whenever he quests, you may
remove up to 2 damage from another chosen
character of yours. Gain 1 lore for each 1 damage
removed this way.

cards.name: Yokai
cards.flavorText:
“You are all brilliant scientists and inventors. Think
of what you could do with this little device. How do
you push the boundaries of what is possible?”

cards.name: Hiram Flaversham
cards.flavorText: He'll find a way to make anything mouse-sized.

cards.name: Yokai
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Yokai.)
NEUROTRANSMITTER You may play items named
Microbots for free.
TECHNICAL GAIN Whenever this character quests,
draw a card for each opposing character with 0 ¤.

cards.name: Alice
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
AHOY! Whenever this character quests, another
chosen character of yours gets +1 ◊ and gains
Ward until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: We Could Be Immortals
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Your Inventor characters gain Resist +6 this turn. Then,
put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 6.)

cards.name: Sail the Azurite Sea
cards.fullText: This turn, you may ink an additional card. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
You need a good plan and even better luck to make it
across these treacherous waters.

cards.name: Helping Hand
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Support this turn. Draw a card.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to another
chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“When you're making the world a better place, every
little thing helps.”
—Judy Hopps

cards.name: Prepare Your Bot
cards.fullText:
Choose one:
• Ready chosen item.
• Ready chosen Robot character. They can't quest for
the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Baymax's Healthcare Chip
cards.fullText:
10,000 MEDICAL PROCEDURES ⟳ — Choose one:
• Remove up to 1 damage from chosen character.
• If you have a Robot character in play, remove up to 3
damage from chosen character.

cards.name: Microbots
cards.fullText:
LIMITLESS APPLICATIONS You may have any number of
cards named Microbots in your deck.
INSPIRED TECH When you play this item, chosen
character gets -1 ¤ this turn for each item named
Microbots you have in play.

cards.name: Jumbo Pop
cards.fullText:
HERE YOU GO Banish this item — Remove up to 2
damage from each of your characters. Draw a card.

cards.name: Rescue Rangers Submarine
cards.fullText:
PLANNING SESSION At the start of your turn, if you have a character
here, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.

cards.name: Institute of Technology
cards.fullText:
WELCOME TO THE LAB Inventor characters get +1 ⛉ while here.
PUSH THE BOUNDARIES At the start of your turn, if you have a character
here, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Kakamora
cards.fullText:
A LITTLE HELP When you play this character, if you
have another Pirate character in play, you may deal 1
damage to chosen character or location.
cards.flavorText:
“They're very good at making trouble.”
—Maui

cards.name: Kakamora
cards.fullText:
HEAD COCONUT Whenever this character quests,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard
a card to deal 1 damage to chosen character or
location. If you discarded a Pirate character card,
deal 3 damage instead.

cards.name: Jim Hawkins
cards.fullText:
COME ON, COME ON, COME ON! During your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, this
character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get
+2 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Mr. Big
cards.fullText:
REPUTATION This character can't be challenged
by characters with 2 ¤ or greater.
cards.flavorText: “You've done me a great service.”

cards.name: Mr. Smee
cards.fullText:
GOOD CATCH During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText: “Captain Hook'd like a word with ya.”

cards.name: Mr. Smee
cards.fullName: Mr. Smee - Captain of the Jolly Roger
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Mr. Smee.)
RAISE THE COLORS When you play this character,
you may deal damage to chosen character equal to
the number of your other Pirate characters in play.

cards.name: Mullins
cards.fullText:
FALL IN LINE While you have a character named
Mr. Smee in play, this character gains Resist +1.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“Anything for you, Mr. Smee! Except me share o'
the plunder...”

cards.name: Kohut
cards.flavorText:
“Ma'am! I am a highly trained instrument of
tactical superiority! Maybe we could find someone
else for the gruntwork! Ma'am!”

cards.name: King Hubert
cards.flavorText:
“I told you we'd find an island eventually! Excellent
navigating. Yes, yes, I'm quite proud. Now, a toast
to our success!”

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“That maze wasn't so bad! Let's see what this
island has in store for us.”

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullText:
HUNK OF HARDWARE When you play this
character, chosen character can't challenge
during their next turn.
cards.flavorText:
“At the end of the day, it's the simplest tools that
come through for you in a pinch.”

cards.name: Mr. Arrow
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“We're holding steady, Captain. Despite this wind.
And these waves.”

cards.name: Jim Hawkins
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Jim Hawkins.)
BATTLE STATIONS When you play this character,
you may deal 1 damage to chosen character or
location.

cards.name: Tuk Tuk
cards.flavorText:
Raya: “Nothing gets past Tuk Tuk. Nothing.”
Sisu: “Except butterflies! Oh, and birds!”
Raya: “Fine. Most things don't get past Tuk Tuk.”

cards.name: Billy Bones
cards.fullText:
KEEP IT HIDDEN When this character is banished,
you may banish chosen item or location.
cards.flavorText: “He'll be comin' soon. Can't let them find this.”

cards.name: Pluto
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
GOOD BOY While this character has no damage,
he gets +4 ¤.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
BACKUP Your characters named Pluto gain
Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“Gee, Donald was right—it's spooky out here in
the dark!”

cards.name: Cobra Bubbles
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
THINK ABOUT WHAT'S BEST 2 ⬡ — Draw a card,
then choose and discard a card.

cards.name: Gantu
cards.flavorText:
“Strength in numbers is overrated. I prefer my own
strength.”

cards.name: Wreck-It Ralph
cards.fullText:
I WRECK THINGS Whenever this character quests, you
may banish chosen item or location to gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText: “I'm very good at what I do. Probably the best I know.”

cards.name: Calhoun
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
LEVEL UP During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a
challenge, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Captain Amelia
cards.fullName: Captain Amelia - Commander of the Legacy
cards.fullText:
DRIVELING GALOOTS This character can't be
challenged by Pirate characters.
EVERYTHING SHIPSHAPE While being challenged,
your other characters gain Resist +1. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
YOU'LL GET WHAT'S COMING TO YOU During your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, deal 1 damage
to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:

cards.name: Kenai
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
WISDOM OF HIS STORY During your turn, when
this character is banished in a challenge, return
this card to your hand and gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Kuzco
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
WE CAN FIGURE THIS OUT At the start of your
turn, choose one:
• Each player draws a card.
• Each player chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
WINTER AMBUSH When you play this character,
chosen opposing character can't ready at the
start of their next turn.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText: OBFUSCATE! Opponents need 25 lore to win the game.
cards.flavorText:
When it comes to magic spells, proper pronunciation
is key.

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
NO ORDINARY APPLE ⟳ — Choose 3 cards from
chosen opponent's discard and put them on
the bottom of their deck to gain 3 lore. If any
Princess cards were moved this way, gain 4 lore
instead.

cards.name: Panic
cards.fullText:
STARTLED SHRIEK When you play this character,
you may move up to 2 damage counters from
chosen character to chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
“What the boss doesn't know won't hurt us. Much.
I hope.”

cards.name: Archimedes
cards.fullText:
MORE TO LEARN Whenever an opponent chooses
this character for an action or ability, you may
draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Archazia's library was a treasure trove of
knowledge even for such an educated owl.

cards.name: Kashekim
cards.flavorText: “You presume much, to think you are welcome here.”

cards.name: Dolores Madrigal
cards.fullText:
I HEAR YOU Whenever one of your characters
sings a song, chosen opponent reveals their hand.
cards.flavorText:
She heard Mariano's heart skip a beat. Was it
because of the puzzle, or was he looking at her?

cards.name: Mufasa
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Mufasa.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Magical Maneuvers
cards.fullText:
Return chosen character of yours to your hand. Exert
chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Oh, I'm sure it's fine if we move these traps around.
Archazia won't mind a little magic.”
—Flora

cards.name: This Is My Family
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Gain 1 lore. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: So many stars, and everybody gets to shine

cards.name: Show Me More!
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText: Each player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavorText:
“Weave of time, attend to me—
Reveal the moments soon to be!”

cards.name: Restoring the Crown
cards.fullText:
Exert all opposing characters. Whenever one of your
characters banishes another character in a challenge
this turn, gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
The Hexwell surged with pure creative energy, fusing
the crown's pieces in a final burst of power.

cards.name: Amethyst Coil
cards.fullText:
MAGICAL TOUCH During your turn, whenever a card is
put into your inkwell, you may move 1 damage counter
from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
Shanzay's coil flared, sending a tendril of mystical
energy toward the damaged glimmer.

cards.name: Drizella
cards.flavorText:
Once again, Drizella was confronted with a simple
truth: life wasn't fair.

cards.name: Grewnge
cards.fullText:
RAPID FIRE Whenever this character quests, you
pay 1 ⬡ less for the next action you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
He loves two things: explosions and even more
explosions.

cards.name: Baymax
cards.fullText: SHHHHH This character enters play exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“Processing data from Archazia's thought scrolls
is taking a great deal of power. Extreme battery
saver protocol engaged.”

cards.name: Thomas O'Malley
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: There's nothing he can't talk his way out of.

cards.name: Pete
cards.fullText:
PILFER AND PLUNDER Whenever you play an action
that isn't a song, you may banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText: “I wasn't stealin' it! I was just keepin' it safe.”

cards.name: Hiro Hamada
cards.fullText:
ORIGIN STORY When you play a Floodborn
character on this card, draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Even with a mind as brilliant as his, the mixed ink
was a unique puzzle to solve.

cards.name: Cheshire Cat
cards.fullText:
MAD GRIN When you play this character, you may
deal 2 damage to chosen damaged character.
cards.flavorText:
“He's not your average cat, after all. Then again,
what cat is?”
—Archazia

cards.name: Shere Khan
cards.fullText:
WHAT A PITY When you play this character,
discard your hand.
cards.flavorText:
He'd be the first to tell you he's as magnificent as
he is deadly.

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
DRAW THEM OUT Whenever this character
quests, opposing damaged characters gain
Reckless during their next turn. (They can't quest
and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText: “The final part of the crown! Jafar will be pleased.”

cards.name: Mad Hatter
cards.fullText:
UNBIRTHDAY PRESENT Whenever a damaged
character challenges another character, you may
draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “Don't you care for tea?”

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Queen of Hearts.)
IF I LOSE MY TEMPER... Whenever another
character is played, put a damage counter on
them.

cards.name: Hiro Hamada
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Hiro Hamada.)
YOU CAN BE WAY MORE Your Floodborn characters
that have a card under them gain Evasive and Ward.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.
Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Yokai
cards.fullText:
INNOVATE You pay 1 ⬡ less to play characters
using their Shift ability.
cards.flavorText:
“In the hands of a lesser person, this much power
would be irresponsible.”

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
DUCK OF ACTION Whenever this character is
challenged, you may return an action card that
isn't a song card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText: “Aye aye, Captain! I'll get it done.”

cards.name: Berlioz
cards.flavorText: “Look what I found! Can we stay here and play?”

cards.name: Lady
cards.fullText:
A DOG'S LIFE While you have a character named
Tramp in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Are you sure we're allowed in here? Jim Dear
would never allow me in the kitchen.”

cards.name: Yzma
cards.fullText:
HOW SHALL I DO IT? When you play this character, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
“One of these must be the right lever, but I'll be a llama's
aunt if I can figure out which one...”

cards.name: Pacha
cards.fullText:
FULL PACK While you have more cards in your hand
than each opponent, this character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
He liked to prepare for any emergency. They
happened frequently with Kuzco around.

cards.name: Tweedledee & Tweedledum
cards.fullText:
ANOTHER RECITATION Whenever this character quests,
you may return chosen damaged character to their
player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“You can't leave yet! Don't you want to hear the ending?”
—Tweedledee

cards.name: Baymax
cards.fullText:
Universal Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on
top of any one of your characters.)
FUNCTIONALITY IMPROVED When you play this
character, if you used Shift to play him, remove
all damage from him.

cards.name: Gizmoduck
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
BLATHERING BLATHERSKITE This character can
challenge ready damaged characters.

cards.name: Fidget
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
I TOOK CARE OF EVERYTHING Whenever this
character quests, another chosen character of
yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Mr. Smee
cards.fullText:
PIPE UP THE CREW Whenever you play an action
that isn't a song, you may ready chosen Pirate
character.
cards.flavorText: “All right now, crew–we've a lot to do today!”

cards.name: Daisy Duck
cards.fullText:
FOWL PLAY Once during your turn, whenever a card is
put into your inkwell, chosen opponent chooses one of
their characters and returns that card to their hand.
cards.flavorText:
A captain must be inventive, commanding, and unafraid
of trampolines.

cards.name: John Silver
cards.fullText:
DRAWN TO A FIGHT If an opposing character took damage
this turn, you pay 2 ⬡ less to play this character.
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
I AIN'T GONE SOFT! Whenever you play an action that isn't a
song, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

cards.name: Tramp
cards.fullText:
HEY, PIDGE If you have a character named Lady
in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
NO TIME FOR WISECRACKS When you play this
character, chosen character of yours gets +1 ¤
this turn for each other character you have in play.

cards.name: King of Hearts
cards.fullText:
OBJECTIONABLE STATE Damaged characters can't
challenge your characters.
cards.flavorText:
“You there! You can't be here in the state you're in.
Begone before the Queen sees this mess!”

cards.name: Duchess
cards.flavorText:
“Now darlings, pay close attention to where we
are. What can you learn about the Owl from the
house?”

cards.name: Anastasia
cards.fullText:
OH, I HATE THIS! Whenever this character is
challenged, the challenging player chooses and
discards a card.
cards.flavorText: “Out of my way! I'm going to be the first to finish!”

cards.name: Pete
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Pete.)
FRIGHTFUL SCHEME While this character is
exerted, opposing characters can't exert to sing
songs and your Pirate characters gain Resist +1.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Lady Tremaine
cards.fullText:
THAT'S QUITE ENOUGH ⟳ — Return chosen
damaged character to their player's hand. Then,
each opponent discards a card at random.

cards.name: Wake Up, Alice!
cards.fullText: Return chosen damaged character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Alice! Will you kindly pay attention and recite your lesson?”
—Alice's sister

cards.name: He's a Tramp
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn for each
character you have in play.
cards.flavorText: Wish that I could travel his way

cards.name: The Return of Hercules
cards.fullText:
Each player may reveal a character card from their hand
and play it for free.
cards.flavorText:
“Congratulations, Wonderboy. You'll make one heck of a god.”
—Megara

cards.name: Ink Geyser
cards.fullText:
Each player exerts all the cards in their inkwell.
Then each player with more than 3 cards in their
inkwell returns cards at random from their inkwell
to their hand until they have 3 cards in their inkwell.

cards.name: Emerald Coil
cards.fullText:
SHIMMERING WINGS During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character
gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText: The coil Martin wore lifted his spirits as well as his body.

cards.name: Grandmother Fa
cards.fullText:
I'VE GOT ALL THE LUCK WE'LL NEED Whenever this
character quests, you may give chosen character
of yours +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Fear will get you hurt. Luck will get you through.”

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullName: Queen of Hearts - Losing Her Temper
cards.fullText:
ROYAL PAIN While this character has damage,
she gets +3 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
Something told the Illumineers she'd had enough
of the obstacles.

cards.name: The Matchmaker
cards.fullText:
YOU ARE A DISGRACE! Whenever this character
challenges another character, each opponent
loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Who spit in her bean curd?”
—Grandma Fa

cards.name: Denahi
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText: “There's no time. We have to act now!”

cards.name: Stabbington Brother
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
GET 'EM! Your other characters named
Stabbington Brother gain Rush.

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
Shift 7
SALVAGE For each item card in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡
less to play this character using her Shift ability.
REPURPOSE Whenever this character quests, you may put
up to 3 item cards from your discard on the bottom of your
deck to gain 1 lore for each item card moved this way.

cards.name: Cy-Bug
cards.fullText:
HIVE MIND This character gets +1 ¤ for each
other character you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
“Cy-Bugs are like a virus. They don't know they're
in a game.”
—Calhoun

cards.name: Stabbington Brother
cards.fullText:
CRIME OF OPPORTUNITY When you play this
character, chosen opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: Silence is golden. And he loves gold.

cards.name: Card Soldiers
cards.fullText:
TAKE POINT While a damaged character is in
play, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
The Three of Hearts raised his spear and
whispered to himself, “While others fall, a Queen's
soldier stands tall.”

cards.name: Cogsworth
cards.fullText:
STILL USEFUL While you have an item card in your
discard, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“Top shelf? Pshaw! If it's a book the mademoiselle
wants, I'll find a way to get it for her!”

cards.name: Toby
cards.flavorText:
“Toby has the most splendid sense of smell of any
hound I've trained. But he can be deucedly frisky.”
—Basil

cards.name: Beagle Boys
cards.fullText:
HURRY IT UP! Whenever this character quests,
chosen character of yours gains Rush and
Resist +1 this turn. (They can challenge the turn
they're played. Damage dealt to them is reduced
by 1.)

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.fullText:
I WON'T LET YOU DOWN This character can
challenge ready characters.
ENORMOUS RESPONSIBILITY While this character
has damage, he gets +2 ¤.

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
ADVENTUROUS SPIRIT Whenever this character
challenges another character, another chosen
character of yours gets +3 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Blot
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
Nobody knows who or what he really is or what
he's planning.

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
I'VE HAD IT! ⟳, 2 ⬡, Banish 2 of your items —
Deal 5 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“No, no, no! This is NOT THE WAY I SEE IT IN
MY HEAD!”

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
INTIMIDATING AND AWE-INSPIRING Whenever one of your
characters challenges, they gain Resist +2 during that
challenge. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
GUARDIAN OF LOST SOULS During your turn, whenever
one of your characters banishes another character in a
challenge, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Maurice
cards.fullText:
HOW ON EARTH DID THAT HAPPEN? When you
play this character, you may banish chosen item
of yours to draw a card. If the banished item is
named Maurice's Machine, you may also banish
chosen character with 2 ¤ or less.

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
STAR POWER Whenever this character challenges
another character, your other characters get +1 ◊
this turn.

cards.name: Lyle Tiberius Rourke
cards.fullText:
EXPLOSIVE Once during your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, deal 2 damage to
each character in play.
cards.flavorText:
He got what he wanted—just not the way he
planned.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mulan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
EXCEPTIONAL LEADER Whenever this character challenges
another character, your other characters gain “This
character can challenge ready characters” this turn.

cards.name: Baloo
cards.fullText:
FIGHT LIKE A BEAR Your characters with 7 ¤ or
more can't be dealt damage.
cards.flavorText:
“Now, move. That's it. Now give me a big bear
growl. Scare me.”

cards.name: Ratigan
cards.fullText:
A MARVELOUS PERFORMANCE Whenever you play
an action while this character is exerted, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: “Why stop the show when you can simply steal it?”

cards.name: Sir Kay
cards.flavorText:
“An owl in charge? Pshaw.” He glared at the
others. Then his eye fell on the targets set up
nearby, and he brightened. “But as long as I still
get to joust...”

cards.name: Milo Thatch
cards.fullText:
I'M YOUR GUY Whenever you play an action, you
may give chosen character +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Okay, we rotated the globe to move the mural
into position. We have the coordinates. Let's go!”

cards.name: Edgar Balthazar
cards.flavorText:
“All these traps, all these locks, all these machines...
If they think that's going to stop me, they've sorely
underestimated Edgar Balthazar!”

cards.name: We've Got Company!
cards.fullText:
Ready all your characters. They gain Reckless this turn.
(They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“Well, as usual, diplomacy has failed us.”
—Lyle Tiberius Rourke

cards.name: Out of Order
cards.fullText: Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText: The last thing any gamer wants to see.

cards.name: Ruby Coil
cards.fullText:
CRIMSON SPARK During your turn, whenever a card is put
into your inkwell, chosen character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Venturo felt a spark from his arm coil, and energy flooded
his strained muscles.

cards.name: Unconventional Tool
cards.fullText:
FIXED IN NO TIME When this item is banished, you pay
2 ⬡ less for the next item you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“I use this one a lot more than you'd think!”
—Maurice

cards.name: Maurice's Machine
cards.fullText:
BREAK DOWN When this item is banished, you may
return an item card with cost 2 or less from your
discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“I hope it does what I built it to do!”
—Maurice

cards.name: Devil's Eye Diamond
cards.fullText:
THE PRICE OF POWER ⟳ — If one of your characters
took damage this turn, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Just look at it, filled with power for its owner.”
—Madame Medusa

cards.name: Clarabelle
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
BREAKING STORY Your other characters with
Support get +1 ¤.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
PUT IT TO GOOD USE You may exert 4 items of
yours to play this character for free.
FORTUNE HUNTER When you play this character,
look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal an item card and put it into your hand. Put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Mattias
cards.fullText:
PROUD TO SERVE Your Queen characters gain
Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “You must move quickly before the trap resets. Go!”

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullName: Moana - Adventurer of Land and Sea
cards.flavorText:
Moana receives a call from the ancestors to sail
to new skies and reconnect people across the
entire ocean.

cards.name: Monsieur D'Arque
cards.fullText:
I'VE COME TO COLLECT Whenever this character
quests, you may banish chosen item of yours to
draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“I can help you with your problem...for the right
price.”

cards.name: Gaetan Moliere
cards.flavorText:
“Fascinating. This shouldn't exist, yet it does. It
may be older than the Great Illuminary itself.”

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
WHAT A MESS During your turn, you may banish
chosen item of yours to play this character for free.
cards.flavorText:
Helping her dad keep the flying debris to a
minimum.

cards.name: Lucky
cards.fullText:
FOLLOW MY VOICE Whenever this character
quests, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You
may reveal any number of Puppy character cards
and put them in your hand. Put the rest on the
bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Dawson
cards.fullText:
BE SENSIBLE Once during your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, look at the top card
of your deck. You may put it on either the top or
the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “I say, what sort of contraption is this?”

cards.name: Tamatoa
cards.fullText:
COOLEST COLLECTION When you play this
character, return up to 2 item cards from your
discard to your hand.
I'M BEAUTIFUL, BABY! Whenever this character
quests, you may play an item for free.

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Heihei.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
CLEAR YOUR MIND When you play this character, put all
cards from your hand into your inkwell facedown and
exerted.

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
KEY TO THE PUZZLE ⟳ — Look at the top 2 cards of
your deck. Put one into your inkwell facedown and
exerted and the other on the top of your deck.

cards.name: Toulouse
cards.flavorText:
He squeezed more paint from the tube and
wiggled in delight. Archazia was fun, even if she
was a giant owl. She had so many new colors to
paint with!

cards.name: Marie
cards.fullText:
I'LL SHOW YOU Whenever this character quests,
you may give chosen character -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Find yourself another Illumineer. This one's
taken.”

cards.name: Pepper
cards.fullText:
IN THE NICK OF TIME Whenever one of your Puppy
characters is banished, you may put that card into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: Pepper proves every puppy is part of the pack.

cards.name: Freckles
cards.fullText:
JUST SO CUTE! When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -1 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “I want to play with the others! Can I, Dad? Please?”

cards.name: Honey Lemon
cards.fullText:
PRETTY GREAT, HUH? Whenever you play a
Floodborn character, if you used Shift to play
them, you may remove up to 2 damage from
chosen character.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“There's been a heap of legends and tall tales
about Robin Hood. All different too.”
—Alan-a-Dale

cards.name: Penny the Orphan
cards.fullText:
OUR BOTTLE WORKED! While you have a Hero
character in play, this character gains Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Penny, dear, now don't cry. We are here to help you.”
—Miss Bianca

cards.name: Lady Kluck
Jasmine
cards.fullText:
EXTRA ASSISTANCE Whenever this character
quests, if you have no cards in your hand, draw a
card for each Ally character you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
“Oh, this is wonderful! I knew Archazia's thought
scrolls would be worth a little extra effort!”

cards.name: Jebidiah Farnsworth
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
I GOT YOUR FOUR BASIC FOOD GROUPS When you play
this character, chosen character gains Resist +1 until
the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Baymax
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
ADVANCED SCANNER When you play this character,
look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a
Floodborn character card and put it into your hand. Put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Maid Marian
cards.fullText:
GOOD SHOT During an opponent's turn, whenever
one of your Ally characters takes damage, deal 1
damage to chosen opposing character.
FAIR PLAY Your characters named Lady Kluck gain
Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Water Has Memory
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 4 cards of chosen player's deck.
Put one on the top of their deck and the rest on the
bottom of their deck in any order.

cards.name: All Is Found
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Put up to 2 cards from your discard into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Where the north wind meets the sea
There's a river full of memory

cards.name: Sapphire Coil
cards.fullText:
BRILLIANT SHINE During your turn, whenever a card is put
into your inkwell, you may give chosen character -2 ¤
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
A single flash of light from the coil on Venturo's leg could
blind any foe.

cards.name: Baymax's Charging Station
cards.fullText:
ENERGY CONVERTER Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, if you used Shift to play them, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Battery at 100%. Ready for action!”
—Hiro

cards.name: Dr. Calico
cards.fullText:
YOU'RE BEGINNING TO IRK ME While this character
has no damage, he gains Resist +2. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
