responsibilities to all the creatures of the woods.

cards.name: Poe De Spell
cards.flavorText:
“Sister, dear, if we turn all the townspeople into
frogs, who will give us our gold and turnips?”

cards.name: Madam Mim
cards.fullName: Madam Mim - Up to No Good
cards.flavorText:
“They think they know my tricks...Oh, this one's
going to be marvelously malicious!”

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
ICE OVER 1 ⬡, Choose and discard a card — Exert
chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
“I have to protect my sister. You're not going
anywhere!”

cards.name: Pinocchio
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
GOT TO KEEP REAL QUIET Once during your turn,
whenever you ready this character, you may draw
a card.

cards.name: Jiminy Cricket
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
ENOUGH'S ENOUGH While this character is
exerted, opposing characters with Rush enter
play exerted.

cards.name: Bambi
cards.fullText:
SAY HELLO When you play this character, gain 1 lore.
KIND OF BASHFUL When an opponent plays a
character, return this character to your hand.

cards.name: Monstro
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
FULL BREACH Choose and discard a card — Ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Nero
cards.fullText:
AND MEAN ⟳ — Move 1 damage counter from
this character to chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
He's identical to Brutus in temperament and
toothiness.

cards.name: Magica De Spell
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
DANCE OF DARKNESS When you play this
character, you may return another chosen
character of yours to your hand to draw a card.

cards.name: Kuzco
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Kuzco.)
WHAT DOES THIS DO? When you play this character, each
opponent chooses one of their characters and puts that
card on the bottom of their deck. Then, each opponent may
draw a card.

cards.name: Yzma
cards.fullText:
WHY DO WE EVEN HAVE THAT LEVER? When you
play this character, if you have a card named Pull
the Lever! in your discard, you may search your
deck for a card named Wrong Lever! and reveal
that card to all players. Put that card into your
hand and shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Madam Mim
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Madam Mim.)
MAKE WAY, COMING THROUGH! When you play
this character, banish her or return another
chosen character of yours to your hand.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
LOOK WHAT YOU'VE DONE When you play this character,
you may deal 2 damage to another chosen character of
yours to give that character Challenger +1 and “When this
character is banished in a challenge, return this card to
your hand” this turn. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Blue Fairy
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Anna.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
COORDINATED PLAN Whenever this character quests, if you
have a character named Elsa in play, you may draw a card.

cards.name: The Sultan
cards.fullText:
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character
for an action, banish them.)
COMMANDING PRESENCE Whenever one of your
Illusion characters quests, exert chosen opposing
character.

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
DARK POWER Whenever this character quests,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard a
card. If an Illusion character card is discarded this
way, you may play that character for free.

cards.name: Camilo Madrigal
cards.fullText:
ENCORE! ENCORE! When this character is banished
in a challenge, return this card to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“My primo Camilo won't stop until he makes you
smile today.”
—Mirabel

cards.name: Flower
cards.fullText:
LOOKING FOR FRIENDS Whenever you play another
character, look at the top card of your deck. Put it
on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
His sweet nature outmatches all the blooms in the
meadow.

cards.name: Forest Duel
cards.fullText:
Your characters gain Challenger +2 and “When this
character is banished in a challenge, return this
card to your hand” this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while
challenging.)
cards.flavorText: Fight with honor, win with dignity.

cards.name: They Never Come Back
cards.fullText:
Up to 2 chosen characters can't ready at the start of
their next turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“You boys have had your fun. Now, pay for it.”
—The Coachman

cards.name: Fantastical and Magical
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 9 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 9 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
For each character that sang this song, draw a card
and gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Pull the Lever!
cards.fullText:
Choose one:
• Draw 2 cards.
• Each opponent chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: Into the Unknown
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen exerted character into their player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Everybody's Got a Weakness
cards.fullText:
Move 1 damage counter from each damaged character
you have in play to chosen opposing character. Draw a
card for each damage counter moved this way.

cards.name: Scarab
cards.fullText:
SEARCH THE SANDS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Return an Illusion
character card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“If we can catch one, maybe we can recalibrate it to
help us get rid of Jafar's illusions!”
—Venturo, an Illumineer

cards.name: Ice Spikes
cards.fullText:
HOLD STILL When you play this item, exert chosen
opposing character.
IT'S STUCK ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Exert chosen opposing item.
It can't ready at the start of its next turn.

cards.name: Wilhelmina Packard
cards.flavorText:
Helga: “Sounds metallic. Could be an echo off one
of the rocks.”
Wilhelmina: “Do you want to do my job? Be my guest.”

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
INCAPACITATE When you play this character, you
may return chosen character to their player's hand.
INTERFERE Whenever this character quests, chosen
opponent discards a card at random.

cards.name: Tramp
cards.fullText:
HOW DO I GET IN? When you play this character, chosen
character gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
One glance at the tiny tracks, and his protective instincts
kicked in.

cards.name: Chaca
cards.fullText:
IN CAHOOTS When you play this character, if
you have a character named Tipo in play, chosen
opposing character gains Reckless during their next
turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)

cards.name: Tipo
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “This is so much fun, Chaca! I want to go higher!”

cards.name: Bill the Lizard
cards.fullText:
NOTHING TO IT While another character in play
has damage, this character gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText:
“We need a lazard with a lizard!”
—White Rabbit

cards.name: March Hare
cards.fullText:
LIGHT THE CANDLES When you play this
character, you may deal 2 damage to chosen
damaged character.
cards.flavorText: He really knows how to light up a room.

cards.name: Fred
cards.fullText:
SPITTING FIRE! When you play this character, you
may banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText:
“Don't be alarmed. It is just a suit. This is not my
real face and body.”

cards.name: Mad Dog
cards.fullText:
ARE YOU SURE THIS IS SAFE, CAPTAIN? If you have a
character named Don Karnage in play, you pay 1 ⬡
less to play this character.
cards.flavorText: He certainly isn't the brains of the operation.

cards.name: Dale
cards.flavorText:
“You're the fearless copilot who can handle any
job....Did I say fearless? I meant brainless!”
—Chip

cards.name: Louis
cards.fullText:
SENSITIVE SOUL This character enters play exerted.
FRIENDLIER THAN HE LOOKS When you play this
character, chosen opposing character gains Reckless
during their next turn. (They can't quest and must
challenge if able.)

cards.name: Napoleon
cards.flavorText:
“Everyone knows that without rations, an
operation'll be a failure. And this is why I outrank
you, Lafayette. 'Cause I see the big picture.”

cards.name: Chip
cards.fullText:
I'LL HANDLE THIS When you play this character,
chosen opponent chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText: “Don't worry, Dale! I've got you!”

cards.name: Fred
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Fred.)
I LIKE WHERE THIS IS HEADING Whenever this character
quests, reveal cards from the top of your deck until you
reveal a Floodborn character card. Put that card into
your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck.

cards.name: Gadget Hackwrench
cards.fullText:
GOLLY! When you play this character, if an
opponent has more cards in their hand than you,
you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“The scarab's power source! I knew that if I dug
around I'd find it!”

cards.name: Raya
cards.fullText:
UNCONVENTIONAL TACTICS Whenever this
character quests, you may pay 2 ⬡ to ready
another chosen character.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
WRAPPED UP Whenever this character quests,
chosen opposing character can't quest during
their next turn.

cards.name: Flynn Rider
cards.fullText:
THIS IS A VERY BIG DAY Whenever this character
is challenged, the challenging player may choose
and discard a card. If they don't, you gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText: “One way or another, I get what I want.”

cards.name: Dormouse
cards.fullText:
VERY RUDE INDEED When you play this character,
you may put 1 damage counter on chosen
character.
cards.flavorText: The tea is strong, even if he isn't.

cards.name: Alice
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Alice.)
ACCIDENT PRONE Whenever this character
quests, put 1 damage counter on each other
character.

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
COUNT OFF! While there are 5 or more characters
with damage in play, this character gets +3 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
She'll go wherever she pleases, no matter who she
has to step on to get there.

cards.name: Hiro Hamada
cards.fullText:
LOOK FOR A NEW ANGLE ⟳ — Ready chosen
Floodborn character.

cards.name: Go Go Tomago
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Go Go Tomago.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
ZERO RESISTANCE When you play this character, if you used
Shift to play her, you may put chosen character into their
player's inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Don Karnage
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SCORNFUL TAUNT Whenever you play an action
that isn't a song, chosen opposing character gains
Reckless during their next turn. (They can't quest
and must challenge if able.)

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Captain Hook.)
GIVE 'EM ALL YOU GOT! Once during your turn,
whenever an opposing character takes damage, your
Pirate characters get +2 ¤ and gain Resist +2 this
turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
I'M NOT FINISHED YET When this character is banished,
choose one:
• Put 2 damage counters on all opposing characters.
• Banish all opposing items.
• Banish all opposing locations.

cards.name: Honey Lemon
cards.fullText:
LET'S DO THIS! Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, if you used Shift to play them, you may
return chosen character to their player's hand.

cards.name: Jock
cards.fullText:
VOICE OF EXPERIENCE When you play this character, if
you have 3 or more other characters in play, gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Settle in, ye wee pups, and let Uncle Jock tell ye a story
about some Illumineers and a mad adventure...”

cards.name: Archimedes
cards.fullText:
YOU DON'T NEED THAT When you play this
character, you may banish chosen item.
NOW, THAT'S NOT BAD During your turn,
whenever an item is banished, you may draw a
card, then choose and discard a card.

cards.name: He Who Steals and Runs Away
cards.fullName: He Who Steals and Runs Away
cards.fullText: Banish chosen item. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Lives to steal another day!

cards.name: Stopped Chaos in Its Tracks
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 8 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 8 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Return up to 2 chosen characters with 3 ¤ or less
each to their player's hand.

cards.name: Wrong Lever!
cards.fullText:
Choose one:
• Return chosen character to their player's hand.
• Put a card named Pull the Lever! from your discard on
the bottom of your deck to put chosen character on
the bottom of their player's deck.

cards.name: Undermine
cards.fullText:
Chosen opponent chooses and discards a card. Chosen
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “It's a real shame I didn't even get a chance to study it.”

cards.name: Walk the Plank!
cards.fullText:
Your Pirate characters gain “⟳ — Banish chosen
damaged character” this turn.
cards.flavorText:
It was at this point that John decided he'd had quite
enough adventure.

cards.name: Chem Purse
cards.fullText:
HERE'S THE BEST PART Whenever you play a character,
if you used Shift to play them, they get +4 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Cute, but also potentially devastating. Perfect.”
—Honey Lemon

cards.name: Jeweled Collar
cards.fullText:
WELCOME EXTRAVAGANCE Whenever one of your
characters is challenged, you may put the top card of
your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Archazia created many wondrous things, but none as
beautiful as this.

cards.name: Gloyd Orangeboar
cards.fullText:
PUMPKIN SPICE When you play this character,
each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“I've got tricks for my opponents and treats for
my fans!”

cards.name: Honest John
cards.flavorText:
“Say, jewels just lying around in a fancy joint like
this? It would be a shame if a few went missing...”

cards.name: Gyro Gearloose
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
I'LL SHOW YOU! When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -3 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Vanellope von Schweetz
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“I can handle anything you throw at me...Wait, are
those laser snakes? This is the best track ever!”

cards.name: Brutus
cards.fullText:
SPITEFUL During your turn, when this character
is banished, if one of your characters took damage
this turn, gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText: He's identical to Nero in cruelty and classiness.

cards.name: The Dodo
cards.fullText:
EXTRAORDINARY SITUATION This character gets
+1 ¤ for each 1 damage on him.
cards.flavorText:
“And there I was in the cave below the palace
when suddenly sand began pouring down. Did I
stop? No! What's a little sand?”

cards.name: Alice
cards.fullText:
THIS WAY OUT When you play this character, you
may ready chosen damaged character of yours.
They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Goodness, those scarabs are awfully close!
We must find the way out!”

cards.name: Lumiere
cards.fullText:
QUICK-STEP While you have an item card in
your discard, this character gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText:
“Sacrebleu! This is no way to treat a guest in your
palace!”

cards.name: Gaston
cards.fullText:
BREAK APART When you play this character, you
may banish one of your items to give chosen
character +2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Take this magical stone. You'll need it to keep up
with me!”

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
LET'S GET THIS SHOW ON THE ROAD ⟳ — Chosen
character gains Rush this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“Move, move, move! There's no time to explain.
Well, maybe a little time, so listen up...”

cards.name: Cri-Kee
cards.fullText:
AT HER SIDE While you have 2 or more other exerted
characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“You were so focused on me and Mulan that you forgot
about my man Cri-Kee here. And that was a mistake!”
—Mushu

cards.name: Lafayette
cards.flavorText:
“What are we guarding the kitchen for, Napoleon?
There ain't no scarabs 'round here. Call me when
there's somethin' serious that needs fixin'.”

cards.name: Figaro
cards.fullText: PLAYFULNESS Opposing items enter play exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“Say hello to Figaro. Up to mischief already!”
—Geppetto

cards.name: Thumper
cards.fullText:
YOU CAN DO IT! ⟳ — Chosen character gets +3 ¤
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“C'mon! Let's show that mean old high sultan
what's what.”

cards.name: Wreck-It Ralph
cards.fullText:
CHARGED UP When you play this character,
chosen Racer character gets +4 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Let's burn rubber, kid!”
—Wreck-It Ralph

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
PAY ATTENTION Whenever you play a character with
5 ¤ or more, you may exert them to gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Lilo
cards.fullText:
STOMPIN' TIME! During your turn, if you've played
3 or more actions this turn, you may play this
character for free.
RAAAWR! When you play this character, ready
chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of
this turn.

cards.name: LeFou
cards.fullText:
ALL FOR ME ⟳, Banish one of your items —
Chosen opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“LeFou, sometimes you really take the cake.”
—Gaston

cards.name: Lumiere
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Lumiere.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
SACREBLEU! Whenever one of your items is
banished, this character gets +1 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: The Coachman
cards.fullText:
WILD RIDE While 2 or more characters of yours
are exerted, this character gets +2 ¤ and
gains Evasive. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
BURST OF SPEED During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
LONG RANGE This character can challenge ready
characters.

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Mushu.)
ALL FIRED UP Whenever you play another character, they
gain Rush, Reckless, and Evasive this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played. They can't quest and
must challenge if able. They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)

cards.name: Mr. Snoops
cards.fullText:
DOUBLE-CROSSING CROOK! During your turn, when
this character is banished, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“You can't do this to me, you swindler! We had a
verbal agreement!”

cards.name: Friend Owl
cards.flavorText:
“Sand? In the forest? I'll bet some magical
miscreant's up to no good. Well, it's none of my
concern. I'm going back to bed.”

cards.name: Faline
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
PRECOCIOUS FRIEND While you have a character
in play with more ¤ than each opposing
character, this character gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Prince John
cards.fullText:
HELP! HELP! Whenever an opponent plays a
character, deal 1 damage to this character.
cards.flavorText: Even a frightened lion still has claws.

cards.name: Nothing We Won't Do
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 8 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 8 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Ready all your characters. For the rest of this turn,
they take no damage from challenges and can't quest.

cards.name: Get Out!
cards.fullText:
Banish chosen character, then return an item card
from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Leave now. Before I change my mind.”
—The Beast

cards.name: Light the Fuse
cards.fullText:
Deal 1 damage to chosen character for each exerted
character you have in play.
cards.flavorText: A bold act can change the course of battle.

cards.name: Twitterpated
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next
turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText:
A mysterious phenomenon that makes you feel both
invincible and vulnerable at the same time.

cards.name: Most Everyone's Mad Here
cards.fullText:
Gain lore equal to the damage on chosen character,
then banish them.
cards.flavorText:
“Well, some go this way, some go that way. But as for
me, myself, personally, I prefer the shortcut.”

cards.name: The Sword of Shan-Yu
cards.fullText:
WORTHY WEAPON ⟳, ⟳ one of your characters —
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“I know what this means to you.”
—The Emperor

cards.name: The Mouse Queen
cards.fullName: The Mouse Queen - Ruler of Mousedom
cards.flavorText:
“After that dreadful Ratigan business, I know
about villains. This Jafar is certainly a villain of the
highest order.”

cards.name: Sir Pellinore
cards.fullText:
CODE OF HONOR Whenever this character quests,
your other characters gain Support this turn.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to
another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText: “Together, lads, we prevail!”

cards.name: Anita Radcliffe
cards.fullText:
I'LL TAKE CARE OF YOU When you play this
character, you may give chosen Puppy character
Resist +1 until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Olaf
cards.fullText:
ENDLESS TALE When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -1 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“It began with two sisters. One born with magical
powers, and one born powerless. Their love of
snowmen, infinite.”

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
WE CAN DO THIS TOGETHER When you play this
character, if you have a character named Elsa in
play, you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Wasabi
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“Okay, so the plan is ‘leave Wasabi to watch our
backs while we steal the crown.’ Good to know.”

cards.name: Go Go Tomago
cards.fullText:
NEED THIS! When you play a Floodborn character
on this card, you may put the top card of your
deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “Check it out! This ‘ink’ offers so many possibilities.”

cards.name: The Wardrobe
cards.fullText:
I HAVE JUST THE THING! ⟳, Choose and discard
an item card — Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: “Time to try something new, dear.”

cards.name: Mrs. Potts
cards.fullText: CLEAN UP ⟳, Banish one of your items — Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Now, don't fret over the mess, love. We'll have
everything shipshape in no time.”

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
JUST WHAT YOU NEED When you play this
character, you may give another chosen character
Resist +1 until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Little Sister
cards.fullText:
LET ME HELP When you play this character,
you may remove up to 1 damage from chosen
character.
cards.flavorText:
As Skippy's older sister, she's had lots of
experience putting things back together.

cards.name: Adelaide Bonfamille
cards.fullName: Adelaide Bonfamille - Patron of the Arts
cards.flavorText:
“Beautiful music can ennoble one's spirit, no
matter how dire things seem.”

cards.name: Nani
cards.fullText:
STICK TO THE PLAN ⟳ — Another chosen character
gains Resist +2 this turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
IT'S UP TO YOU, LILO Your characters named Lilo gain
Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤
to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
SO NAUGHTY When you play this character, each opponent
puts the top card of their deck into their inkwell facedown
and exerted.
STEALTH MODE At the start of your turn, if this card is in
your discard, you may choose and discard a card with ◉ to
play this character for free and he enters play exerted.

cards.name: Ratigan
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
TIME RUNS OUT At the end of your turn, if you
didn't put any cards into your inkwell this turn,
banish this character.

cards.name: Arthur
cards.fullText: NO MORE BOOKS Skip your turn's Draw step.
cards.flavorText:
“Do you want to be all muscle and no brain?”
—Merlin

cards.name: Bernard
cards.fullText:
GO DOWN THERE AND INVESTIGATE When you play
this character, if you have an Ally character in
play, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “Miss Bianca, over here! I found something!”

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
SAFE PASSAGE Whenever one of your Ally characters
quests, you may remove up to 2 damage from this
character.

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Jasmine.)
ALWAYS PLANNING Whenever this character quests,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal
an Ally character card and put it into your hand. Put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Roquefort
cards.fullText:
SAFEKEEPING Whenever this character quests,
you may put chosen item into its player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“Jafar will never expect us to hide lore from him in
his own safe! How exciting!”

cards.name: Jumba Jookiba
cards.flavorText:
“This little thing has a much more rudimentary
design than if I had created it. But if you were
rushing development, then this makes sense.”

cards.name: Geppetto
cards.fullText:
SEEKING INSPIRATION Whenever this character
quests, you may choose and discard any number
of item cards to gain 1 lore for each item card
discarded this way.
cards.flavorText: Everything he carves is a work of art.

cards.name: Heads Held High
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 6 or more may ⟳
to sing this song for free.)
Remove up to 3 damage from any number of chosen
characters. All opposing characters get -3 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Pouncing Practice
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn. Chosen
character of yours gains Evasive this turn. (They can
challenge characters with Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“Check out this cool trick my dad taught me!”
—Simba

cards.name: Down in New Orleans
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 6 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a
character, item, or location card with cost 6 or less and
play it for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck
in any order.

cards.name: Television Set
cards.fullText:
IS IT ON YET? ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Look at the top card of your deck.
If it's a Puppy character card, you may reveal it and put it into
your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: Thunderbolt's show was one thing all the puppies could agree on.

cards.name: Belle's Favorite Book
cards.fullText:
CHAPTER THREE ⟳, Banish one of your other items —
Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: Some stories stay with you forever.

cards.name: Atlantean Crystal
cards.fullText:
SHIELDING LIGHT ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gains
Resist +2 and Support until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2. Whenever
they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)

cards.name: Atitaya
cards.flavorText:
“Spears of Fang, stand strong and tall. We are the
last line of defense and we will not fall!”

cards.name: Bobby
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
cards.flavorText: “You come at me, you get the beak, capisce?”

cards.name: Magic Carpet
cards.fullText:
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character for
an action, banish them.)
SPECTRAL FORCE Your other Illusion characters gain
Challenger +1. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Prince Achmed
cards.fullText:
UNWELCOME PROPOSAL When you play this
character, you may exert chosen Princess
character.
cards.flavorText:
“Talk about overdressed and self-absorbed!”
—Jasmine

cards.name: Dumptruck
cards.fullText:
LET ME AT 'EM When you play this character, you
may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “Say, let me do it, Mad Dog. It's my turn.”

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText: “How dare you? Arm yourself, scoundrel!”

cards.name: General Li
cards.fullName: General Li - Head of the Imperial Army
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“A single grain of rice can tip the scale. One man may
be the difference between victory and defeat.”
—The Emperor

cards.name: Monterey Jack
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

cards.name: Genie
cards.fullText:
BUG CATCHER During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)

cards.name: Toby Turtle
cards.fullText:
HARD SHELL While this character is exerted, he gains
Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: “This place is scarier than Prince John.”

cards.name: Arianna
cards.flavorText:
“In dark times, a crown is a weighty honor we
must bear with grace and courage.”

cards.name: Zipper
cards.fullText:
BEST MATES If you have a character named
Monterey Jack in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play
this character.
BURST OF SPEED During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)

cards.name: Khan
cards.flavorText:
“When the whole world changes around you,
remember that Khan will always be the same—
steadfast and true.”
—Fa Zhou

cards.name: Vinnie
cards.fullText:
LEARNING EXPERIENCE During an opponent's turn,
whenever one of your other characters is banished,
gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: “That's quite a predicament you're in. Glad it ain't me.”

cards.name: Iago
cards.fullText:
SELF-PRESERVATION While you have another
exerted character in play, this character can't be
challenged.
cards.flavorText: “Nice try, chumps! Too bad I'm all the way up here!”

cards.name: Nathaniel Flint
cards.fullText:
PREDATORY INSTINCT You can't play this character
unless an opposing character took damage this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Flint's secret trove was never found, but stories have
persisted that it remains hidden...”
—Narrator

cards.name: Vincenzo Santorini
cards.fullText:
I JUST LIKE TO BLOW THINGS UP When you play
this character, you may deal 3 damage to chosen
character.
cards.flavorText: “Never be afraid to make a big entrance.”

cards.name: Namaari
cards.fullText:
STRATEGIC EDGE When you play this character
and at the start of your turn, you may draw a card,
then choose and discard a card.
EXTREME FOCUS This character gets +1 ¤ for
each card in your discard.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
THE BIGGEST STAR EVER When this character
is banished, deal 5 damage to each opposing
character.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
I WIN! During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you may
draw a card and gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Ah! Finally, a good use for his destructive instincts.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Desperate Plan
cards.fullText:
If you have no cards in your hand, draw until you have
3 cards in your hand. Otherwise, choose and discard
any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
cards.flavorText:
“It's my decision. My choice. And you won't stop me.”
—Namaari

cards.name: Beyond the Horizon
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 7 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Choose any number of players. They discard their
hands and draw 3 cards each.

cards.name: Quick Shot
cards.fullText: Deal 1 damage to chosen character. Draw a card.

cards.name: Hamster Ball
cards.fullText:
ROLL WITH THE PUNCHES ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character
with no damage gains Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Lady
cards.fullText:
PACK OF HER OWN Whenever you play a
character, this character gets +1 ¤ this turn.
TAKE THE LEAD While this character has 3 ¤
or more, she gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Wreck-It Ralph
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Wreck-It Ralph.)
BACK ON TRACK When you play this character
and whenever he quests, you may return a Racer
character card with cost 6 or less from your
discard to your hand. If you do, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Perdita
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Perdita.)
QUICK, EVERYONE HIDE When you play this
character, you may put all Puppy character cards
from your discard into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.

cards.name: It Means No Worries
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 9 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 9 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Return up to 3 character cards from your discard to your
hand. You pay 2 ⬡ less for the next character you play
this turn.

cards.name: Bambi
cards.fullText:
SAY HELLO When you play this character, gain
1 lore.
KIND OF BASHFUL When an opponent plays a
character, return this character to your hand.

cards.name: Kuzco
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Kuzco.)
WHAT DOES THIS DO? When you play this character,
each opponent chooses one of their characters and
puts that card on the bottom of their deck. Then,
each opponent may draw a card.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
LOOK WHAT YOU'VE DONE When you play this
character, you may deal 2 damage to another
chosen character of yours to give that character
Challenger +1 and “When this character is banished
in a challenge, return this card to your hand” this
turn. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Fantastical and Magical
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 9 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 9 or more
may ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
For each character that sang this song, draw a
card and gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Into the Unknown
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen exerted character into their player's
inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
WRAPPED UP Whenever this character
quests, chosen opposing character can't
quest during their next turn.

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Captain Hook.)
GIVE 'EM ALL YOU GOT! Once during your turn,
whenever an opposing character takes damage,
your Pirate characters get +2 ¤ and gain Resist +2
this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Wrong Lever!
cards.fullText:
Choose one:
• Return chosen character to their player's hand.
• Put a card named Pull the Lever! from your discard
on the bottom of your deck to put chosen character
on the bottom of their player's deck.

cards.name: Lilo
cards.fullText:
STOMPIN' TIME! During your turn, if you've
played 3 or more actions this turn, you may play
this character for free.
RAAAWR! When you play this character, ready
chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Mushu.)
ALL FIRED UP Whenever you play another character,
they gain Rush, Reckless, and Evasive this turn. (They
can challenge the turn they're played. They can't quest
and must challenge if able. They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)

cards.name: The Sword of Shan-Yu
cards.fullText:
WORTHY WEAPON ⟳, ⟳ one of your characters —
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the
rest of this turn.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
SO NAUGHTY When you play this character, each
opponent puts the top card of their deck into their
inkwell facedown and exerted.
STEALTH MODE At the start of your turn, if this card is in
your discard, you may choose and discard a card with ◉
to play this character for free and he enters play exerted.

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Jasmine.)
ALWAYS PLANNING Whenever this character quests,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal
an Ally character card and put it into your hand. Put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Desperate Plan
cards.fullText:
If you have no cards in your hand, draw until you
have 3 cards in your hand. Otherwise, choose and
discard any number of cards, then draw that many
cards.

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
PLENTY TO GO AROUND At the end of your turn,
you may remove up to 1 damage from each of
your other characters. Ready each character you
removed damage from this way.
cards.flavorText: “You're just in time for Surprise à la Goof!”

cards.name: Pinocchio
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
GOT TO KEEP REAL QUIET Once during your turn,
whenever you ready this character, you may draw
a card.

cards.name: Metal Scorpion
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SIMULTANEOUS STRIKE When Jafar plays this
character, each Illumineer chooses and banishes
one of their characters, one of their items, and one
of their locations.

cards.name: Palace Guard
cards.fullText:
BRING IT TO ME When Jafar plays this character,
he steals The Reforged Crown.
cards.flavorText:
“Ah, yes. I'll be taking that.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Iago
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one
of Jafar's characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
JAFAR'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.
SOUND THE ALARM While this character is exerted,
Jafar's locations can't be challenged.

cards.name: Razoul
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges
one of Jafar's characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
JAFAR'S SENTRY This character enters play exerted.

cards.name: Treasure Guardian
cards.fullText:
SHIFTING SANDS Illumineers can't use
battleground abilities.
cards.flavorText:
“Oh dear, have the rules changed? How dreadfully
sad...for you.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Jafar
cards.fullText:
RETURN TO ME! When Jafar plays this character,
he plays all items named Mechanical Snake from
his discard for free.
cards.flavorText:
“You didn't think this was over, did you? Bow
before true power!”

cards.name: Genie
cards.flavorText:
“Behold the power of my sorcery. This genie is mine!”
—Jafar

cards.name: The Sultan
cards.fullText:
PAY FEALTY When Jafar plays this character, each
Illumineer chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Now he's bowing before me.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.fullText:
OVER HERE! Whenever this character quests, Jafar
draws a card.
cards.flavorText:
“This version may be less substantial than the real
princess, but she'll do.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Gazeem
cards.fullText:
FIGHTING DIRTY When Jafar plays this character, he
deals 2 damage to each opposing damaged character.
cards.flavorText:
“What he lacks in manners he makes up in sheer cruelty.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Iago
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
GOTCHA! Whenever this character quests, Jafar
steals The Reforged Crown.

cards.name: Monumental Scarab
cards.fullText:
SECRET VULNERABILITY During the Illumineers'
turn, they may pay 3 ⬡ each to banish this
character.
cards.flavorText:
“Just the thing to deal with pests like you!”
—Jafar

cards.name: Gargantuan Cobra
cards.fullText:
SERPENT'S SHADOW When Jafar plays this
character, he deals 3 damage to each opposing
exerted character.
cards.flavorText:
“Behold the wonders of true power! Even the stone is
mine to command!”
—Jafar

cards.name: Tiger Behemoth
cards.fullText:
DREADFUL STARE This character can't be
challenged by damaged characters.
cards.flavorText:
“The palace guardians don't take kindly to
interlopers. Consider yourself warned.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Abu
cards.flavorText:
“Why, yes, he is annoying. So kind of you to notice.
I wanted this illusion to be as accurate as possible.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
cards.flavorText:
“The best part about this illusion? He knows his place.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Basil
cards.flavorText:
“I'll admit, he has a great mind—for a mouse.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Sandblast
cards.fullText:
Jafar deals 1 damage to each opposing character.
Then, put this card into his inkwell facedown.
cards.flavorText:
“Things are getting a bit rough, aren't they?”
—Jafar

cards.name: Destructive Misstep
cards.fullText:
Jafar's locations lose Ward until the start of his next turn.
The Illumineers may choose and banish up to one of
Jafar's locations.

cards.name: Disastrous Sandstorm
cards.fullText:
Each Illumineer chooses and banishes one of their
items or locations.
cards.flavorText:
“You'll have to dig deep if you want that back!”
—Jafar

cards.name: Sudden Power
cards.fullText:
Jafar gains 2 lore. Then, put this card into his inkwell
facedown.
cards.flavorText: “Yes! I can feel it! All of Lorcana shall tremble before me!”

cards.name: Arcane Quake
cards.fullText:
Jafar exerts all opposing characters. They can't ready at
the start of their next turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Your plan's beginning to crumble. Try not to lose your grip!”
—Jafar

cards.name: Cataclysmic Cyclone
cards.fullText:
Each Illumineer chooses one of their characters, items,
or locations. Then, Jafar banishes all other opposing
characters, items, and locations.
cards.flavorText:
“Now this will really blow you away!”
—Jafar

cards.name: Sand Wave
cards.fullText:
Jafar returns all opposing exerted characters to their
Illumineers' hands.
cards.flavorText:
“Try not to get swept away!”
—Jafar

cards.name: Mechanical Snake
cards.fullText:
SEIZE THE CROWN! When Jafar plays this item, he steals
The Reforged Crown.
DISASSEMBLED SERPENT ⟳, Banish this item — Jafar gains
2 lore.

cards.name: Fiery Basin
cards.fullText:
FACE THE FLAMES At the start of Jafar's turn, he banishes
this item to have each Illumineer choose one of their
characters and deal 4 damage to them.
cards.flavorText:
“You're playing with fire now.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Giant Hourglass
cards.fullText:
RISING SAND ⟳ — Jafar deals 1 damage to each
opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
“It's important to make time for friends.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Cobra Pit
cards.fullText:
SNAKEBITE When Jafar plays this location, he deals 1 damage to each
opposing character.

cards.name: Endless Staircase
cards.fullText:
VERTIGO When Jafar plays this location, he deals 3 damage to the
character with the highest cost each Illumineer has in play. (If there's a
tie, the Illumineers choose from the tied characters.)

cards.name: Royal Armory
cards.fullText: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this location is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Crystal Gate
cards.fullText: Ward (Illumineers can't choose this location except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Magical crystal to secure my most powerful treasures.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Deepwell Labyrinth
cards.fullText:
MAP THE MAZE Whenever a character challenges this location, each
Illumineer chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: Hall of Illusions
cards.fullText: WONDERSTRUCK Opposing characters can't quest.
cards.flavorText:
“I'm sure you'll figure it out in a thousand years or so.”
—Jafar

cards.name: Clockwork Sawblades
cards.fullText:
Ward (Illumineers can't choose this location except to challenge.)
NO ESCAPE When Jafar plays this location, he deals 2 damage to each
opposing character.

cards.name: Ink Moat
cards.fullName: Ink Moat - First Line of Defense
cards.flavorText: Don't get overconfident. They won't all be this easy.

cards.name: Bruno Madrigal
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
YOU JUST HAVE TO SEE IT ⟳ — Name a card, then
reveal the top card of your deck. If it's the named
card, put it into your hand and gain 3 lore. Otherwise,
put it on the top of your deck.

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
ROYAL SUMMONS At the start of your turn, you may
choose and discard a Princess or Queen character
card to return a character card from your discard to
your hand.

cards.name: Dumbo
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
AERIAL DUO When you play this character,
chosen character gains Evasive until the start of
your next turn.

cards.name: Pegasus
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“His name is Pegasus. And he's all yours....”
—Zeus

cards.name: Pongo
cards.fullText:
TWILIGHT BARK Once during your turn, you may
pay 2 ⬡ to reveal the top card of your deck. If it's
a character card, put it into your hand. Otherwise,
put it on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “We'll find our way. I know we will!”

cards.name: Alice
cards.fullText:
WASHED AWAY When you play this character,
you may put chosen item into its player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
MAKING WAVES Whenever this character quests,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Stitch.)
ADORING FANS Whenever you play a character with
cost 2 or less, you may exert them to draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
The best part about a beachside concert is that there's
always room for one more.

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
ROYAL SUMMONS At the start of your turn, you may
choose and discard a Princess or Queen character
card to return a character card from your discard to
your hand.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Stitch.)
ADORING FANS Whenever you play a character with
cost 2 or less, you may exert them to draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
The best part about a beachside concert is that there's
always room for one more.

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
FULL DANCE CARD Your Princess characters get
+1 ¤ and +1 ⛉.
cards.flavorText:
His heart warmed as the music began and the
dancers took their places.

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
DRAGON FIRE When you play this character,
you may banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
The ninth Rule of Villainy: When all else fails, turn
into a dragon.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Shift 5
STRAIGHT SHOOTER When you play this character, if you
used Shift to play her, she gets +3 ¤ this turn.
TRIPLE SHOT During your turn, whenever this character
deals damage to another character in a challenge, deal the
same amount of damage to up to 2 other chosen characters.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
ROYAL FAVOR Your characters named Mickey Mouse
gain Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
BYE BYE, NOW Whenever this character quests,
you may banish chosen exerted character with 5 ¤
or more.

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
DRAGON FIRE When you play this character,
you may banish chosen character.

cards.name: Pegasus
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“His name is Pegasus. And he's all yours....”
—Zeus

cards.name: Aurora
cards.fullText:
ROYAL WELCOME Whenever this character quests,
you pay 1 ⬡ less for the next Princess or Queen
character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
The other princesses were especially happy to
attend her long-awaited celebration.

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡
ROCK THE BOAT When you play this character, deal 1
damage to each opposing character.
PUNY PIRATE! During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge,
you may deal 2 damage to chosen opposing character.

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.flavorText:
Don't question her. Don't doubt her. And above all,
don't disobey her.

cards.name: Cursed Merfolk
cards.fullText:
POOR SOULS Whenever this character is challenged,
each opponent chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Now it's happened once or twice, someone couldn't
pay the price...”
—Ursula

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
MAGIC HAIR ⟳ — Remove up to 2 damage from
chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“We can all make the world a little brighter in our
own way.”

cards.name: Strength of a Raging Fire
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Deal damage to chosen character equal to the number of
characters you have in play.
cards.flavorText:
Tranquil as a forest
But on fire within

cards.name: Stitch
cards.flavorText:
Moving to the music, he begins to understand the
true meaning of ohana and how he fits into the
family he has found.

cards.name: Sisu
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
BRING ON THE HEAT! When you play this character,
banish chosen opposing character with 1 ¤ or less.
cards.flavorText: “Come on—what's the worst that can happen?”

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
Everything looks better when you're free to be

Judy: “These symbols must mean something...”

cards.fullText:

this turn, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Whoever's room this was, I think we just found their
inkcaster.”
—Shanzay, an Illumineer

cards.name: Blessed Bagpipes
cards.fullText:

put the top card of your deck facedown under one of
your characters or locations with Boost.
BATTLE ANTHEM Whenever one of your characters
or locations with a card under them is challenged,
gain 1 lore.

cards.name: White Agony Plains
cards.fullText: PURE LIQUID GOLD This location gets +1 ◊ for each character here.

cards.name: Diablo
cards.flavorText:
“Be careful when gathering herbs in the Inkwell
Caverns. You never know who's watching.”
—Hana's Herborium

cards.name: Ares
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
CALL TO BATTLE Once during your turn, whenever
you put a card under one of your characters or
locations, you may ready chosen character. If you do,
that character can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Wanna race? Last one through the Inkwell
Caverns is a codfish!”

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.flavorText:
“Okay, now we know pixie dust doesn't affect the
torn lorebook pages. Thanks, Tink.”
—Venturo, an Illumineer

cards.name: Raksha
cards.fullText:
ON PATROL Once during your turn, you may pay
1 ⬡ less to move this character to a location.
cards.flavorText:
Her name means “protection,” and she'll do
anything to defend the cubs under her care.

cards.name: Shere Khan
cards.flavorText:
“Jungle or forest, it doesn't matter. I'd recognize
the scent of man anywhere.”

cards.name: Rama
cards.fullText:
PROTECTION OF THE PACK Whenever you play
another character with 5 ¤ or more, you may
ready this character. If you do, he can't quest for
the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
With cubs to protect, any strange sound must be
investigated.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.fullText:
SOMEBODY'S GOT TO USE IT If a character was
banished this turn, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“The world is a cruel place, and sometimes you've
got to be a little cruel to get by.”

cards.name: Katrina Van Tassel
cards.flavorText:
She danced the night away, hoping to find
someone who could keep up with her.

cards.name: Hermes
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“What do you mean, ‘late’? Kid, I was ahead of my
time before time was invented.”

cards.name: Beast

to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
THAT'S MINE Whenever he challenges another
character, if there's a card under this character, each

hand, this character can't ready.

Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Tinker Bell.)
HARMLESS DIVERSION When you play this
character, exert chosen opposing character with

cards.fullText:
LEARN FROM EVERYTHING During your turn,
whenever one of your characters is banished,
draw a card.

turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

cards.fullText:
JOSTLING FOR POWER King and Queen characters
can't quest.
GROWING INFLUENCE At the start of your turn,
if an opponent has 2 or more ready characters in
play, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
EVER VIGILANT This character can't be dealt
damage unless he's being challenged.
EVER VALIANT While this character is exerted,
your other Hero characters can't be dealt damage
unless they're being challenged.

cards.name: Goliath
cards.fullText:
BE CAREFUL, ALL OF YOU Whenever one of
your Gargoyle characters challenges another
character, gain 1 lore.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your

cards.name: Brooklyn
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.
cards.flavorText: “If they think we're beasts and monsters...”

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
HIGH ENERGY Your other Ruby characters
get +1 ¤.
POWERFUL REWARD Your other Ruby characters
with 7 ¤ or more get +1 ◊.

cards.name: Elisa Maza
cards.fullText:
SPECIAL DETAIL While you have 2 or more
other characters in play with 5 ¤ or more, this
character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Now, you can let me look the place over, or I can
come back with a warrant and a lot more cops.
Your call.”

cards.name: Aladdin

Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
ONLY THE BOLD While there's a card under this character,
your characters with Reckless gain “⟳ — Gain 1 lore.”

the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
EXPEDIENT SCHEMES Whenever this character quests,
if you've put a card under her this turn, you may play an
action with cost 5 or less from your discard for free, then
put that action card on the bottom of your deck instead of
into your discard.

cards.name: The Headless Horseman
cards.fullName: The Headless Horseman - Terror of Sleepy Hollow
cards.fullText:
LEAVES NO TRACE When you play this character,
banish chosen opposing character with 2 ¤ or less.
GATHERING STRENGTH During your turn, whenever
an opposing character is banished, each of your
characters gets +1 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
FLOWING BLADE During your turn, if you've put
a card under one of your characters or locations
this turn, this character takes no damage from
challenges.

cards.name: Brom Bones
cards.fullText:
ROUGH AND TUMBLE Whenever this character
challenges a character with 2 ¤ or less, each
opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Hold on, schoolmaster! That's a mighty big book.
Let me take that for you!”

cards.name: Shere Khan
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Shere Khan.)
WILD RAGE 1 ⬡, Deal 1 damage to this character —
Ready this character. He can't quest for the rest of
this turn.

of this turn. The next time they challenge another

cards.name: Get to Safety!
cards.fullText:
Play a location with cost 3 or less from your discard for
free. Then, if you have a location named Sleepy Hollow
in play, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Run scared if you must—but whatever you do, RUN!

cards.name: Time to Go!
cards.fullText:
Banish chosen character of yours to draw 2 cards.
If that character had a card under them, draw 3
cards instead.
cards.flavorText:
“What are you doing here when there's a rogue
horseman out there? Have you lost your head?”
—Gaston

cards.name: Ghostly Tale
cards.fullText: Exert all opposing characters with 2 ¤ or less.
cards.flavorText:
Brom dwelled on every frightful detail, determined to
put a good scare into his rival.

cards.name: Dragon Fire
cards.fullText: Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText: Never underestimate the wrath of a dragon.

cards.fullText:
I NEED FIREPOWER When you play this item, chosen
character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the
turn they're played.)
HITCH A RIDE 2 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen

cards.name: The Bitterwood
cards.fullText:
GATHER RESOURCES Once during your turn, whenever you move a
character with 5 ¤ or more here, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Sleepy Hollow
cards.fullText:
HEAD FOR THE BRIDGE! Whenever a character quests while here, you may
banish this location to gain 2 lore and give them Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Judy Hopps
cards.fullText:
HIDDEN CLUES When you play this character, if you
have another Detective character in play, you may
put chosen item into its player's inkwell facedown
and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “More torn lorebook pages! Who could have done this?”

cards.name: Hen Wen
cards.fullText:
FUTURE SIGHT Whenever this character quests,
look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either
the top or the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
“She's a special pig, Taran.”
—Dallben

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“Come on—there's tons to do! Skating and snow
forts and sledding and hot chocolate!”

cards.name: Chef Louis
cards.fullName: Chef Louis - In Over His Head
cards.flavorText:
“When added to a clear soup, the pale, triple-
pointed leaves of Trispiritus can have a restorative
effect. CAUTION: DO NOT confuse it with Three
Thorns, which causes itchy rashes.”
—Hana's Herborium

cards.name: Daisy Duck
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“If I'm reading this right, these aren't actually ghosts
at all! Boy, you're lucky I came along on this one.”

cards.name: Cri-Kee
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“Small glimmers may feel safe in the jungle
around the Mysterious Ruins, where they can
easily go unnoticed.”
—Hana's Herborium

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
ENSNARL When you play this character, chosen
opposing character gets -3 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Well, that should slow you down for a minute.”

cards.name: Fergus McDuck
cards.fullText:
TOUGHEN UP When you play this character,
chosen character of yours gains Ward until the
start of your next turn. (Opponents can't choose
them except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Ach, close the secret entrance! You're letting all
the mysterious air out!”

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.flavorText:
The sound of hoofbeats filled the air. Li Shang
moved his men into position, ready to turn the
tables on their pursuer.

cards.name: Genie
cards.flavorText:
“You know, most books are a lot more compelling
when you read the pages in order...”

cards.name: Scuttle
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except
to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “Whoa! The wind's all of a sudden on the move here.”

this turn, put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: The Sultan

Never mind what the Curator intended these
trinkets for; the sultan found his own use for them
soon enough.

may put a card from your hand into your inkwell
facedown to draw a card.

the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a
Detective character card and put it into your
hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.

cards.fullText:
ON THE TRAIL ⟳ — If you have a Detective character
in play, return an item card from your discard to your
hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

cards.name: Daisy Duck

Sapphire characters quests, you may look at the
top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or
the bottom of your deck.

to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
WORTH MINING Whenever this character quests,
if there's a card under him, put the top card of your

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
GET A CLUE When you play this character, you
may put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
The clues all pointed toward ghosts, but he knew
there was something more going on here.

cards.name: Hen Wen's Visions
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 1 on the top
of your deck and the rest on the bottom in any order.
cards.flavorText:
“Hen Wen, from you I do beseech
Knowledge that lies beyond my reach...”
—Taran

cards.name: Promising Lead
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gets +1 ◊ and gains Support this turn.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“The books on these pages match up with those shelves. And the
ley lines...The answer's right here!”
—Judy Hopps

(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)

up to 1 character card and up to 1 item card and put
them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.

Put chosen opposing character into their player's
inkwell facedown. That player puts the top card of
their deck into their inkwell facedown.

cards.name: Spooky Sight

inkwells facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“We've got to get out of here!”
—Mickey Mouse

cards.name: Detective's Badge

and the Detective classification until the start of your next turn.

cards.flavorText:
“It's not just a badge. It's who we are. There's no greater honor.”
—Detective Judy Hopps

during their turn, if it's the second card they've drawn
this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
With a crackle of energy, the strange device lit up when
the glimmers entered the study.

put a card into your inkwell, chosen Princess character
of yours gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)

cards.fullText:
INTO THE GLOOM Once during your turn, whenever a character quests
while here, you may ready chosen item.

to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
EXPERT SHOT Whenever this character quests, if
there's a card under him, deal 1 damage to up to 2
chosen characters.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
RAISE A RUCKUS When you play this character,
chosen Detective character gains Challenger +2
this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText:
“Let's show those rotten ghosts who's in charge!
You go first.”

cards.name: Goliath
cards.fullText:

have more than 2 cards in their hand, they choose and
discard cards until they have 2. If they have fewer than 2
cards in their hand, they draw until they have 2.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your hand,
this character can't ready.

cards.name: The Headless Horseman
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named The Headless Horseman.)
WITCHING HOUR When you play this character, each
player draws 3 cards, then discards 3 cards at random.
Choose an opposing character and deal 2 damage to
them for each action card discarded this way.

cards.name: Clawhauser
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
It was only a crumb, but Clawhauser knew it was a
small piece of a larger mystery.

cards.name: Francine
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
Francine stared at the torn page, trying to take
her mind off Higgins and his pursuit of the littering
mastermind. Was he ready for the danger of
undercover work?

cards.name: Inspector Tezuka
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“Stand back. I'll handle this.”
—Inspector Tezuka

cards.name: Nick Wilde
cards.flavorText:
“Okay, Nick, it's time to use those superior sleuthing
skills to find a way out of this. Wait, why am I talking to
myself?”

cards.name: Basil
cards.fullText:
HOLD YOUR GROUND Whenever you play another
Detective character, this character gains Resist +1
until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: “It's time to make a stand!”

cards.name: Hudson
cards.fullText:
FINDING ANSWERS When you play this character,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard
a card.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
SEARCH THE SHADOWS When you play this
character, chosen Detective character gains Alert
this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
It's hard to catch a ghost without going somewhere
spooky.

cards.name: Black Heron
cards.flavorText:
“You may have bested me before, McDuck, but
not this time!”

cards.name: Lexington
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they
had Evasive.)
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.

cards.name: David Xanatos
cards.fullText:
MINOR INCONVENIENCE When you play this character,
you may choose and discard a card to deal 2 damage to
chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“A plan only fails when you don't learn from it. And my
plans never fail.”
—David Xanatos

cards.name: Chief Bogo
cards.fullText:
MY JURISDICTION During your turn, this
character can't be dealt damage.
DEPUTIZE Your other characters gain the
Detective classification.

cards.name: The Twins
cards.fullText:
TWO FOR ONE When you play this character,
if you have a location in play, you may deal 2
damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Hooray! A whole new forest to be lost in!”
“Yeah, lost in!”

cards.name: Nick Wilde
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Nick Wilde.)

of your Detective characters banishes another
character in a challenge, draw a card.

cards.name: Mayor Winddancer
cards.flavorText:
It's the role of a lifetime, and it'll take every bit
of his considerable charm and fabulous mane to
get it right.

cards.name: Prince Charming
cards.fullName: Prince Charming - Protector of the Realm
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play
exerted. An opposing character who challenges
one of your characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
PROTECTIVE PRESENCE Each turn, only one
character can challenge.

one of your characters must choose one with

under this character, you may banish chosen opposing
character. If you do, their player may reveal the top card
of their deck. If that card is a character or item card, they
may play it for free. Otherwise, they put it on the bottom of
their deck.

cards.name: Zeus
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
I NEED MORE THUNDERBOLTS! While there's a card
under this character, he gets +2 ¤ and +2 ⛉.

cards.name: The Headless Horseman
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText: If you hear hoofbeats in the dark, don't look back.

cards.name: But I'm Much Faster
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Chosen character gains Alert and Challenger +2 this
turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive. They
get +2 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: Putting It All Together
cards.fullText:
Chosen opposing character can't challenge during
their next turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Okay, so the ghostly glimmers were first seen here,
and the trail of torn lorebook pages started in this part
of the Illuminary...”
—Judy Hopps
