WARM HEART Whenever this character quests, you may
gain lore equal to the ◊ of a character card in your discard.
If you do, put that card on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Kristoff
cards.fullText:
HIDDEN DEPTHS When you play this character,
if you have a character named Anna in play, you
may put a card from chosen player's discard on
the bottom of their deck.
STROKE OF LUCK Once during your turn,
whenever a card leaves your discard, draw a card.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
UNEXPECTED DISCOVERY When you play this
character, you may put a card from chosen
player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
cards.flavorText:
Even in the deep forest, Anna could see the vine
poking above the treetops.

cards.name: Marshmallow
cards.fullText:
ICY BLAST Whenever this character quests,
each opponent can't ready more than 1 of their
characters at the start of their next turn.
cards.flavorText: “GO AWAY!!”

cards.name: Space Cows
cards.flavorText:
“The cows are not what they seem.”
—Launchpad

cards.name: Christopher Robin
cards.fullText:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
cards.flavorText:
The air was crisp and clear. “A perfect morning for
a snowball fight,” said Christopher Robin.

cards.name: Lumpy
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Wheee! This is even more fun than a game of
leaplog!”

cards.name: Witches of Morva
cards.fullName: Witches of Morva - Orddu, Orwen, and Orgoch
cards.fullText:
QUITE A BARGAIN When you play this character,
you may return another chosen character of yours
to your hand. If you do, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
What are you willing to give up in exchange for
power?

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
HE'S BACK! When this character is banished in a
challenge, return this card from your discard to
your hand.
cards.flavorText: More powerful. More beautiful. More Heihei.

cards.name: Pua
cards.flavorText:
“Don't worry, buddy. We're going to have fun
today, I promise!”
—Moana

cards.name: Sven
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character
gets +3 ¤.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)

cards.name: Do You Want to Build A Snowman?
cards.fullName: Do You Want to Build A Snowman?
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen opponent chooses YES! or NO!:
• YES! You gain 3 lore.
• NO! They choose a character of theirs and put that
card on the bottom of their deck.

cards.name: Come Out and Fight!
cards.fullText:
Put all cards from under chosen character, item, or
location on the bottom of their player's deck in a
random order. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Mickey: “All right, let's get that ghost!”
Goofy: “How do you reckon we do that?”

cards.name: Swordplay
cards.fullText:
Chosen character gains Challenger +3 this turn.
(They get +3 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText:
“It takes a great hero to handle a sword like this!”
—Taran

cards.name: Colors of the Wind
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player reveals the top card of their deck. Draw
a card for each different ink type of cards revealed
this way.

cards.name: Mother's Necklace
cards.fullText:
PRECIOUS GIFT At the end of your turn, if none of your
characters challenged this turn, chosen character of
yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
cards.flavorText:
“It's more than a necklace—it's a connection to her past.”
—Chief Powhatan

cards.name: Mystical Inkcaster
cards.fullText:
SPECIAL SUMMONS ⟳, 3 ⬡ — Play a character with
cost 5 or less for free. They gain Rush. At the end of
your turn, banish them. (They can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“We need your help. Show us what you've got.”
—Shanzay, an Illumineer

cards.name: Pot of Honey
cards.fullText:
I'M STUCK! Banish this item — Chosen exerted
character can't ready at the start of their next turn.
cards.flavorText: “Oh, bother. Not again...again.”

cards.name: The Frozen Vine
cards.fullText:
PERSISTENT PROBLEM When this location is banished, if there was an
exerted character here, return this card from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
RIGOROUS TRAINING Whenever this character quests,
gain lore equal to her ¤, to a maximum of 6 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Now remember, it's your first day of training, so listen
to your teacher and no fightin', play nice with the other
kids...”
—Mushu

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
I DARE YOU! ⟳ — Chosen opposing character
gains Reckless until the start of your next turn.
(They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
cards.flavorText: “Hi.”

cards.name: Big Mama
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Gather 'round, little ones. Let Big Mama teach
you how to stay warm in the snow!”

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.flavorText:
She's the epitome of grace, beauty, and a whole
lot of fun.

cards.name: Yao
cards.fullText:
OOH, I'M SCARED During opponents' turns, this
character gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText:
In his mind, he was “Snow-General Yao,” surveying
his frozen lands from atop his icy fortress.

cards.name: Chien-Po
cards.flavorText:
“Stay right here, little snowball. I'll come get you
when it's time for your date with Ling's face.”

cards.name: Ling
cards.fullText:
BUILDING MUSCLES 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gets
+1 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“If I keep carrying these, I'll be as strong as
Chien-Po!”

cards.name: Boomer
cards.fullText:
SPOTTED HIM! When you play this character, you
may exert chosen damaged character.
cards.flavorText:
“Good work, Boomer. We'll get him this time.”
—Dinky

cards.name: Chernabog
cards.fullText:
DARK DANCE When you play this character, you
may shuffle chosen opposing character into their
player's deck. If you do, that player may play a
character from their discard for free.

cards.name: Dinky
cards.fullText:
GET HIM! When you play this character, each
opponent chooses one of their characters and
deals 1 damage to them.
cards.flavorText: “Nail him, Boomer! Sock it to him!”

cards.name: Stegmutt
cards.fullText:
WAKE OF DESTRUCTION For each item card in your
discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
COLLATERAL DAMAGE When you play this character, you
may put 3 item cards from your discard on the bottom
of your deck in any order. If you do, deal 3 damage to
chosen character.

cards.name: Squeaks
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Snug as a bug, while we're out here freezin' our
b-b-beaks off!”
—Boomer

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullName: Aladdin - On the Edge of Adventure
cards.fullText:
QUICK ON HIS FEET Whenever you play an action,
this character gains Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
SNOWY SURPRISE When you play this character,
deal 2 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“You want a snowball? I'll give you a snowball. I'll
give you the biggest snowball you've ever seen!”

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
GRAVE OUTCOME When this character is
banished, each opponent chooses and discards a
card for each card that was under him.

cards.name: Copper
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Copper.)
MORE TO EXPLORE Whenever this character
quests, your characters with Evasive get +1 ◊
this turn.

cards.name: Copper
cards.fullText:
FOUND YA When you play this character, chosen
player reveals their hand.
cards.flavorText:
“How's this for a huntin' dog? He's just a little runt
now, but he'll grow.”
—Amos Slade

cards.name: Vixey
cards.fullText:
SHOWIN' UP If you have a character named Tod
in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)

cards.name: Tod
cards.flavorText:
“Come on, now. I'm not going to harm you.”
—Widow Tweed

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
A MOTHER'S LOVE When you play this character,
you may put the top card of your deck facedown
under one of your characters or locations with
Boost. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: White Rabbit
cards.fullText:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)

cards.name: Tod
cards.fullText:
LOOK AT THIS! Whenever this character quests,
choose one:
• Gain 1 lore.
• Chosen character of yours gains Evasive until
the start of your next turn. (Only characters with
Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
SLIPPERY SLOPE When you play this character
and when he leaves play, each opponent chooses
and discards a card.
cards.flavorText: “Now, that's what I call shredding!”

cards.name: Tod
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Tod.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
IMPRESSIVE LEAPS Twice during your turn, whenever
this character is chosen for an action or an item's ability,
you may ready him.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
SPIRIT OF GIVING Whenever you use the Boost
ability of a character, you may put the top card of
your deck under them facedown.
WELL WISHES During opponents' turns, whenever
one of your other characters is banished, you may
draw a card for each card that was under them.

cards.name: Strike a Good Match
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
Please bring honor to us
Please bring honor to us all

cards.name: Snowball Fight
cards.fullText:
Each opponent chooses and discards a card. If you
have a character with Evasive in play, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Snowflakes compacted into sphere makes for excellent
projectile.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Freeze the Vine
cards.fullText:
Banish all locations. Draw 2 cards, then choose and
discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
“There's only one way to stop this vine. Wait, no...
It's full of mixed ink? There's too much! I can't control it!”

cards.name: Education or Elimination
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Choose one:
• Draw a card. Chosen character of yours gets +1 ◊ and gains
Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only characters
with Evasive can challenge them.)
• Banish chosen damaged character.

cards.name: Snow Fort
cards.fullText:
THE HIGH GROUND Your characters get +1 ¤.
BARRICADE During opponents' turns, your characters
gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Rafiki's Bakora Staff
cards.fullText:
READ THE OMENS ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Draw a card, then choose
and discard a card.
BONK! 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Deal 1 damage to
chosen character.

cards.name: Retro Evolution Device
cards.fullText:
TURN INTO DINOSAUR ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish chosen character
of yours — Play a character with cost up to 2 more than
the banished character for free.
cards.flavorText:
“It's great for reheating leftovers, and it turns people into
dinosaurs.”
—Stegmutt

cards.name: Battering Ram
cards.fullText:
FULL FORCE ⟳ — Deal 1 damage to chosen damaged
character.
BREAK THROUGH ⟳, Banish this item — Banish chosen
location.
cards.flavorText: There's a right tool for every job.

cards.name: Game Preserve
cards.fullText:
EASY TO MISS While there's a character with Evasive here, this location
gains Evasive. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge it.)

cards.name: Wreck-It Ralph
cards.fullText:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
POWERED UP This character gets +1 ¤ for each card
under him.
WHO'S COMIN' WITH ME? When this character is banished,
banish all characters with ¤ equal to or less than the ¤
he had in play.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
COUNTING COINS This character gets +1 ¤ and +1 ⛉
for each card under him.
cards.flavorText: This grim future is but one possibility.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.flavorText:
Bob Cratchit: “That Fred, always so full of
kindness.”
Ebenezer Scrooge: “Aye, he always was a little
peculiar.”

cards.name: Taurus Bulba
cards.flavorText:
“Looks like Taurus Bulba's new computer brain has
the same old disposition.”
—Launchpad

cards.name: Copper
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: “I won't get lost, Chief. I can smell my way back.”

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
NOBLE SPIRIT If you have a character in play with
damage, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
FIGHTING SPIRIT If you have a character in play
with 5 ¤ or more, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.

cards.name: Maui
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText: “This has to be worth at least three chee hoos!”

cards.name: Fa Zhou
cards.fullText:
BATTLE WOUND This character enters play with
2 damage.
cards.flavorText:
It had been his duty and his honor to serve the
Empire.

cards.name: Liquidator
cards.fullText:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)

cards.name: Elisa Maza
cards.fullText:
FOREVER STRONG Your characters' ¤ can't be
reduced below their printed value.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.
cards.flavorText: “I'll never get the hang of jumping off rooftops.”

cards.name: Iduna
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Oh, dear. Look at the ice! Do you think this
means...?”

cards.name: Agnarr
cards.fullText:
PROTECTIVE INSTINCT While you have a Queen
character in play, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText: “It's just as we feared.”

cards.name: Negaduck
cards.flavorText:
“Only someone so dastardly, so despicable, so
disdainful of the utterly defenseless would dare
perform such a deed!”
—Darkwing Duck

cards.name: Negaduck
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Negaduck.)
STICKY FINGERS Whenever this character
challenges another character, each opponent
loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
SUPERHUMAN STRENGTH While there's a card
under this character, he gets +3 ¤.

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
DYNAMIC MANEUVER Whenever this character
challenges, if he's at a location, he takes no
damage from the challenge.

cards.name: Slushy
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“All right, Slushy. Do your stuff.”
—Lilo

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
PREPARE YOURSELF When you play this character,
you may ready chosen character. If you do, they
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Tonight, you will be visited by three spirits. Listen
to 'em.”

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
YAAAAAAA-HOO-HOO-HOO-HOOEY ⟳, Banish this
character — Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Skiing really is quite simple, once you get the
hang of it.”
—Narrator

cards.name: Olaf
cards.fullText:
ABOUT TIME! For each action card in your
discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
CHAOTIC COLLISION When you play this
character, each opponent loses 2 lore.

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Elsa.)
ENDLESS WINTER When you play this character and
whenever you play a location, you may exert chosen
character with 3 ¤ or less.
DISTANT CALL While this character is at a location, she
gets +3 ◊.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
PAYMENT DUE Whenever this character quests,
each opponent loses 1 lore. Draw a card for each 1
lore lost this way.
FORECLOSURE At the end of your turn, if an
opponent has 0 lore, you gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
CLEAR THE WAY When you play this character,
you pay 2 ⬡ less for the next location you play
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“The vine is worse than I thought. I'll have to take
care of this myself.”

cards.name: Willie the Giant
cards.fullName: Willie the Giant - Ghost of Christmas Present
cards.fullText:
Boost 3 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
3 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
THE FOOD OF GENEROSITY This character can't
quest or challenge unless you put a card under
him this turn.

cards.name: Nani's Payback
cards.fullText:
Each opponent loses lore equal to the damage on
chosen character of yours, to a maximum of 4 lore
each. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Older sister's wrath is even more dangerous than
Hamsterviel.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Force of a Great Typhoon
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gets +5 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
Once you find your center
You are sure to win

cards.name: Marching Off to Battle
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
If a character was banished this turn, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: The Cold Never Bothered Me
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
a location card and put it into your hand. Put the
rest into your discard. You pay 3 ⬡ less for the next
location you play this turn.

cards.name: Grab Your Bow
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish up to 2 chosen characters with 2 ¤ or less.

cards.name: Lonely Grave
cards.fullText:
HAUNTING PRESENCE ⟳, Banish chosen character of
yours — Put the top card of your deck facedown under
one of your characters or locations with Boost.
cards.flavorText: A frightening prospect for the richest man in town.

cards.name: Kristoff's Lute
cards.fullText:
MOMENT OF INSPIRATION ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Reveal the top
card of your deck. You may play it as if it were in your
hand. Otherwise, put it in your discard.
cards.flavorText:
“A little music and a campfire is the best way to keep
warm in winter...well, mostly the campfire.”
—Kristoff

cards.name: Scrooge's Counting House
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡ to put the top card of your
deck facedown under this location.)
GOOD BUSINESS This location gets +1 ⛉ and +1 ◊ for each card under it.

cards.name: Graveyard of Christmas Future
cards.fullName: Graveyard of Christmas Future - Lonely Resting Place
cards.fullText:
NEW ARRIVAL Whenever you move a character here, put the top card of your deck
under this location facedown.
ANOTHER CHANCE At the start of your turn, you may put all cards from under this
location into your hand. If you do, banish this location.

cards.name: Beast's Castle
cards.fullText:
SNOWBALL STANDOFF Whenever a character here challenges another
character, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: While the flowers slept, something else began to bloom.

cards.name: Roo
cards.fullText:
HOPPING IN ⟳ — Put this character facedown
under one of your characters or locations
with Boost.
cards.flavorText:
“Look, Mama—the icy magic is going away! Aren't
the flowers pretty?”

cards.name: Kanga
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
EXTRA HELP While there's a card under this
character, she gets +1 ◊.

cards.name: Piglet
cards.flavorText:
“I've always thought,” said Pooh, “that sometimes
the smallest things are the best.”

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.flavorText:
Tiny Tim loves seeing the Christmas decorations at
the Winter Festival. His father, Bob Cratchit, loves
every chance to spend time with him.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
She's always ready with a warm plate and a warm
heart.

cards.name: Sina
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
Sometimes, people just need to know there's
someone watching over them.

cards.name: Honker Muddlefoot
cards.fullText:
BE CAREFUL! Your characters named Darkwing
Duck gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“It's clear you're the brains of this operation, Honker.”
—Darkwing Duck

cards.name: Daisy Duck
cards.flavorText:
“You loved your gold more than that precious
creature. And you lost her forever.”
—Ghost of Christmas Past, to Scrooge

cards.name: Darkwing Duck
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“The noble visage of one of history's greatest
detectives, carved by one of history's other
greatest detectives: me.”

cards.name: Jiminy Cricket
cards.fullName: Jiminy Cricket - Ghost of Christmas Past
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
LOOK INTO YOUR PAST Whenever you put a card
under this character, you may put a card from your
discard into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Piglet
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Piglet.)
SPECIAL RECIPE At the end of your turn, remove
up to 2 damage from each of your characters.

cards.name: Gramma Tala
cards.fullText:
ANCESTORS' GIFT For each card in your inkwell,
you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
cards.flavorText: “Ice fishing? No, no—this is ice feeding!”

cards.name: Gosalyn Mallard
cards.fullText:
KEEN GEAR When you play this character, look at
the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an
item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest
on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Darkwing Duck
cards.fullText:
MODERN MARVEL Whenever this character quests,
you may put an item card from your discard on the
bottom of your deck. If you do, you may play an item
with cost 5 or less from your discard for free.
cards.flavorText:
“I've got things in here that haven't even been tested
yet!”

cards.name: Winnie the Pooh
cards.fullText:
LOOKING FOR A MORSEL When you play this
character, you may return an item card from your
discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText: “Oh, bother! Empty again!”

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Scrooge McDuck.)
SPREADING JOY When you play this character, you
may put a card from the top of your deck facedown
under each of your other characters. If you do, those
characters gain Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Splatter Phoenix
cards.fullText:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)

cards.name: Pete
cards.fullText:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
FOREBODING GLANCE Whenever this character quests, look
at a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to the
number of cards under him. Put one into your hand and put
the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
ANCESTRAL LEGACY You can ink cards from
your discard.
cards.flavorText:
“I've never seen anything like this before! It's so
dazzling, so beautiful. So...cold.”

cards.name: Tamatoa
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
ANYTHING THAT GLITTERS Whenever you put a card under
one of your characters or locations, this character gets +1 ◊
this turn.

cards.name: Morty Fieldmouse
cards.fullText:
HOLIDAY SPIRIT Once during your turn,
whenever you put a card under one of your
other characters, put the top card of your deck
facedown under this character.
HOLIDAY CHEER This character gets +1 ◊ for
each card under him.

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
WINTER STOCKPILE Whenever one of your
characters is banished, you may put that card
from your discard into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
What the Beast didn't know was that her father
had taught her how to throw a perfect snowball.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
HARD WORK Whenever this character quests, put
the top card of your deck facedown under him.
A GIVING HEART When this character is banished
in a challenge, you may put all cards that were
under him under another chosen character or
location of yours facedown.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
BAH, HUMBUG During your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, chosen character
gets -1 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“You work all your life to get money, and people
want you to give it away.”

cards.name: Chief Tui
cards.fullText:
AND THEN... Once during your turn, whenever a card
is put into your inkwell, look at the top card of your
deck. You may put it on either the top or the bottom of
your deck.
cards.flavorText: “And still a spark of hope burned in their hearts...”

cards.name: Visiting Christmas Past
cards.fullText:
Put any number of cards from under your characters
and locations into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
“What's wrong, Scrooge? I thought you enjoyed looking
down on the world!”
—The Ghost of Christmas Past

cards.name: Let It Go
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen character into their player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Distract
cards.fullText: Chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Be off with you, spirits! Can't a man enjoy his meal in
peace?”

cards.name: Wipe Out!
cards.fullText:
Put chosen character with Bodyguard or item into their
player's inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Blue Smoke
cards.fullText:
THEATRICAL ENTRANCE If you have a character named
Darkwing Duck in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this item.
CLOUD OF MYSTERY ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Tiny Tim's Crutch
cards.fullText:
AT YOUR SIDE ⟳ — Chosen character gains Support
this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤
to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“We all need a little help from time to time.”
—Mrs. Cratchit

cards.name: Darkwing's Chair Set
cards.fullText:
SECRET ENTRANCE When you play this item, you may put the
top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
SUDDEN SPIN ⟳, Banish this item — Remove up to 2 damage
from chosen character. If a character named Darkwing Duck
is chosen, remove up to 4 damage instead.

cards.name: Darkwing's Gas Device
cards.fullText:
BLINDING CLOUD ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gets -1 ¤
this turn. If you have a character named Darkwing Duck
in play, chosen character gets -2 ¤ this turn instead.

cards.name: Hidden Trap
cards.fullText:
ALMOST READY This item enters play exerted.
SNAP! ⟳, Banish this item — Choose one:
• Banish chosen item.
• Chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
CLONK! Whenever this character quests, if there's
a card under her, chosen opposing character can't
challenge until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Launchpad
cards.fullText:
STAND GUARD Your locations gain Resist +1.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“No one'll crash the gate while I'm here. And I
know about crashing!”

cards.name: Prince Naveen
cards.flavorText:
“Achidanza! I've never been this cold in my life.
It's so...invigorating!”

cards.name: Darkwing Duck
cards.flavorText:
“I am the terror that flaps in the night! I am the
chill that runs up your spine! I am Darkwing Duck.”

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“My father was strict and stern, but he made me
who I am.”

cards.name: Gantu
cards.fullText:
EASY TARGET When you play this character,
choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: “I'd better be getting paid for this.”

cards.name: Launchpad
cards.fullText:
WHAT DID YOU NEED? ⟳ — Draw a card. Then,
choose and discard a card unless you have a
character named Darkwing Duck in play.
cards.flavorText:
“Excuse my sidekick. His brain seems to be having
an out-of-body experience.”
—Darkwing Duck

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullName: Donald Duck - Along for the Ride
cards.fullText:
COMIN' THROUGH! When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText: “Where are the brakes on this doggone thing?!”

cards.name: Chief
cards.fullText:
GOOD RIDDANCE ⟳ — If an opposing character
was banished in a challenge this turn,
draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Sonny, you've got a lot of learnin' to do about
a-sniffin' and a-smellin'.”

cards.name: Amos Slade
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“I heard two of them foxes skitterin' about.
Shouldn't be long now...”

cards.name: McHorn
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText:
“If this storm keeps up, every neighborhood will be
like Tundratown.”

cards.name: Duke Weaselton
cards.fullText:
APPREHENDED When this character is banished,
you may play a character with cost 2 or less
for free.
cards.flavorText: “What'd you go and do that for?”

cards.name: Li Shang
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Li Shang.)
cards.flavorText:
“The best way I can honor my father's memory is
to finish his fight.”

cards.name: Nani
cards.fullText:
TAKE IT EASY While this character has no
damage, she gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“For a warming winter tea, add the following
Lorcana spices to your cup: frosted peppercorns,
silver cardamom, wishing star anise.”
—Hana's Herborium

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
AMPED UP While you have a character named
Lilo in play, this character gains Challenger +3.
(They get +3 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText:
“No more caffeine for you.”
—Lilo

cards.name: Dr. Hamsterviel
cards.fullText:
CONTROLLED VARIABLES For each Alien character
card in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
AWESTRUCK When you play this character,
chosen opposing character can't challenge during
their next turn.

cards.name: Angela
cards.fullText:
SHADOW POWER When you play this character,
you may give chosen character Challenger +2 and
Resist +2 until the start of your next turn. (They get
+2 ¤ while challenging. Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
ETERNAL NIGHT Your Gargoyle characters lose the
Stone by Day ability.

cards.name: Darkwing Duck
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
INSTA-ARMOR During your turn, whenever an
item is banished, this character gains Resist +1
until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Gigi
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they
had Evasive.)
SO PRETTY While this character has no damage,
she gets +2 ¤.

cards.name: Grand Councilwoman
cards.flavorText:
“Mr. Pleakley?! Are you responsible for this
snowball? You are a member of the Galactic
Council—have some self-respect!”

cards.name: Angel
cards.fullText:
UNTOUCHABLE While you have no cards in your
hand, this character gains Resist +2. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
GOOD AIM Once during your turn, you may
choose and discard a card to deal 2 damage to
chosen character.

cards.name: Darkwing Duck
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Darkwing Duck.)
TAKE THAT! During your turn, whenever an item is
banished, you may pay 1 ⬡ to deal 2 damage to chosen
character.
EVILDOERS BEWARE! This character can challenge ready
Villain characters.

cards.name: John Smith
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play
exerted. An opposing character who challenges
one of your characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
DO YOUR WORST Opponents must choose this
character for actions and abilities if able.

cards.name: Judy Hopps
cards.fullText:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're
not the first player, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Lilo
cards.fullText:
EXTRA LAYERS During each opponent's turn, the
first time this character would take damage, she
takes no damage instead.
cards.flavorText:
“My big dumb sister said I had to wear warm
clothes, so I took ALL of them.”

cards.name: Keep the Ancient Ways
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Opponents can't play actions or items until the start of
your next turn.

cards.name: The Terror That Flaps in the Night
cards.fullName: The Terror That Flaps in the Night
cards.fullText:
Deal 2 damage to chosen opposing character. If you
have a character named Darkwing Duck in play, deal 3
damage instead.
cards.flavorText:
“The first rule of superheroing is always utilize the
element of surprise.”
—Darkwing Duck

cards.name: Let's Get Dangerous
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player shuffles their deck and then reveals the
top card. Each player who reveals a character card
may play that character for free. Otherwise, put the
revealed cards on the bottom of their player's deck.

cards.name: Winterspell
cards.fullText:
Chosen location of yours can't be challenged until the
start of your next turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Well, that backfired. Anyone know how to thaw an
Illuminary?”
—Shanzay, an Illumineer

cards.name: Nearly Indestructible
cards.fullText:
Chosen character of yours gains Resist +2 until the
start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText:
“I designed this creature for to be unstoppable.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Infra-Pink Ultra Scan Specs
cards.fullText:
DETECTING EVIDENCE When you play this item, draw a
card, then choose and discard a card.
FOLLOW THE CLUES Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Alert this turn. (They can challenge as
if they had Evasive.)

cards.name: The Thunderquack
cards.fullText:
VIGILANTE JUSTICE All opposing characters gain the
Villain classification.
LAY OF THE LAND ⟳ — If a character was banished in a
challenge this turn, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Containment Unit
cards.fullText:
GOT YOU NOW When you play this item, choose a
character. They can't challenge or quest while this
item is in play.
POWER SUPPLY At the start of your turn, choose and
discard a card or banish this item.

cards.name: Darkwing Tower
cards.fullText:
EVIL VANQUISHED During your turn, whenever an opposing Villain
character is banished, you may ready a character here. If you do, they
can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Tiana
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
cards.flavorText: “This cocoa will warm you up like a hug from your mama.”

cards.name: Grandmother Willow
cards.fullText:
SMOOTH THE WAY Once during your turn, you pay
1 ⬡ less for the next character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText: “I haven't had this much excitement in 200 years.”

cards.name: Stitch
cards.fullText:
BRING YOUR FRIENDS Whenever this character
quests, if you have 2 or more other characters in
play, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“First one down the mountain gets all the
marshmallows for their cocoa!”
—Lilo

cards.name: Tigger
cards.fullText:
SPLENDERIFFIC BOUNCE When you play this
character, you may return chosen character,
item, or location with cost 2 or less to their
player's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“What do you mean, can Tiggers bounce in the
snow? Just watch!”

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
UNEXPECTED DISCOVERY When you play this
character, you may put a card from chosen
player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
cards.flavorText:
Even in the deep forest, Anna could see the vine
poking above the treetops.

cards.name: Genie
cards.fullText:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
1 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
INCREASING WISDOM This character gets +1 ◊
for each card under him.

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullName: Aladdin - On the Edge of Adventure
cards.fullText:
QUICK ON HIS FEET Whenever you play an action,
this character gains Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
SNOWY SURPRISE When you play this character,
deal 2 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“You want a snowball? I'll give you a snowball. I'll
give you the biggest snowball you've ever seen!”

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
A MOTHER'S LOVE When you play this character,
you may put the top card of your deck facedown
under one of your characters or locations with
Boost. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
SUPERHUMAN STRENGTH While there's a card
under this character, he gets +3 ¤.

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
CLEAR THE WAY When you play this character,
you pay 2 ⬡ less for the next location you play
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“The vine is worse than I thought. I'll have to take
care of this myself.”

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
YAAAAAAA-HOO-HOO-HOO-HOOEY ⟳, Banish this
character — Banish chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“Skiing really is quite simple, once you get the
hang of it.”
—Narrator

cards.name: Winnie the Pooh
cards.fullText:
LOOKING FOR A MORSEL When you play this
character, you may return an item card from your
discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText: “Oh, bother! Empty again!”

cards.name: Jiminy Cricket
cards.fullName: Jiminy Cricket - Ghost of Christmas Past
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
LOOK INTO YOUR PAST Whenever you put a card
under this character, you may put a card from your
discard into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.fullText:

cards.flavorText: “Where are the brakes on this doggone thing?!”

reduced by 1.)

challenge until the start of your next turn.

I'LL COUNT YOU IN Whenever this character
quests, you may play a character with cost 2
or less from your discard for free.

cards.name: Ohana Means Family
cards.fullText:
Remove all damage from chosen character of
yours. Draw a card for each 1 damage removed
this way.

cards.name: Raging Storm
cards.fullText: Banish all characters.

cards.name: Eeyore
cards.fullText:
THANKS FOR NOTICIN' ME For each exerted character
in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
SORRY ABOUT THAT When you play this character, for
each opposing player, you may choose a character of
theirs. They can't ready at the start of their next turn.

cards.name: Anna
cards.fullText:
UNUSUAL TRANSFORMATION If a card left a player's
discard this turn, this character gains Shift 0 ⬡.
WARM HEART Whenever this character quests, you
may gain lore equal to the ◊ of a character card in
your discard. If you do, put that card on the bottom
of your deck.

cards.name: Colors of the Wind
cards.fullText:
Each player reveals the top card of their deck. Draw a
card for each different ink symbol on cards revealed
this way.

cards.name: Mulan
cards.fullText:
RIGOROUS TRAINING Whenever this character
quests, gain lore equal to her ¤, to a maximum of
6 lore.

cards.name: Tod
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡
Evasive
IMPRESSIVE LEAPS Twice during your turn,
whenever this character is chosen for an
action or an item's ability, you may ready him.

cards.name: Freeze the Vine
cards.fullText:
Banish all locations. Draw 2 cards, then choose
and discard a card.

cards.name: Negaduck
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡
STICKY FINGERS Whenever this character
challenges another character, each opponent
loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Elsa
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡
ENDLESS WINTER When you play this character and
whenever you play a location, you may exert chosen
character with 3 ¤ or less.
DISTANT CALL While this character is at a location,
she gets +3 ◊.

cards.name: The Cold Never Bothered Me
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal a location card and put it into your hand.
Put the rest into your discard. You pay 3 ⬡ less for
the next location you play this turn.

cards.name: Scrooge McDuck
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡
SPREADING JOY When you play this character, you
may put a card from the top of your deck facedown
under each of your other characters. If you do,
those characters gain Ward until the start of your
next turn.

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
WINTER STOCKPILE Whenever one of your
characters is banished, you may put that card
from your discard into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.

cards.name: Tamatoa
cards.fullText:
Boost 2 ⬡
Ward
ANYTHING THAT GLITTERS Whenever you
put a card under one of your characters or
locations, this character gets +1 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Angel
cards.fullText:
UNTOUCHABLE While you have no cards in
your hand, this character gains Resist +2.
GOOD AIM Once during your turn, you may
choose and discard a card to deal 2 damage
to chosen character.

cards.name: Darkwing Duck
cards.fullText:

cards.fullText:
Each player shuffles their deck and then reveals
the top card. Each player who reveals a character
card may play that character for free. Otherwise,
put the revealed cards on the bottom of their
player's deck.

cards.name: Pocahontas
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡
CALMING WORDS When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play her and none of your
characters challenged this turn, characters can't
challenge until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Moana
cards.fullText:
ANCESTRAL LEGACY You can ink cards from
your discard.

cards.name: Gosalyn Mallard
cards.fullText:
HEROIC INTERVENTION When you play this
character, you may ready chosen character
with cost 2 or less. If you do, they can't quest or
challenge for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: “I bet Dad never caught any flowers like this!”

cards.name: Monterey Jack
cards.fullText:
BIRD'S-EYE VIEW When you play this character,
you may reveal the top card of your deck. If it's
a character card, you may put it into your hand.
Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “They're not lost. I just haven't found 'em yet!”

cards.name: Woody
cards.flavorText:
“Starin' over the jungle from this huge vine
I think back to when I was laughin' and feelin' fine
My friends were all around to welcome me back home
But now I'm lost in Lorcana and oh so alone”

cards.name: Dale
cards.fullText:
LOOK WHAT I FOUND While you have a character
named Chip in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Hey, Chip! Look what I found! Maybe we can use
'em for something.”

cards.name: Pedro Madrigal
cards.fullText:
DIFFICULT JOURNEY This character enters play
with 1 damage.
DEVOTED FAMILY When you play this character, if
you have another Madrigal character in play, you
may remove up to 1 damage from him.

cards.name: Agustin Madrigal
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
“I'm happy to bring these arepas to the oasis, mi vida.
Just think how much more I could help if I had a gift.”

cards.name: Alan-a-Dale
cards.fullText:
Singer 4 (This character counts as cost 4 to
sing songs.)
cards.flavorText:
“When the vine was loomin' large
And had us all feelin' down
Ol' Martin stood up, took charge
And now we're Illuminary bound”

cards.name: Prince Eric
cards.flavorText:
Of all the items in Ariel's trove, something about
this particular sword called to him. He knew it was
meant to be his.

cards.name: Dolores Madrigal
cards.fullText:
NO SECRETS When you play this character, look
at chosen opponent's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Amazu says he'll be back this way in a few weeks.
He's stuck in the desert right now.”

cards.name: Woody
cards.fullText:
LET'S GO HOME When you play this character,
look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal a Toy character card or a location card
named Andy's Room and put it into your hand.
Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.

cards.name: Rex
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play
exerted. An opposing character who challenges
one of your characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
RUN AWAY! During an opponent's turn, when this
character is banished, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Hamm
cards.fullText:
LOOSE CHANGE ⟳ — You pay 1 ⬡ less for the
next character you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Can you hurry up, Woody? I think these flowers
are aiming to break the bank, if you know what I
mean!”

cards.name: Monterey Jack
cards.fullText:
BREAK THE TRANCE This character can't quest
unless you have a character with 4 ⛉ or more
in play.
cards.flavorText:
“When there's a hint of cheddar in the air,
somethin' inside me snaps.”

cards.name: Bo Peep
cards.fullText:
SOMEBODY DO SOMETHING! Your characters
named Woody gain Bodyguard. (An opposing
character who challenges one of your characters
must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

cards.name: Chip
cards.fullText:
THERE YOU ARE! When you play this character,
you may return a character card with 4 ⛉ or
more from your discard to your hand.
FRIENDLY ASSIST Your characters named Dale
get +1 ⛉.

cards.name: Woody
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Woody.)
LET'S GET MOVIN' Whenever this character quests, draw
a card. Then, you may play a character with cost 2 or less
for free.
EVERYONE GATHER 'ROUND Your other Toy characters
get +1 ⛉.

cards.name: Mr. Incredible
cards.fullName: Mr. Incredible - Taking Out the Trash
cards.fullText:
KA-POW! When you play this character, you may
deal 2 damage to chosen opposing Robot or Villain
character.
cards.flavorText:
“Heavyweight problems need heavyweight solutions.”
—Mr. Incredible

cards.name: Pegasus
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“This Pegasus can carry almost anything on
his back—even a terrified archivist.”
—Rayyan, an Illumineer

cards.name: Isabela Madrigal
cards.fullName: Isabela Madrigal - Such a Lovely Voice
cards.fullText:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to
sing songs.)
NEW MOTIF When you play this character, if you
removed 1 or more damage from one of your
characters this turn, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Bullseye
cards.fullText:
LET'S RIDE If you have a character named Woody
or Jessie in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
cards.flavorText:
“Whoo-whee, Bullseye! You're muddier than a pig at
suppertime! Now come on outta there.”
—Jessie

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
FAMILIAR GROUND Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, chosen
opposing character can't challenge and must quest
during their next turn if able.
cards.flavorText:
“Isn't it wonderful? See if there's anything that
catches your eye.”

cards.name: Isabela Madrigal
cards.fullText:

one of your characters named Isabela Madrigal.)

from one of your characters, gain 1 lore for each 1
damage removed.

cards.name: Jessie
cards.fullText:
PART OF A FAMILY Whenever this character
quests, if you have 2 or more other Toy characters
in play, you may draw a card.
YODEL-AY-HEE-HOO! Whenever you pay 2 ⬡ or
less to play a card, chosen opposing character
gets -1 ¤ until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Woody
cards.fullText:
LET'S GO HOME When you play this character,
look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal a Toy character card or a location card
named Andy's Room and put it into your hand.
Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.

cards.name: Dale
cards.fullText:
SPIKE SUIT During challenges, your characters
deal damage with their ⛉ instead of their ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“He's bonkus in the conkus, you know.”
—Monterey Jack

cards.name: The Prince
cards.fullName: The Prince - Searching for His Love
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.flavorText:
“Forest deep and highest mountain are nothing to
a true heart. I hear my love's voice in every bird's
song and see her beauty in the golden light.”

cards.name: Julieta Madrigal
cards.fullText:
RESTORING RECIPE When you play this character
and whenever she quests, you may remove up to
1 damage from chosen character or location.
cards.flavorText:
“Mi amor, your kind heart is the best gift I've ever
received.”

cards.name: Pluto
cards.fullText:
BEWARE OF DOG Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, chosen
opposing character gets -1 ¤ until the start of your
next turn.
cards.flavorText:
“What'd you hear, boy?”
—Mickey

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
LONG JOURNEY This character may enter play exerted.
SECRET PATH While this character is exerted, whenever
one of your other characters quests, chosen opposing
character gets -2 ¤ until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Chip
cards.fullText:
RANGER RESOURCEFULNESS When you play this
character, if you have another character with 4 ⛉
or more in play, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Come on, Dale. You look fine! I've got a plan that
you'll be perfect for!”

cards.name: Ranger Team-Up
cards.fullText: Chosen character gets +¤ equal to their ⛉ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Great teamwork, pal! Now, make sure that helmet is
fastened nice and tight...”
—Chip

cards.name: This Growing Pressure
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen opposing character can't challenge and must
quest during their next turn if able. Draw a card.

cards.name: You've Got a Friend in Me
cards.fullName: You've Got a Friend in Me
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
up to 2 Toy character cards and put them into your
hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.

cards.name: Metamorphosis
cards.fullText: Shift a character from your discard for free.
cards.flavorText:
“The vine is full of flood ink. You won't believe what it can
do with a little encouragement!”
—Isabela Madrigal

cards.name: When You Need Help, Just Call
cards.fullName: When You Need Help, Just Call
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
If an opponent has more characters in play than you,
you may play a character with cost 4 or less for free.

cards.name: Safety Rope
cards.fullText:
GRAB HOLD! When you play this item, you may put
a character card from your discard on the top of
your deck.
PACK IT UP At the end of your turn, you may banish
this item to draw a card.

cards.name: Andy's Room
cards.fullText:
ANDY'S FAVORITE While you have only 1 character here, they get +2 ⛉
and +1 ◊.

cards.name: Mor'du
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“Believing that he alone should be the sole heir,
a seed of selfishness grew in him like a poison.”
—The Witch

cards.name: Alma Madrigal
cards.fullText:
PROTECTING THE FAMILY When you play this
character, if you have another Madrigal character
in play, you may exert chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText: “In our darkest moment, we were given a miracle.”

cards.name: Snow White
cards.fullName: Snow White - Merry as the Morning
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
CLARION CALL Whenever this character quests,
you may return chosen Seven Dwarfs character of
yours to your hand to draw a card.
NEVER FORGOTTEN During an opponent's turn,
when this character is banished in a challenge,
return this card to your hand.

cards.name: Dopey
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
TONGUE-TIED This character can't ⟳ to sing songs.
DISTANT MELODY Once during your turn, whenever
you play a song, this character gets +1 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Bashful
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “Oh, gosh!”

cards.name: Doc
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
SHARE KNOWLEDGE When you play this character,
if you have another Seven Dwarfs character or a
Princess character in play, draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Oh boy! Now this is a change grant...uh, a
ranged pant...a strange plant!”

cards.name: Grumpy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.flavorText:
“Watch what yer doin'. Ya nearly put me through
a wall with that sneeze! Ya wanna bring the whole
mine down?!”

cards.name: Sneezy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
GESUNDHEIT When you play this character,
chosen character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Why did the vine have to have such big flo—ah-
AH-CHOO!”

cards.name: Happy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.flavorText:
“This vine looks mighty peculiar! You fellas think
it'd be okay to touch it?”

cards.name: Ariel
cards.fullText:
FAMILIAR GROUND Whenever this character quests, if you
played another character this turn, chosen opposing character
can't challenge and must quest during their next turn if able.
cards.flavorText: “Isn't it wonderful? See if there's anything that catches your eye.”

cards.name: Sleepy
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
PLEASANT DREAMS When this character is
banished, if you have a Seven Dwarfs or Princess
character in play, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
A warm breeze, fragrant smells, and a gently
swinging vine...Who wouldn't fall asleep?

cards.name: Maleficent
cards.fullText:
HEED MY WORDS Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, you may
exert chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText: “Bind this glimmer, fiendish flowers!”

cards.name: Alma Madrigal
cards.fullName: Alma Madrigal - Heart of the Family
cards.fullText:
FIND A WAY Whenever this character quests,
move up to 1 damage from chosen character of
yours to chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
“Everybody makes mistakes. What's important is
that we recognize them.”

cards.name: Cruella De Vil
cards.fullText:
YOU'RE OUT OF FASHION Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
you may banish chosen damaged character.
cards.flavorText: “Can I help you? Not with your sense of style, darling.”

cards.name: Frozone
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText: “Go on. You can say it. That was cool, right?”

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
ROYAL COMMAND Whenever this character quests, if you
played another character this turn, chosen character gains
Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
Hours of walking in the heat had not improved her rosy
disposition.

cards.name: Will o' the Wisp

cards.fullText:
COME ON OUT When this character is banished in a
challenge, you may return this card to your hand.
cards.flavorText: They always come back when you need them.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
THIS AND THAT Whenever this character quests, if you
played another character this turn, you may put the top card
of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:

her friends.

cards.fullText:

cards.flavorText:

—Grandmother Willow

• This character gains Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can

cards.name: Zipper

half the heart as that wee dodger!”
—Monterey Jack

cards.name: Elinor
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
She had a lot to learn about being a bear, but
protecting her family came naturally.

cards.fullText:
COME ON OUT When this character is banished

cards.flavorText: They always come back when you need them.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
LIGHTING THE WAY Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText: You're never lost when you have a friend by your side.

cards.name: Dash Parr
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn

he's played.
cards.flavorText: “Whoa! A hidden place inside the mountain!”

in play, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“The Supers aren't gone, Mr. Incredible. You're still
here. You can still do great things.”

SILVER LINING Once during your turn, whenever
you remove 1 or more damage from one of your
characters, draw a card.

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.flavorText:

seems to have undergone some strange
mutations. Could be Zurg's influence.”

exert chosen opposing character.

exert chosen opposing character.

of your characters named Luisa Madrigal.)

character of yours to this character. Then, if this
character has 3 or more damage, move all damage from
this character to chosen opposing character.

cards.name: Dash Parr
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)

he's played.
cards.flavorText: “Whoa! A hidden place inside the mountain!”

cards.name: Luisa Madrigal
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“One way...or another...I'm getting...all of
you...up...this mountain!”

cards.name: Super Relocation Program
cards.fullText:
Return chosen character of yours to your hand. If you
returned a Hero character this way, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText:
“We appreciate what you did in the old days, but those
days are over.”
—Rick Dicker

cards.name: Right Behind You
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Draw a card. If you have a Seven Dwarfs character
and a Princess character in play, you may play a Seven
Dwarfs character for free.

cards.name: Don't Be Nervous
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Search your deck for a Princess character card, reveal
that card to all players, and put it into your hand. Then,
shuffle your deck. If you have 2 or more Seven Dwarfs
characters in play, draw 2 cards and gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Super Suit
cards.fullText:
SIMPLE, ELEGANT When you play this item, if you have
a Hero character in play, gain 1 lore.
SUIT UP ⟳, 2 ⬡ — If you played a Hero character this
turn, draw a card.

cards.name: DunBroch Family Tapestry
cards.fullText:
TORN APART This item enters play exerted.
MEND THE BOND ⟳, Banish this item — Each player
shuffles all character cards from their discard into
their deck.

cards.name: Ring of Stones
cards.fullName: Ring of Stones - Place of Legends
cards.fullText:
FOLLOW YOUR FATE Your exerted characters can move here for free.
PART THE VEIL Once during your turn, whenever a character moves
here, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Merida
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“‘Stay in camp, Merida.’ ‘Be an example, Merida.’
What could it hurt to go out and explore? I'll stay
on the vine and they'll never even know.”

cards.name: Hamish, Hubert & Harris
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Oh, aye, they're slippery little devils. Ye should
see what they did to the garden.”
—Merida

cards.name: Young MacGuffin
cards.flavorText:
“There's something wrong with these flowers, Da.
They make me feel funny, like I dinnae want to
fight them.”

cards.name: Tod
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Look, I counted to ten before I started climbing.
You all should have found better hiding spots than
the top of a tree.”

cards.name: Helga Sinclair
cards.fullText:
CRISIS MANAGEMENT If 2 or more cards were put
into your discard this turn, you pay 2 ⬡ less to
play this character.
cards.flavorText:
“Once again, I find myself cleaning up someone
else's mess.”

cards.name: The Witch
cards.fullText:
UNSATISFIED CUSTOMERS Whenever this
character is challenged, each opponent
loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“This is the perfect place to set up shop! That vine
adds just the right rustic feel.”

cards.name: The Queen
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
UNEQUALED CRUELTY While an opposing
damaged character is in play, this character
gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“With such a gift to further the Council's goals,
soon all will tremble before my power.”

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.flavorText:
“Environment appears habitable, but the flora
seems to have undergone some strange
mutations. Could be Zurg's influence.”

cards.name: RC
cards.fullText:
LOW BATTERIES This character can't quest or
challenge unless you pay 1 ⬡. (You pay this cost
each time.)
cards.flavorText:
Racing around Andy's room is fun, but he really
loves going off road.

cards.name: Lord MacGuffin
cards.fullText:
WAIT FOR IT... This character may enter play
exerted to deal 3 damage to chosen damaged
character.
cards.flavorText:
“We'll find our way back to the Illuminary if we
have to fight through every plant in Lorcana.”

cards.name: Lenny
cards.fullText:
TAKE A GOOD LOOK When you play this character,

an action card of your choice.
COMIN' UP FAST Once during your turn, whenever
you play an action, you may ready this character.

cards.name: Gaetan Moliere
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)

may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard 2 cards.

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullName: Peter Pan - Searching Far and Wide
cards.flavorText:
“I've already checked the whole jungle. He's got to
be around here somewhere!”

cards.name: Milo Thatch
cards.fullName: Milo Thatch - Getting His Hands Dirty
cards.fullText:
Ward
SCHOLAR'S GAMBIT When you play this character,
you may choose and discard a card to return chosen
character to their player's hand.
PRACTICAL KNOWLEDGE At the end of your turn, if
2 or more cards were put into your discard this turn,
draw a card.

cards.name: Alien
cards.fullText:
WE ARE ONE This character gets +1 ¤ for each
other Toy character you have in play.
HE HAS BEEN CHOSEN During your turn, when
this character is banished, return another
character card named Alien from your discard to
your hand.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
BURNING CURIOSITY Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
each opponent chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
In the wilderness of Lorcana, a little luck goes a
long way.

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.fullText:

and discard a card.
WORLD'S GREATEST TOY Whenever you pay 2 ⬡

chosen opposing damaged character.

deal 1 damage to chosen opposing character, gain
1 lore, and draw a card.

may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
DIRTY TRICKS At the end of your turn, if 2 or
more cards were put into your discard this turn,
each opponent loses 1 lore.

discards a card.
cards.flavorText:

fine. No arguing—doctor's orders.”

challenging character.

quests, deal 1 damage to chosen opposing
character. If 2 or more cards were put into your

cards.name: The Huntsman
cards.fullName: The Huntsman - On the Queen's Orders
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Even you wouldn't be fool enough to disobey my
orders a second time.”
—The Queen

their deck.

cards.flavorText:

—Alien

opponent loses 1 lore.

cards.name: Lyle Tiberius Rourke

the top 2 cards of your deck into your discard. Then,
you may return an action card with cost 4 or less
from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Mr. Incredible
cards.flavorText: Dropping weight and getting in shape!

cards.name: Lyle Tiberius Rourke
cards.fullName: Lyle Tiberius Rourke - Looking for His Moment
cards.flavorText:
“You have to be ready to take advantage of any
opportunity. And this vine? Looks like a pretty big
opportunity.”

cards.name: Pegasus
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
cards.flavorText:
Lorcana had changed. It felt bigger somehow.
But no matter how big it got, he was determined
to find his friend.

cards.name: Audrey Ramirez
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:

faster!”

cards.name: Milo Thatch
