this character gets +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
“Just think, Amazu—without the vine, we might
never have discovered these ruins!”

cards.name: Zeus
cards.fullText:
IMMORTAL WOUND This character enters play
with 4 damage.
cards.flavorText:
“I am the ruler of Olympus! I refuse to be defeated
by a bunch of flowers!”

cards.name: Preston Whitmore
cards.fullText:
PRICE OF PROGRESS When you play this
character, you may put the top 2 cards of your
deck into your discard.
cards.flavorText:
“I promised all of you I'd keep your secrets. And
Preston Whitmore always keeps a promise.”

cards.name: Jingle Joe
cards.fullText:
TURN OUT THE LIGHT During your turn, whenever
one of your other Toy characters is banished,
chosen character of yours gains Evasive until
the start of your next turn. (Only characters with
Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Wind-Up Frog
cards.fullText:
ADDED TRACTION If one of your Toy characters was
banished this turn, you pay 2 ⬡ less to play this
character.
cards.flavorText:
“I made it cooler. Who cares about some dumb hopping
frog, when it can have wheels?”
—Sid

cards.name: Roller Bob
cards.fullText:
TIME TO MOVE When you play this character, you
may put 2 character cards from your discard on
the bottom of your deck to give this character
Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn
they're played.)

cards.name: Hand-in-the-Box
cards.fullText:
SPRING-LOADED You may put a Toy character
card from your discard on the bottom of your
deck to play this character for free.
cards.flavorText:
“Ah! How does that still startle me every time?”
—Woody

cards.name: Daisy Duck
cards.fullText:
BREAK IS OVER Whenever this character quests,
if you played a character this turn, you may ready
another chosen character. If you do, they can't
quest for the rest of this turn.
cards.flavorText: “Time to go. I don't want to miss that sunset!”

cards.name: Copper
cards.flavorText:
“I'll clear this ol' vine out, if I have to do it one root
at a time.”

cards.name: Jebidiah Farnsworth
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
cards.flavorText: “Anything's edible if ya fry it!”

cards.name: Dash Parr
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“You can't outrun your chores, young man!”
—Helen Parr

cards.name: Babyhead
cards.fullText:
TIGHTEN THE BOLTS Whenever you pay 2 ⬡ or
less to play a card, chosen character gets +2 ¤
this turn.
REPLACEMENT PARTS During your turn, whenever
one of your other characters is banished,
draw a card.

cards.name: Bouncing Ducky
cards.fullText:
REJECTED TOYS For each Toy character card
in your discard, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
REPURPOSED When you play this character, put
all Toy character cards from your discard on the
bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Jack-Jack Parr
cards.fullText:
WEIRD THINGS ARE HAPPENING At the start of your turn,
you may put the top card of your deck into your discard.
If its card type is:
• character, this character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
• action or item, this character gets +2 ◊ this turn.
• location, banish chosen character.

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.fullText:
ROYAL COMMAND Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, chosen
character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge
the turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
Hours of walking in the heat had not improved her
rosy disposition.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.fullText:
HEROIC SACRIFICE When you play this character,
you may discard your hand. If you do, return a
card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“I don't care what the Fates say. I make my own
destiny.”

cards.name: Vincenzo Santorini
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
NEUTRALIZE Opposing items can't ready at the
start of their players' turns.

cards.name: The Leviathan
cards.fullText:
IT'S A MACHINE! When you play this character,
if 2 or more cards were put into your discard
this turn, you may banish any number of chosen
opposing characters with total ¤ 10 or less.

cards.name: Sid Phillips
cards.fullText:
PLAYTIME'S OVER When you play this character,
you may banish another chosen character of
yours. If you do, each opponent chooses and
banishes one of their characters.
DOUBLE PRIZES! During your turn, whenever a
Toy character is banished, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Mr. Incredible
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Mr. Incredible.)
ALWAYS UNITED This character gets +2 ¤ for each
other character you have in play.
LET'S DO THIS! Whenever one of your Super characters
challenges another character, draw a card.

cards.name: Pterodactyl Janie Doll
cards.fullText:
DOUBLE TRANSPLANT During your turn, when this
character is banished, each opponent loses 1 lore
and you gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“The first step of her transformation is complete.”
—Sid

cards.name: Inner Strength
cards.fullText: Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
Just when you think you've given it all you've got,
sometimes you can give a little more.

cards.name: Firefly Swarm
cards.fullText:
Choose one:
• Banish chosen character with 2 ¤ or less.
• If 2 or more other cards were put into your discard
this turn, banish chosen character.

cards.name: Like a Bird in the Sky
cards.fullName: Like a Bird in the Sky
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gets +1 ◊ and gains Evasive until the
start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive
can challenge them.)

cards.name: Hero Work
cards.fullText:
Your characters get +1 ¤ this turn. Your Hero characters
gain “Whenever this character challenges another
character, each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore”
this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“It's a whole family of Supers!”
—Syndrome

cards.name: Dangerous Plan
cards.fullText: Draw 2 cards. Then, discard a card at random.
cards.flavorText:
Audrey: “This was your plan?!”
Milo: “I didn't anticipate the flowers, but it can still work!”

cards.name: Amazu's Inkcaster
cards.fullText:
ON THE HORIZON ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Look at the top 4 cards of
your deck. You may reveal a location card and put it into
your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.
cards.flavorText:
“It always points the way to new adventures.”
—Amazu, an Illumineer

cards.name: Remote Inklands
cards.fullText:
ERODING WINDS At the start of your turn, put the top card of your deck
into your discard.
SUCCESSFUL EXPEDITION Characters get +2 ¤ while here.

cards.name: Leviathan's Lair
cards.fullText:
LOST TO THE DUNES When this location is banished, each opponent chooses and
banishes one of their characters.
cards.flavorText: [in Atlantean] Enter the lair of the leviathan.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.flavorText:
“I say, those glowing symbols look interesting.
I think it's time to go in for a closer look!”

cards.name: Prince Charming
cards.flavorText:
From a distance this had looked like any other
cave. But up close...

cards.name: Merryweather
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “We'll need a fire! A nice blue fire, of course.”

cards.name: Fauna
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
cards.flavorText: “Oh dear, let me help you with that.”

cards.name: Flora
cards.fullText:
LUMINOUS SHELTER When you play this character,
your other characters gain Resist +1 until the
start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“While you two finish up, I'll add protective charms.
Pink, of course.”

cards.name: Mirabel Madrigal
cards.fullText:
THIS WILL HELP When you play this character,
remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“We'll get you something to eat when we get to
camp. For now, you should drink this.”

cards.name: Syndrome
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
The fifth Rule of Villainy: The best way to get
revenge on your enemies? Lots of practice.

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
NATURAL DEFENSE When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“I may be far from home, but I still know how to
snare an intruder.”
—Kida

cards.name: Gadget Hackwrench
cards.fullText:
TIME TO TINKER When you play this character,
you may play an item with cost 3 or less for free.
WELL SUPPLIED Your characters with Support
get +1 ◊.

cards.name: Norton Nimnul
cards.fullText:
DEVITALIZER RAY Once during your turn,
whenever you play an item, chosen opposing
character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Another successful test! This brilliant devitalizer
ray technology will be my finest invention yet!”

cards.name: Gadget Hackwrench
cards.fullName: Gadget Hackwrench - Finder of Lost Parts
cards.fullText:
USEFUL BITS When this character leaves play,
you may return an item card from your discard to
your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Golly, I can't believe I almost left the safety pin
behind. It's the key to everything!”

cards.name: Zipper
cards.flavorText:
“Crikey! I've seen fellas who are twice the size with
half the heart as that wee dodger!”
—Monterey Jack

cards.name: Edna Mode
cards.fullText:
KEY ACCESSORY ⟳ — Ready chosen item.
ALL THE BASICS While you have an item
named Super Suit in play, this character gains
Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)

cards.name: Zipper
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Zipper.)
BUZZING ENTHUSIASM Whenever this character
quests, you may add his ⛉ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.

cards.name: Luisa Madrigal
cards.fullText:
SHOULDER THE BURDEN Whenever this character
quests, you may move up to 3 damage from
chosen character to this character.
cards.flavorText: “Who needs a break? I'm fine! I got this!”

cards.name: Dr. Sara Bellum
cards.fullName: Dr. Sara Bellum - Head of Research
cards.fullText:
SCIENTIFIC SCRUTINY When you play this
character, look at the top card of your deck. Put it
on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
“Fascinating. What unusual markings! I can't wait
to bring my findings back to S.H.U.S.H.”

cards.name: Isabela Madrigal
cards.fullText:
FEEL BETTER When you play this character and
whenever she quests, you may move all damage
from chosen character of yours to this character.
SELF-CARE At the end of your turn, you may
remove all damage from this character.

cards.name: Bruno Madrigal
cards.fullText:
FIND THAT VISION Once during your turn, whenever you
remove damage from one of your characters, you may
look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your
hand and the other on the bottom of your deck.
YOU'LL BE OKAY Whenever this character quests, you
may remove all damage from chosen character.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
THIS AND THAT Whenever this character quests, if
you played another character this turn, you may put
the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
No matter how difficult the journey, she always takes
care of her friends.

cards.name: Bruno Madrigal
cards.fullText:
CHANGE THE OUTCOME When you play this
character, you may look at the top card of chosen
player's deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom
of their deck.
cards.flavorText:
“It's so hard to make out...I think it's something
buried deep underground.”

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
READ THE RUNES Whenever this character
quests, if 2 or more cards were put into your
discard this turn, you may put the top card
of your deck into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.

cards.name: Kashekim
cards.fullText:
STRENGTH IN MEMORY At the end of your turn,
if 2 or more cards were put into your discard this
turn, you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown.
cards.flavorText: “The power here is buried deep in the sands.”

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
DISCERNING EYE Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“I found a shortcut just over the ridge. We'll be at
the oasis in no time!”

cards.name: Kida
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 ⬡
FLOOD OF POWER When you play this character, each player
may put up to 5 cards from their discard into their inkwell
facedown and exerted.
THE PATH REVEALED 7 ⬡ — Look at the top 2 cards of your
deck. Put one into your hand and the other on the bottom
of your deck.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.fullText:
QUITE THE BARGAIN When you play this character
and whenever she quests, another chosen
character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
BY THE WAY At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, put chosen character of
yours into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Someone Will Lose His Head
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.

cards.name: What Else Can I Do?
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand
and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted. If a
character sang this song, your characters gain Ward until the
start of your next turn. (Opponents can't choose them except
to challenge.)

cards.name: Escape Plan
cards.fullText:
You can't play this action unless 2 or more cards were
put into your discard this turn.
Each player chooses 2 of their characters and puts
them into their inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Salvage Operation
cards.fullText:
Return an item card from your discard to your hand. If you
have a character with 4 ⛉ or more in play, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Can you lift the Ranger Plane up a little higher, Zipper?
I've just about got it.”
—Gadget Hackwrench

cards.name: Julieta's Arepas
cards.fullText:
FLAVORFUL CURE At the start of your turn, if you have
a Madrigal character in play, remove up to 2 damage
from chosen character.
THAT DID THE TRICK ⟳ — If you removed damage from
a character this turn, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Ranger Plane
cards.fullText:
AIR SUPPORT Your characters gain Support. (Whenever
they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)
BIG LIFT ⟳ — Chosen character with 10 ¤ or more
gets +3 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Gadget's Goggles
cards.fullText:
ENHANCED VISION ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Look at the top 2 cards
of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the
other on the bottom.
cards.flavorText:
Dale: “Do you see anything, Gadget?”
Gadget: “Yeah, but I wish I didn't.”

cards.name: Shepherd's Journal
cards.fullText:
MARGIN NOTES When you play this item, you may look
at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top of
your deck or into your discard.
KEY TO THE PUZZLE 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Return
another item card from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Casa Madrigal
cards.fullText:
HEALING HOME Whenever a character quests while here, you may
remove up to 2 damage from them. Then, you may remove up to 2
damage from this location.

cards.name: Pocahontas
cards.fullText:
WANDERING SPIRIT Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, return a
location card from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Sometimes the right path is not the easiest one.”
—Grandmother Willow

cards.name: Syndrome
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Syndrome.)
GOT ME MONOLOGUING! Whenever this character
quests, return a Robot character card from your
discard to your hand. Then, you may play or shift
a Robot character with cost 8 or less for free.

cards.name: Omnidroid
cards.flavorText:
“It's bigger! It's badder! Ladies and gentlemen, it's
too much for Mr. Incredible!”
—Syndrome

cards.name: Angus
cards.fullText:
DAUNTLESS When you play this character,
chosen character gains Alert this turn. (They can
challenge as if they had Evasive.)

cards.name: Fergus
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
cards.flavorText: “Come on then! I'll take ye all on at once!”

cards.name: Wee Dingwall
cards.fullText:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
cards.flavorText:
“No big flower's gonnae block our way, Da. I'll tear
it apart with me own hands.”

cards.name: Incrediboy
cards.fullText:
NERDING OUT When you play this character, if a
Hero character is in play, gain 1 lore.
SPOILER ALERT This character also counts as
being named Syndrome for Shift.
cards.flavorText: “Not every superhero has powers, you know.”

cards.name: Violet Parr
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
“Keep laughing, Dash. It's time to play ‘Bowling
for Brothers.’”
—Violet

cards.name: Mrs. Incredible
cards.fullText:
PEP TALK When you play this character, chosen
character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get
+2 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText:
“You can do this. I believe in you. Now let's show
them what we can do!”

cards.name: Young Macintosh
cards.flavorText:
“We've got the strength and we've got the swords.
What vine could stand against all of that, right Da?”

cards.name: Lord Macintosh
cards.fullText:
TOUGH IT OUT This character may enter play
exerted to give chosen character Resist +2 until the
start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
cards.flavorText:
“Clan Macintosh fears no flower, vine, or tree.
We dinnae mess with shrubs, though.”

cards.name: Fat Cat
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“I'm afraid your information is out of date, my
dear rodent. I know what the glyphs are for, and
more importantly...how to use them.”

cards.name: Rat Capone
cards.fullText:
SHADAAP! While this character has no damage,
he gets +3 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“Listen here, you no good, dirty cat. We had a
deal! Yeah, a deal, see? And you gotta honor it!”

cards.name: Omnidroid
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Omnidroid.)
ENEMY DETECTED When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play it, you may deal 2
damage to chosen character.

cards.name: Mr. Incredible
cards.fullName: Mr. Incredible - Taking Out the Trash
cards.fullText:
KA-POW! When you play this character, you may
deal 2 damage to chosen opposing Robot or Villain
character.
cards.flavorText:
“Heavyweight problems need heavyweight solutions.”
—Mr. Incredible

cards.name: Lord Dingwall
cards.fullText:
FIGHTIN' TALK This character may enter play
exerted to give chosen character Challenger +3
this turn. (They get +3 ¤ while challenging.)
cards.flavorText:
“Ach, look at the size o' that flower! Let's clear that
beastie out before it causes any trouble.”

cards.name: Fat Cat
cards.fullText:
WORTHY INVESTMENT Your locations gain Resist
+1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“You don't become the most wanted cat in the
realm by playing nice.”

cards.name: Maudie
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText: “I'm here to look after three bairns, not three bears!”

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
FALLING ROCKS Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, you may
deal 1 damage to chosen character or location.
cards.flavorText: “Gawrsh! Look out below!”

cards.name: Omnidroid
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Omnidroid.)
ELECTRO-ARMOR While there's a card under this
character, it gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Merida
cards.fullText:
FULL QUIVER When you play this character, you
may return an action card named Three Arrows
from your discard to your hand.
STEADY AIM Whenever one of your actions deals
damage to an opposing character, deal 2 damage
to that character.

cards.name: John Smith
cards.flavorText: “Look alive, men. There's plenty of fish in this river!”

cards.name: Gizmoduck
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
FAIL-SAFE While you have no cards in your hand,
opponents can't play actions with cost 4 or more.

cards.name: Fergus
cards.fullText:
JUST THE SPOT During your turn, whenever this
character becomes exerted, you may play a location
from your hand or discard with cost 4 or less for free.
HOLD FAST While this character is at a location,
whenever a location is challenged and banished, you
may deal 4 damage to chosen character.

cards.name: Mrs. Incredible
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡
PULL BACK Your characters gain Resist +1.
REGROUP During your turn, whenever another
character is banished in a challenge, you may ready
chosen Super character. If you do, they can't quest
for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Diablo
cards.fullText:
CRUEL INTENT While you have a Villain character
in play, this character gets +2 ¤ and +1 ◊.
VILLAINOUS BOND While this character is
exerted, your Villain characters can't be
challenged.

cards.name: Three Arrows
cards.fullText:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. Then, you may
deal 1 damage to another chosen character.
cards.flavorText:
“I am Merida. Firstborn descendant of Clan DunBroch.
And I'll be shooting for my own hand.”
—Merida

cards.name: Card Advantage
cards.fullText:
If an opposing character was banished in a challenge
this turn, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText:
“I didn't plant the vine! It was the Nine, the Nine!”
—Three of Spades

cards.name: Touch the Sky
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Move a character of yours to a location for free.
Then, draw cards equal to that location's ◊.

cards.name: Plunger Crossbow
cards.fullText:
SUCTION TECHNOLOGY ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Draw a card, then
choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
“All right, just let me adjust the trajectory.”
—Gadget Hackwrench

cards.name: Syndrome's Remote
cards.fullText:
ZERO-POINT ENERGY ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character
can't challenge during their next turn.
LEARN FROM THEIR LOSSES Whenever a Robot
character is banished, you may banish this item to
discard your hand and draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Club Door
cards.fullText:
WELCOME BACK, SIR If you have a character named
Fat Cat in play, you may play this card for free.
COOL CATS ONLY Your locations can't be challenged
by characters with cost 2 or less.

cards.name: Fat Cat's Club
cards.flavorText: The hottest club for only the coolest cats in town.

cards.name: The Island of Nomanisan
cards.fullName: The Island of Nomanisan - Syndrome's Headquarters
cards.fullText:
RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT Robot characters get +1 ¤ and +1 ⛉ while here.
CHEAP SHOT Once during your turn, whenever a character banishes another
character in a challenge while here, you may deal 2 damage to chosen character.

cards.name: Woody
cards.flavorText:
“Starin' over the jungle from this huge vine
I think back to when I was laughin' and feelin' fine
My friends were all around to welcome me back home
But now I'm lost in Lorcana and oh so alone”

cards.name: Rex
cards.fullText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play
exerted. An opposing character who challenges
one of your characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
RUN AWAY! During an opponent's turn, when this
character is banished, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Isabela Madrigal
cards.fullName: Isabela Madrigal - Such a Lovely Voice
cards.fullText:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to
sing songs.)
NEW MOTIF When you play this character, if you
removed 1 or more damage from one of your
characters this turn, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Mirage
cards.fullText:
BUSINESS ARRANGEMENT When you play this
character, if you have a Super or Hero character
in play, you may draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“The Supers aren't gone, Mr. Incredible. You're still
here. You can still do great things.”

cards.name: Edna Mode
cards.fullText:
NO CAPES! When you play this character, you
may return chosen item with cost 2 or less to its
player's hand. If you do, its player draws a card.
MAKING SUPERS FABULOUS Whenever this
character quests, your Super characters get +1 ◊
this turn.

cards.name: Doc
cards.story: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cards.fullText:
SHARE KNOWLEDGE When you play this character,
if you have another Seven Dwarfs character or a
Princess character in play, draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“Oh boy! Now this is a change grant...uh, a
ranged pant...a strange plant!”

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.flavorText:
“Environment appears habitable, but the flora
seems to have undergone some strange
mutations. Could be Zurg's influence.”

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
BURNING CURIOSITY Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
each opponent chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
In the wilderness of Lorcana, a little luck goes a
long way.

cards.name: Merida
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Merida.)
FIERCE PROTECTION While this character is
exerted, whenever an opposing character

cards.fullText:
HANG ON! When you play this character, choose
one of the following. If you have another Toy
character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return a character card with cost 2 or less
from your discard to your hand.
• You may play a character with cost 2 or less for free.

cards.name: Christopher Robin
cards.fullText:
GATHER THE PARTY You can have other Hunny
characters in your deck regardless of ink type.
MAGICAL SUMMONS When you play this character,
you may search your deck for a Hunny card, reveal it,
and put it in your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Winnie the Pooh & Piglet
cards.fullName: Winnie the Pooh & Piglet - Hunny Mages
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top
of one of your characters named Winnie the Pooh
or Piglet.)
MAGICAL MIX This character gets +1 ◊ for each
different ink type of characters you have in play.

cards.name: Maleficent & Diablo
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Maleficent or Diablo.)
FOOLS! You may put 5 character cards from your discard
on the bottom of your deck in any order to shift this
character for free.
RAVEN'S CALL During your turn, whenever this character
exerts, draw a card.

cards.name: You've Got Some Punch
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Rush and Challenger +2 this
turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played. They
get +2 ¤ while challenging.)

cards.name: With a Few Good Friends
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 6 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen player draws a card for each different ink type
of characters you have in play.

cards.name: Petrify
cards.fullText: Exert chosen opposing character.
cards.flavorText:
“What's making that awful noise? It sounds like it's
coming our way.”
—Shanzay, an Illumineer

cards.name: One and Only
cards.fullText:
Choose a character. Banish all other characters with
the same name as that character.
cards.flavorText:
“Is that.... me? The vine made a copy of me to defend
itself?!”

cards.name: Protective Aura
cards.fullText:
Your Floodborn characters gain Evasive until the start
of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
cards.flavorText:
The glow of the vine-created replicas was beautiful...
but unsettling.

cards.name: Narrow Escape
cards.fullText:
Return up to 2 chosen characters, items, or locations
with cost 2 or less each to their player's hand.

cards.name: Broken Pod
cards.fullText:
RENEWAL PROCESS ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Put a card from chosen
player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
cards.flavorText:
“Looks like another vineling's on the loose. Let's go get it.”
—Venturo, an Illumineer

cards.name: Magical Hunny Staff
cards.fullText:
GIFT OF THE HIVE Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡
to give chosen character of yours the Hunny classification
until the start of your next turn.
SPELL OF SWIFTNESS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen Hunny character
of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Source of the Vine
cards.fullText:
SIPHON Whenever an opposing character quests, you
gain 1 lore unless their player pays 1 ⬡.
RADIANT BLOOM ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Soon it'll drain every drop of ink in Lorcana...”
—Hana, an Illumineer

cards.name: Ring of Stones
cards.fullName: Ring of Stones - Taken by the Vine
cards.fullText: DEEP WISDOM Your Floodborn characters get +1 ◊.
cards.flavorText: The tendrils wrapped around each stone, searching for more ink.

cards.name: Carl Fredricksen
cards.fullText:
TAKE MY HAND When you play this character, you
pay 2 ⬡ less for the next character named Ellie
Fredricksen you play this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“You know, Ellie, I think we're going to be together
forever.”

cards.name: Ellie Fredricksen
cards.fullText:
ADVENTUROUS HEART Whenever you play a
location, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: “Every moment we're together is an adventure.”

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.fullText: NOT A FLYING TOY This character can't gain Evasive.
cards.flavorText:
“Star Command, the foliage on this planet is
uniquely disarming.”

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.fullText:
ACTION FIGURE When you play this character,
choose one of the following. If you have another Toy
character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return an action card with cost 2 or less
from your discard to your hand.
• You may play an action with cost 2 or less for free.

cards.name: Gopher
cards.fullText:
DOWN THE HOLE This character may enter play
exerted.
FORTIFYING MEAL During an opponent's turn,
while this character is exerted, your other Hunny
characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Russell
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Russell.)
BASE CAMP Your characters at locations get +1 ¤.
GOOD LEADERSHIP Whenever one of your
characters with 4 ¤ or more quests, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
THE FATES' DESIGN When you play this character,
you may choose and discard a card. If you do,
return chosen character to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText: “I...said...GET...OUT!”

cards.name: Tod
cards.fullText:
PROBLEM SOLVING When you play this character,
draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
cards.flavorText:
“This would be a lot easier if these vines tasted
better.”

cards.name: Russell
cards.fullText:
ASSISTING THE ELDERLY BADGE Whenever this
character quests, you may move him and one of your
other characters to the same location for free.
cards.flavorText:
“An Explorer is a friend to all, be it plants or fish or
tiny mole.”

cards.name: Roo
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except
to challenge.)
ELUSIVE EXPERTISE While you have another Hunny
character in play, this character gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Winifred
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Hathi! Stop yapping about your medal and do
something about this renegade vegetation!”

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.fullText:
CLEAR IT OUT When you play this character, you
may pay 1 ⬡ to banish chosen item.
cards.flavorText:
“I don't know what that is, but let's send it back
where it came from.”

cards.name: Madam Mim
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
JUST HOW I LIKE IT All cards in your hand count as
having ◉.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.flavorText:
Minnie peered through the snarl of thorns.
Was that a narrow passage into the vine? She
wondered how far it might go.

cards.name: Kevin
cards.fullText:
BACK TO THE NEST Whenever this character
quests, put this card on the top of your deck.
cards.flavorText:
“She has been gathering food for her babies and
must get back to them.”
—Dug

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.fullName: Peter Pan - Created by the Vine
cards.fullText:
CLEVER TRICK Whenever one of your Floodborn
characters is challenged, the challenging player
chooses and discards a card.
cards.flavorText:
The replicas the vine created glowed with an
infusion of mixed ink.

cards.name: Copper
cards.flavorText:
“And then Chief was sleeping, but the vine touched
his leg, and he jumped up in the air like this!”
—Copper

cards.name: Posey
cards.fullText:
Potato Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this
on top of one of your items named Potato.)
cards.flavorText:
“She's alive! Alive, I tell you!”
—Dr. Bushroot

cards.name: Dr. Bushroot
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
FAIR IS FAIR Whenever this character is challenged,
chosen opponent chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: Mother Gothel
cards.flavorText: “Well, I'm glad somebody let me up!”

cards.name: Tod & Copper
cards.fullText:
Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Tod or Copper.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.fullText:
THE CALL OF ADVENTURE Once during your turn,
you may discard a card to give this character +1 ◊
and Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Cetus
cards.flavorText:
“Okay, so this vine? Not in my plans. But I'm a
resourceful god. Gotta roll with punches. Adapt.
Bring out the sea serpent.”
—Hades

cards.name: Mushu
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
TIP THE SCALES Whenever this character quests,
if an opponent has more cards in their hand than
you, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Carl Fredricksen & Russell
cards.fullText:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Carl Fredricksen or Russell.)
OUTDOOR SKILLS While this character is at a location,
all characters at that location get +1 ◊ and gain Evasive.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse
cards.fullName: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse - Adventuring Duo
cards.fullText:
Duo Shift 0 ⬡ (You may pay 0 ⬡ to play this on
top of two of your characters, one named Mickey
Mouse and one named Minnie Mouse.)
THINKING OF YOU If this character would be
banished, put them into your inkwell facedown
and exerted instead.

cards.name: Rapunzel & Flynn Rider
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Rapunzel or Flynn Rider.)
CLEVER SWAP Whenever this character quests, you may
draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
FRESH START During your turn, whenever you discard
a character card, you may play that character from your
discard. (You pay all costs.)

cards.name: To Wither a Flower
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Deal 2 damage to each opposing damaged character.

cards.name: Piercing Attack
cards.fullText:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. This damage can't
be reduced by Resist.

cards.name: Put That Thing Back
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Return chosen character or item to their player's hand.
cards.flavorText: ...Where it came from or so help me

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.fullText: If an opponent has more lore than you, gain 2 lore.
cards.flavorText:
When the odds seem longest, Mickey and Minnie will
find their way through.

cards.name: Potato
cards.fullText: FULL OF POTENTIAL This item enters play exerted.
cards.flavorText: It doesn't have much flavor.

cards.name: My Adventure Book
cards.fullText:
NEW MEMORIES ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Reveal the top card of your deck.
If it's a non-character card or a character card named Kevin,
put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of
your deck.
cards.flavorText: “Thanks for the adventure—now go have a new one! Love, Ellie”

cards.name: Vine Pod
cards.fullText:
FRAGILE HUSK This item enters play exerted.
REGENERATE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Banish chosen character of
yours. You may play a character with the same name as
that character for free.

cards.name: Paradise Falls
cards.fullText: QUITE A SIGHT While you have a character here, this location gets +3 ◊.
cards.flavorText: A land lost in time.

cards.name: Dash Parr
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Dash Parr.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
FOLLOW ME! Whenever this character quests, you may
reveal the top card of your deck. If you do, you may play it.
Otherwise, put it into your discard. (You pay all costs.)

cards.name: Yzma
cards.fullText:
GET THIS RIGHT When you play this character,
each opponent loses 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Is there anything on this menu that isn't swimming
in gravy?”

cards.name: Kuzco
cards.flavorText:
“Give me the chili cheese sampler, hold the chili and
put the cheese on the side. Oh, and extra gravy...
Hey! Are you listening? I'm ordering here!”

cards.name: The Bear
cards.fullText:
SAVAGE FURY While this character has damage,
he gets +3 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“Look, Copper. The vine's no match for that bear!”
—Amos Slade

cards.name: Carl Fredricksen
cards.fullText:
MOVING PARTNER Whenever you play a location,
you may move this character and up to 1 of your
other characters to that location for free.
ADVENTURE AWAITS Whenever this character
quests while at a location, draw cards equal to
that location's ◊.

cards.name: Dash Parr
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“Hey look, I'm here! No wait, I'm over here now!
Nope, back here again!”

cards.name: Gaston
cards.fullText:
DRAWING STRENGTH Your Floodborn characters
get +1 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“Of course the vine would copy me. Look at him!
He's almost as handsome as I am.”
—Gaston

cards.name: Colonel Hathi
cards.fullText:
HUP, TWO, THREE, FOUR Whenever this character
quests, you may move him to one of your locations
for free.
cards.flavorText: “March, march, march. No complaining.”

cards.name: Splodyhead
cards.flavorText:
“Is ideal experiment for making of campfires,
roasting of marshmallows, and also blowing up
of things.”
—Jumba Jookiba

cards.name: Pacha
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
ADRENALINE SURGE During your turn, this
character gets +4 ¤.

cards.name: Sun Yee
cards.fullText:
Temporary Red Panda Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay
2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your Red Panda
characters. At the end of your turn, remove all
damage from this character and return only this
card to your hand.)

cards.name: Grandma Wu
cards.fullText:
Temporary Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Grandma Wu. At the
end of your turn, remove all damage from this character
and return only this card to your hand.)
INTIMIDATING CHARGE Whenever this character
challenges another character, you gain 2 lore and each
opponent loses 2 lore.

cards.name: King Louie
cards.fullText:
Singer 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to sing
songs.)
cards.flavorText:
“Come on, groove with ol' King Louie. You cats
need to relax!”

cards.name: Beast
cards.fullText:
FORMIDABLE LOVE While you have a character named
Belle in play, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
The Beast treasured two things above all: the enchanted
rose and the love who could break his curse.

cards.name: Randall Boggs
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
AFTER-HOURS PROJECT While all cards in your
inkwell are exerted, this character gets +2 ◊.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
Mickey Mouse: “I wouldn't do that, Donald!”
Donald Duck: “That's why I have more fun!”

cards.name: Meilin Lee
cards.fullText:
Temporary Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this
on top of one of your characters named Meilin Lee.
At the end of your turn, remove all damage from this
character and return only this card to your hand.)
KARAOKE QUEEN Once during your turn, whenever
this character sings a song, gain 3 lore.

cards.name: Tigger
cards.fullText:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
PROTECTIVE CHARGE Once during your turn, whenever
this character challenges another character, you may
ready chosen Hunny character. If you do, that character
can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Boo
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
KID-TASTROPHE! Whenever this character challenges
another character with 3 ¤ or less, banish that
character. (No damage is dealt in that challenge.)

cards.name: Sulley
cards.fullText:
FEARSOME GLARE When you play this character, you
may exert all cards in your inkwell.
RILED UP While all cards in your inkwell are exerted,
this character gains Rush. (They can challenge the
turn they're played.)

cards.name: Ming Lee
cards.fullText:
Temporary Shift 7 ⬡ (You may pay 7 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Ming Lee. At the
end of your turn, remove all damage from this character
and return only this card to your hand.)
PATH OF DESTRUCTION Whenever this character
challenges another character, ready her. She can't quest
for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Captain Hook
cards.fullText:
HAVE AT YOU Whenever this character challenges
another character, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Smee! We have some uninvited guests—time to
show them our famed hospitality.”

cards.name: Peter Pan
cards.flavorText:
“Come on, you big bully. You've gotta be faster
than that!”

cards.name: Belle & Beast
cards.fullName: Belle & Beast - Certain as the Sun
cards.fullText:
Shift 6 ⬡ (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Belle or Beast.)
INSPIRING DANCE Whenever this character quests,
ready all cards in your inkwell.
APPRECIATIVE AUDIENCE 6 ⬡ — Ready your other
characters. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Dash Parr & Violet Parr
cards.fullName: Dash Parr & Violet Parr - Super Siblings
cards.fullText:
Combo Shift 6 ⬡ (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Dash Parr, one
named Violet Parr, or one of each.)
Evasive, Resist +1
INCREDIBLE TACTICS Whenever this character quests
or challenges, draw a card for each card under them.

cards.name: Red Moon Ritual
cards.fullText:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 7 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish chosen character.

cards.name: Red Alert
cards.fullText:
Banish chosen character with 3 ¤ or less. If you have
a Monster character in play, chosen opponent loses
1 lore.
cards.flavorText:
“Please remain calm. This is not a drill.”
—CDA Agent

cards.name: Rahr!
cards.fullText: Chosen character gets +3 ¤ this turn.
cards.flavorText:
“Did you see the look on my face? It was the scariest
one yet!”
—Mike Wazowski

cards.name: Prophetic Vision
cards.fullText:
Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top card. If it's an
action card, you may play it for free. Otherwise, put it on
the bottom of your deck, then each opponent loses 1 lore
and you gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: The vision showed the city but not the source of its power.

cards.name: It's Gonna Be Great!
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.

cards.name: Scream Canister
cards.fullText:
ERRATIC SCREAMS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Exert all cards in your
inkwell. Exert chosen opposing character with 2 ¤
or less.
cards.flavorText:
“‘Those screams are unstable, Randall.’ Pffft. Maybe
for you, you big hairball.”

cards.name: Bunch of Balloons
cards.fullText:
FLOAT AWAY When you play this item, choose a
location of yours. While this item is in play, that
location gains Evasive. (Only characters with Evasive
can challenge it.)
OUT OF SIGHT 3 ⬡ — Return this item to your hand.

cards.name: Beast's Castle
cards.fullName: Beast's Castle - Overrun by the Vine
cards.fullText:
IMMINENT THREAT Your Floodborn characters gain Rush. (They can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText: A deep rumble echoed through the forest as the vine ripped the castle from its foundation.

cards.name: Carl's House
cards.fullText:
MOVING DAY Once during your turn, you may move chosen character
from here to another location for free. If you do, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Launchpad
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
Launchpad: “Don't worry, DW, I'll make sure we
crash there safely!”
Darkwing Duck: “That's what I'm afraid of.”

cards.name: Dug
cards.fullText:
FETCH! When you play this character, if you have
an item in play, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “A ball! Oh boy, oh boy, a ball!”

cards.name: Roz
cards.fullText:
ALWAYS Each opponent plays with the top card
of their deck faceup.
cards.flavorText:
“And I'm sure you filed your paperwork correctly.
For once.”

cards.name: Merlin
cards.fullText:
MINOR TRICKERY When you play this character,
you may draw a card from the bottom of
your deck.
AGE OF INCONVENIENCE When this character is
banished, put this card from your discard on the
bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Quackerjack
cards.fullText:
EVIL DESIGN When you play this character and
whenever he quests, put the top 4 cards of your
deck into your discard. You may deal 1 damage to
chosen character for each item card put into your
discard this way.

cards.name: Belle
cards.fullText:
DREAMING OF MORE You pay 1 ⬡ less to shift a
character on top of this character.
cards.flavorText:
“I just finished the most wonderful story about a
beanstalk and an ogre...”

cards.name: Ellie Fredricksen
cards.fullText:
ALWAYS WITH YOU When this character is banished,
you may put this card into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “Adventure has a way of finding us wherever we go.”

cards.name: Mrs. Hasagawa
cards.flavorText:
The old woman turned as the vine's shadow fell
over her fruit stand. “Hello, dear! More mangoes
today?”

cards.name: Alpha
cards.fullText:
WHO WANTS A TREAT? Whenever you play an item,
chosen character gets +1 ¤ and gains Resist +1 this
turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“Now we will find the small mailman and The One
Who Smells of Prunes.”

cards.name: Sulley
cards.fullText:
JUMP SCARE While you have 5 or more cards in
your inkwell, this character gets +2 ¤.
cards.flavorText:
“Show them what it takes to be our top scarer!”
—Henry J. Waternoose III

cards.name: Randall Boggs
cards.fullText:
GET OUTTA HERE! When you play this character,
put chosen character of yours into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
DEVIOUS PLAN At the end of your turn, if all cards
in your inkwell are exerted, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Piglet
cards.flavorText:
“It's okay, Piglet. Being scared doesn't mean
you're not brave. In fact, I think you can only be
brave if you're scared first!”
—Christopher Robin, Hunny Sage

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.flavorText:
“Oh boy, I knew climbing this vine would be worth it.
There's so much to see up here!”

cards.name: Hades
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“This little guy is so hideous! I love it! And the way
it sucks up flood ink? Even I couldn't have planned
it any better.”

cards.name: Antonio Madrigal
cards.fullText:
HEALING HANDS When you play this character,
you may remove up to 3 damage from chosen
character of yours. If you removed damage this
way, put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Maid Marian
cards.fullName: Maid Marian - Created by the Vine
cards.fullText:
INKFLOW Whenever one of your Floodborn characters
is banished, you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.fullName: Robin Hood - Created by the Vine
cards.fullText:
KEEN-EYED Your Floodborn characters gain Alert.
(They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
cards.flavorText:
The vine created defenders to keep silent watch on
the surrounding lands.

cards.name: Boo
cards.fullText:
MAKING MEMORIES While you have 5 or more
cards in your inkwell, this character gets +2 ◊.
cards.flavorText:
For the rest of her life, Boo would remember her
friend, Kitty.

cards.name: Pluto
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
cards.flavorText: He didn't like the smell of that vine one bit.

cards.name: Charles Muntz
cards.fullText:
USEFUL GEAR Whenever you play an item, look at the top
card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of
your deck.
FIND THAT BIRD! Whenever this character quests, look at the
top card of your deck. If it's a character card named Kevin,
you may reveal it and put it into your hand to gain 3 lore.
Otherwise, put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Henry J. Waternoose III
cards.fullName: Henry J. Waternoose III - Chief Executive Officer
cards.fullText:
THE BOTTOM LINE While you have more cards
in your inkwell than each opposing player, this
character gets +2 ◊ and gains Ward. (Opponents
can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Eeyore
cards.fullText:
HUNNY TACTICS Whenever this character quests,
chosen Hunny character of yours gets +1 ◊
and gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText: “It's okay. Pile more things on. I'll be fine.”

cards.name: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad
cards.fullName: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad - St. Canard's Finest
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Darkwing Duck or Launchpad.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
VICTORY POSE During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.

cards.name: Power Surge
cards.fullText:
Each player puts the top 2 cards of their deck into their
inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText:
Sulley: “What was that?”
Mike: “I have no idea, but it would be really great if it
didn't do it again.”

cards.name: Focused Search
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
a character card named Kevin or an item card and put

KAIJU CRUSH When you play this character, you
may banish chosen location.
cards.flavorText: “I think I'm getting the hang of this.”

cards.name: Honey Lemon
cards.fullText:
ADVANCED CHEMISTRY When you play this character
and whenever she quests, you may banish chosen
item of yours. If you do, draw a card and get 1 ink
drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)

cards.name: Air Drop
cards.fullText:
Deal 3 damage to chosen character. If that character
has damage, deal 5 damage instead.
cards.flavorText:
“We don't need to steal the cargo, boss. It's coming
right to us!”
—Dumptruck

cards.name: Above the Crowd
cards.fullText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put chosen opposing character with 3 ¤ or less on
the bottom of their player's deck.

cards.name: This Is Business
cards.fullText:
Chosen opponent chooses one:
• They reveal their hand and discard a card of your
choice. They get 2 ink drops. (Each ink drop may be
removed to pay 1 ⬡.)
• You draw a card and get 2 ink drops.

cards.name: Leaning Tower of Cheese-a
cards.fullText:
FAIR TRADE When you play this item, you may draw a
card, then choose and discard a card.
EXTRA CHEESY While you have 4 items named Leaning
Tower of Cheese-a in play, your items gain Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them.)

cards.name: HeiHei
cards.fullText:
AIMLESS WANDERING Once during your turn, if
this character is at a location, you may move him
to another location for free. If you do, gain 1 lore.
cards.flavorText: That answers the how, but not the why.

cards.name: Abby Park
cards.fullText:
DREAM COME TRUE When you play this character,
reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a character
card with Singer or a song card, you may put it
into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of
your deck.
cards.flavorText: “Best. Concert. EVER!”

cards.name: Goofy
cards.fullText:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Goofy.)
Singer 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to
sing songs.)
IN THE GROOVE Whenever this character quests,
your other characters with Singer get +1 ◊ this turn.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.fullText:
RUSH HOUR When you play this character,
chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played.)
cards.flavorText: “Move it, buster! I've got places to be!”

cards.name: Cruella De Vil
cards.fullText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
cards.flavorText:
“Out of my way, imbeciles! I've got important
business to see to!”

cards.name: Jasper
cards.fullText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
cards.flavorText:
“You can use the big boat when you've earned it.”
—Cruella

cards.name: Stacey
cards.flavorText:
“Check it out—they had the limited-edition
Powerline scented candle! I've been looking for
that forever!”

cards.name: Ernesto de la Cruz
cards.fullName: Ernesto de la Cruz - Ruthless Musician
cards.fullText:
Singer 8 (This character counts as cost 8 to sing songs.)
WHATEVER IT TAKES When you play this character,
you may banish chosen character with Singer.

cards.name: Tramp
cards.fullText:
GIVE CHASE When you play this character,
choose one:
• Exert chosen character with 1 ¤ or less.
• This character gains Rush this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played.)

cards.name: Wasabi
cards.fullText:
TWIN BLADES During your turn, whenever this
character deals damage to another character in a
challenge, deal damage equal to this character's
¤ to another chosen character.
BRING THE HEAT While you have an ink drop, this
character gets +2 ¤.

cards.name: Jukebox
cards.fullText:
ON REPEAT Once during your turn, whenever you play
a song, if it has the same name as another card in your
discard, you may ready chosen character. If you do,
they can't quest for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
DISCERNING EYE When you play this character,
look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either
the top or the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavorText: “Maybe it is old-fashioned, but I'll fix that.”

cards.name: Wasabi
cards.fullText:
SAFETY FIRST When you play this character, if
you removed an ink drop to play him, your other
characters gain Resist +1 and Ward until the
start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1. Opponents can't choose them except
to challenge.)

cards.name: Madam Mim
cards.fullText:
NO HIDING When you play this character, look at
chosen opponent's hand.
cards.flavorText:
“Yoo-hooo! Merlin! What are you playing with?
Don't you know it's nice to share your toys?”

cards.name: Lionheart
cards.fullText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they
had Evasive.)
CIVIC DUTY 6 ⬡ — Remove all damage from
chosen character or location.

cards.name: Thomas O'Malley
cards.fullText:
LUCKY BREAK Whenever this character quests,
each player reveals the top card of their deck.
Put the card with the highest cost revealed this
way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its
player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of their
players' decks.

cards.name: Duchess
cards.fullText:
UPPER CRUST While you have a character in play
with the highest cost, or tied for highest cost, this
character gets +1 ◊.
PROPER ETIQUETTE Whenever this character
quests, look at the top card of your deck. Put that
card on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Judy Hopps
cards.fullText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
LEND A PAW When you play this character, if you
played another character this turn, you may put the
top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except
to challenge.)
ALL BY DESIGN At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, you may look at the cards in
your inkwell and then you may return one to your
hand. If you do either, exert all cards in your inkwell.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Cinderella.)
BESPOKE DESIGN At the end of your turn, you
may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one
on either the top or the bottom of your deck and
the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Doug
cards.fullText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
cards.flavorText:
“Just watch it. Doug is the opposite of friendly.
He's unfriendly.”
—Duke Weaselton

cards.name: Intense Research
cards.fullText:
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, then put one into
your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck
in any order. If you removed an ink drop to play this
action, look at the top 5 cards of your deck instead.

cards.name: Scram!
cards.fullText:
Put chosen opposing character with cost 2 or less into
their player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
cards.flavorText: “For the last time, I don't take on apprentices!”

cards.name: Upgraded Chem Purse
cards.fullText:
IT'S GOT POCKETS! ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish one of your other
items — Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal an item card and put it into your hand. Put the
rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Toulouse
cards.fullText:
UNBECOMING BEHAVIOR When you play this
character, opponents can't play actions until the
start of your next turn.
cards.flavorText: The size of a house slipper with the heart of a tiger.

cards.name: Arthur
cards.fullText:
CAREFUL CRAFTING When you play this character,
you may pay 1 ⬡ to get 1 ink drop. (You may remove
an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
cards.flavorText:
“You need a strong arm and a strong mind to craft
these ink drops.”
—Merlin

cards.name: Berlioz
cards.fullText:
SHARP LITTLE CLAWS When you play this character,
you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
cards.flavorText: “This'll show that mean ol' butler.”

cards.name: Marie
cards.fullText:
A LITTLE TREAT Whenever this character quests,
if an opposing character took damage this turn,
get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to
pay 1 ⬡.)
cards.flavorText: “Danger is no excuse to forget one's manners.”

cards.name: Baloo
cards.fullText:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
cards.flavorText:
“Hey, no fair! You're air pirates—you're not supposed
to attack me on the ground!”

cards.name: Shere Khan
cards.fullText:
NEW INCENTIVE When you play this character, chosen
character can challenge ready characters this turn.
CORNER THE MARKET Once during your turn, whenever
one of your other characters banishes another character
in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink
drop to pay 1 ⬡.)

cards.name: Tiana
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Tiana.)
IDEAL VENUE When you play this character, you
may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a
card. If you discarded a location card this way,
you may play it from your discard for free.

cards.name: Jousting Match
cards.fullText:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. If you removed an
ink drop to play this action, deal 5 damage instead.
cards.flavorText:
“Jousting is a fine skill. It's...it's a highly developed
science.”
—Sir Pellinore

cards.name: Hyperia City Express
cards.fullText:
EASY COMMUTE ⟳ — Move a character of yours to a
location for free.
STYLISH CONVENIENCE Your Hyperia City locations
get +2 ⛉.
cards.flavorText: Arrive on time, every time.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.fullText:
Adventurous
HOT DOG! At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, each player gets 1 ink drop.

cards.name: Cinderella
cards.fullText:
Shift 5 ⬡
BESPOKE DESIGN At the end of your turn, you
may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one
on either the top or the bottom of your deck and
the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
